description: 🇰🇷 3 Cafes to visit in Seoul, Korea ⬇️ You’ll never have a shortage of cafes to visit in Seoul. There are so many amazing cafe and shops to grab coffee, tea or sweets from. These are some of my favorite ones that are worth visiting:  ☕️ Cafe 1 In 1 Jan 534 Yeonseo-ro, Jingwan-dong, Eunpyeong District, Seoul 🕙 Hours: 10 AM - 9:30 PM Daily (closed Mondays)  Located in Eunpyeong Hanok Village featuring Bukhansan Mountain as a stunning backdrop. Unlike the historic hanoks of Bukchon, Eunpyeong Hanok Village was intentionally designed as a cultural and tourist-friendly site. Whereas over tourism has disrupted daily life of residents at Bukchon, tourism is welcome at Eunpyeong. The building is 6 stories - the 4th and 5th floors are called 1 In 1 Sang and serve meals whereas other floors are for coffee.  📍 Cafe Pokpo 카페폭포 @cafe.pokpo 262-29 Yeonhui-ro, Seodaemun-gu, Seoul 🕙 Hours: 10 AM - 9 PM Daily  Literally means “Cafe Waterfall” the cafe has unobstructed views of serene waterfalls (it is manmade.. but still incredible). It’s hard to believe that this is right in the middle of Seoul - it will feel like you’re in the countryside given how peaceful it is. The menu is simple, but you’re going here for the views and the vibes.  🎋 Cheongsudang Bakery 31-9 Donhwamun-ro 11na-gil, Jongno District, Seoul 🕙 Hours: 10:30 AM - 9 PM Daily This cafe is located in Inseon-dong, and is one of the most aesthetic Hanok-style cafes in the neighborhood. The entrance features a stone path lined with bamboo trees and lanterns. Their desserts are a bit pricey but so unique - like the Black Sesame Fromage Cake I tried. I think it’s totally worth the hype.  #korea #seoul #visitseoul #seoulcafe #travelkorea #travelseoul #koreafood  Coffee shops in Seoul | Hanok cafe | cafe in Seoul | korean coffee shops

description: 😱大马零售！线上疯涨线下愁？   家人们👋，最近大马零售圈那局势，简直比好莱坞大片还精彩刺激🎬！线上电商一路“狂飙”，线下实体店却急得像热锅上的蚂蚁，今天就带大家深度唠唠这场激烈的商业大战🤝！   先瞧瞧线上那些“王牌选手”✨。Shopee 在 2024 年于马来西亚站开启“暴走模式”啦🚀！Shopee Live 的观看次数从 2023 年的 20 亿次，像坐火箭一样直接窜到 770 亿次，这增长速度太惊人了😮！独立观众更是暴增 300%，啥概念呢？原本 1 个人看，现在变成 4 个人看啦👀！本地卖家跟着赚得盆满钵满，销售额破百万令吉的订单量直接翻了 11 倍，头部品牌订单量也翻了 10 倍，这赚钱速度，谁看了不眼红😍！还有 Shopee Video，上线才一年，就产出 700 万个视频，直接带动 50 万笔订单，妥妥的“短视频引流 + 直播爆单”黄金组合，这操作，太牛了👍！   物流这块，Shopee 更是用 AI 玩出了新高度🤖！当日达服务使用率暴增 84 倍，全马自提点疯狂扩张到 1200 多个，使用率飙涨 6 倍！效率大幅提升，成本自然就降下来了，东南亚仓储成本砍了 20% +，巴西那边单均亏损更是暴跌 87.9%！就算低价卖货，利润也相当可观，这生意经，绝了👏！   不过，Shopee 可不是“一家独大”哦😏。TikTok Shop 来势汹汹，市场份额从 35% 猛地窜到 43%，直播 GMV 狂飙 170%！Lazada 背靠阿里这座“大山”，在 3C 家电圈稳稳守住 40%份额。2024 年电商 GMV 预计能冲到 160 亿美元，同比涨 17%，线上消费占 GDP 都到 36.7%了，线上战场这火药味，浓得能呛人呀🔥！   #181富人俱乐部 #大马零售 #线上电商 #线下实体 #Shopee #TikTokShop #Lazada #电商大战 #商业分析 #零售行业 #线上消费 #线下困境 #电商数据 #直播带货 #短视频引流 #物流创新 #商业策略 #零售风云 #线上线下对比 #181富人俱乐部

description: Want to study aesthetically for upcoming exams during Ramadan, but can’t order food/drinks? WE GOT YOU! ⭐️ Hisashi Coffee Company is introducing our "Reserve & Focus" scheme for the duration of Ramadan, where you can hire a table and use our space to lock in and focus while you're fasting. The hirable tables will be next to a plug socket which supports USB and micro USB, and you'll have access to our WiFi *How does it work?* You simply order a full or half session of 'Reserve & Focus' at the front counter! We'll provide you with a stamp card which will state the start and end time of your session. Full session: £2.50 per hour (pp), with a minimum booking of 2 hours. Half session: £3.00 for one hour (pp). Available from 7am until 5pm daily, (excluding Saturday).   This is a great way to get things done, while also supporting your local independent coffee shop this Ramadan season. BONUS: if you use our 'Reserve and Focus' stamp card three times in the month of Ramadan between 01/03/25 until Eid, and collect 3 sessions (half or full), you'll be entitled to a free drink* and a Pistachio Kunafa chocolate bar (combined value of up to £9.45), available to claim any time until 05/05/25, just be sure to bring in your stamp card to trade in. *Free drinks includes: Any medium size HOT or ICED coffee based drink, with the option to add any one flavour. Our traditional medium matcha latte HOT or ICED (not including blueberry, strawberry, sakura, chocolate, or white chocolate) Any medium frappe excluding matcha. Any juice of your choice. Extra espresso, whipped cream, alternative milk, sizing up, or an extra shot of matcha will be charged. NO REFUNDS OFFERED FOR THE RESERVE AND FOCUS SCHEME. #fyp #foryour #ramadan #study #studytok #cafe #studyspot #london #londoncafe #fasting

description: Kuchisake-onna. The Japanese vengeful ghost appears as a seemingly beautiful woman who roams the streets at night. She wears a face mask and carries a huge pair of scissors. If you are unlucky enough to meet Kuchisake-onna during a solitary stroll, she will ask you if you think she is beautiful. As with Aka Manto, consider your answer like your life depends on it (since it does). If you say no, she will murder you right then or later with her scissors. If you say yes, she will remove her face covering to reveal a gaping mouth that has been slit from ear to ear in a haunting smile. Then, she will ask again: say 'no' and you die, but stick with 'yes' and she will slit your mouth like hers. The only way to escape Kuchisake-onna, is to tell her that she looks average. #urbanlegend #horror #aiart #horrortok #horrorart #fyp #horrorcore #creepy #darkart #dark #scary #cryptid

description: Because coffee is life, even during the days I choose to be in bed all day 🫶🏻 Love the concept of @lakomkape's set of coffees because of how convenient it is to pack in my bag and prep when I'm ready to have my caffeine fix! All I need is ice and I have a strong cup of coffee ready to help me brace the day wherever, whenever. It's also pretty fun prepping my drink, reminded me of the reels of people making drinks in Korean convenience stores, ang saya pala to pour my drink in, I can't explain why HAHAHA I got the DIY Iced Coffee + LK! for Later, both of which I really enjoyed! The DIY Iced Coffee was extra creamy, which I love in iced coffee. No need to add sugar because the full cream milk gave it the right amount of sweetness while still bringing out the espresso's flavors! LK for Later was a bit more convenient since it's already pre-mixed and comes in one packet only. You can choose between sweet or creamy when getting LK, and while I enjoyed this one for its strength, I also found it a lil too bitter for my taste, so I added a bit more milk here to neutralize the acidity. But what I do know = it kept me up for a movie marathon pretty well 😂 You can get your fix from 'LAKOMKAPE in their physical stores around Metro Manila + one in San Pedro, Laguna, or ordering via Foodpanda!  #coffeeaddict #coffeelover #diycoffee #philippines🇵🇭tiktok #coffeetok

description: "Continental Breakfast" is an artwork by Swedish artist Anna Uddenberg. This piece is part of her exploration of consumer culture and its impact on identity and gender. In this work, Uddenberg often combines everyday objects and exaggerated forms to critique contemporary social norms. The artwork typically features an elaborate breakfast setting, showcasing a range of exaggerated, often surreal, elements that mimic or exaggerate luxury and indulgence. Uddenberg uses this setting to comment on issues such as the commodification of daily life, the superficiality of social rituals, and the roles and expectations placed on women. To understand and appreciate "Continental Breakfast," consider the following: 1. **Exaggeration and Surrealism**: The piece often includes exaggerated, surreal elements that challenge our perceptions of normality and luxury. This exaggeration serves to critique the superficial nature of consumer culture. 2. **Commentary on Consumerism**: By presenting a breakfast setting in an extravagant or absurd way, Uddenberg critiques the commodification of daily experiences and the way consumer culture influences our identities. 3. **Social and Gender Critique**: Uddenberg's work frequently addresses issues of gender and societal expectations. The depiction of a luxurious breakfast may be a metaphor for the pressures and expectations placed on individuals, particularly women, to conform to certain standards. Understanding "Continental Breakfast" involves recognizing these layers of critique and the ways in which Uddenberg uses visual and conceptual exaggeration to make a statement about modern life and societal norms. #art #fyp #viral #performance

description: Exploring a local house museum at Montaña de Oro State Park.  This beach-side Ranch house and land estate was owned by a couple generations of the Spooner family and functioned as Pecho Ranch before being sold to another family. The Ranch was re-named Montaña de Oro (“mountains of gold”) in reference to the beautiful golden wildflowers that appear on the hillsides during Spring. 🌼  It was a little too early to see the blooms, but you can probably start to see them around April if you visit.  The house is filled with turn-of-the-century edwardian and victorian furniture, clothing, and everyday objects. This mesmerizing installation features 62 glowing pumpkins reflected infinitely in a mirrored room, and is the only one of its kind in a North American museum collection! Each 45-second experience allows just two visitors at a time, creating an intimate and surreal journey into Kusama’s world. description: Have you walked a path worthy of your eyes? A trail that doesn’t merely stretch before you but unfolds like a whispered hymn to the earth, a quiet symphony of wind, wood, and distant peaks? In Moieciu de Sus, where the land rises and falls in gentle waves of emerald, where an old wooden fence stands like the stave of an unwritten melody, the world feels as if it is exhaling, unrushed, eternal. Here, the air carries the scent of damp earth and wildflowers, the sky is a vast canvas of drifting light, and the mountains hold their breath, watching, waiting. The path meanders like a thought left to wander—beneath your feet, the earth is soft, kissed by time, marked by the hooves of passing flocks and the careful steps of those who still listen to the land. The fence, weathered and worn, its beams darkened by years of rain and sun, does not merely divide but guides, a silent companion leading you through a world untouched by haste. Beyond it, hills roll like the crests of a slumbering sea, each rise and dip an invitation to step further into this untouched reverie. Shadows stretch long in the golden hours, painting the pastures in hues of honey and dusk, while the wind hums its ageless tune through the pines. There are places that quiet the mind and stir the soul, places where beauty does not beg for attention but exists, unshaken, for those who choose to see. This is such a place—a threshold between the seen and the felt, the present and the timeless. When was the last time you stood still and let the world move around you? description: #foryoupage #fypシ #bodydysphormia #mentalhealth #poetry  Body Dysmorphia- I was five-foot-ten and one-seventy-five. Not small, not large — just… statistical. A number that didn’t set off alarms for doctors or friends or charts online. People said I looked healthy. That I was lucky. That I had "nothing to worry about." But I worried anyway. Because they didn't see what I saw. I saw thighs that didn’t look right, a stomach that never sat flat, arms I wanted to carve into something smaller. I saw angles that felt like failures, softness that made me hate softness altogether. I’d stare into the mirror, trace outlines in disgust, measure bones and bulges with silent shame. If the tag read a size up, I didn’t eat that day. If I sat down and felt my body fold, I’d pull at my skin like it was the problem. They called it insecurity. I called it survival. Because I learned early that shrinking earned praise. That hunger felt holy. That thinness — even imagined — was the closest thing to control I would ever own. And so, I stopped eating. Quietly. No scenes. Just smaller portions, skipped meals, tight smiles. I’d watch people eat with ease while I counted everything I didn’t touch. I wore baggy clothes to hide the damage. I told them I was “just not hungry.” They believed me. Why wouldn’t they? I didn’t *look* sick. But I was. Starving became ritual — an act of devotion to a body I hated and a mind that would not forgive it. Even when the numbers dropped, even when I felt bones where curves had been, I didn’t feel better. I felt emptier. But emptiness was easier than being seen. Eventually, I tried to eat again. Tried to repair the wreckage. But recovery isn’t a straight road —it’s a tightrope. Because food no longer felt like food. It felt like betrayal. Like failure wearing frosting. People said, *“You should be proud. You’re eating again.”* But they didn’t know how I sat alone in my room afterward, crying over a sandwich because it tasted like guilt. And the worst part? I was never even “overweight.” Not by the world’s standards. But this wasn’t about the world. It was about what I saw — what the mirror showed me, what my mind twisted into truth. Because body dysmorphia doesn’t care about your BMI. It doesn’t care if you’re tall or average or lean. It’s not about fat. It’s about *wrong.* Feeling wrong in your own skin, like you’re wearing someone else’s shape and no one believes you. I wish I could explain how terrifying food becomes when your self-worth depends on not needing it. How your mind splits every bite into good or bad, every meal into win or lose. And people still don’t get it. They say I’m fine. That I look great. That I should love myself more. As if I haven’t tried. As if loving yourself is just a switch you flip on after enough affirmations. But I’ve spent years unlearning the belief that smaller equals better, that thinner equals worthy, that hunger equals strength. And the hardest part is I still haven’t unlearned it. I’m trying, though. Trying to eat without apology. To wear clothes without shame. To speak about the days when I hate my reflection and not feel weak for saying so. I am learning that health is not defined by the absence of visible wounds. That just because people don’t see your pain doesn’t mean you’re making it up. That just because you are not underweight doesn’t mean you are not unwell. I am learning to forgive myself for every time I believed the mirror instead of my body. For every skipped meal, every silent spiral, every tear shed over a number that never defined me. Because I am not numbers. I am not statistics.I am not what people guess by looking. I am a person — trying to survive in a body I’m learning to stay in, even on the days it feels impossible. And one day, I hope to feel full — not with food, but with grace. With peace. With the quiet knowing that I never had to shrink to be enough.

description: 记▪️2022年捐赠图书馆/阅读角落活动（1）终于，第一间完成啦‼️在获得足够的捐款后，我们已把书籍等物品备好，并与相关孤儿院约定了拜访时间。［2022.04.17］上午10点，我们抵达了位于Puchong的The Pure Life Society（Boy's Wing）。那里一共有22位年龄介于13至17岁的男孩（Senior Boys) 。其中有印裔和华裔小孩。 在见到了负责人Ms.Selve后，她便领我们到他们目前的阅读角落。里面空间不大，只是一个房间的大小。房间里有两个大书厨，一个放了一半的书籍，另一个是完全空置的书厨，所以他们的书籍是非常缺乏的。我们一共准备了12箱的物品，包括书籍、文具、桌游和一些小零食等。然后我们便开始陆续把书本放到架子上，并排列整齐。期间也感谢这些小男孩们帮忙我们一并整理。在布置好后，负责人也带我们参观了该处。她提到：这里的孩子都来自不同的家庭背景，有的来自不健全或单亲家庭，或是被遗弃甚至曾被虐待等。但他们都希望以后能有好的生活，能够独立自律的生活，所以他们也十分重视孩子们的教育。在男生分部，所有的清洁打扫都是由男孩们根据值日表亲手包办。确实，我们亲眼所见那边的环境都很整洁。他们每天都有个作息时间表，其中包括上学，阅读复习、用膳、打扫、运动、种菜及做木工艺品等。Ms.Selve告诉我们由于通货膨胀，蔬菜的价格都一直在提高，所以他们也鼓励孩子们学习自给自足，自己种菜来减低昂贵的食材开销，而孩子们也很喜欢吃自己用心种出来的菜。此外，孩子们有在学习一些木工技巧。他们所制成的成品都是会拿去售卖以补贴他们的日常开销。同时这也让孩子们多了一门手艺。之前也有热心人士捐赠书籍，但无奈捐赠的书籍并不合适小朋友阅读，包括一些法律书籍等非常深奥的专业知识书籍。所以在男生分部也没有合适及足够的书籍让他们阅读。最值得一提的是，Ms.Selve表示整个男生分部的所有壁画都是由男孩们自己绘画的。其中包括每个男生床位旁的墙壁，他们都各自绘上了自己喜欢的事物及座右铭，以时刻激励自己。例如：Aspire to inspire before we expire. Ms.Selve也表示其实还有很多人都请求他们收留更多小孩。目前，在该处的男孩们有足够的活动空间，但却没有更多的宿舍以收留更多的孩子。所以如果有任何热心人士想要帮助他们建设宿舍，都可以联系他们。另外，我们所捐助的图书是在男生分部，但其实The Pure Life Society 的主部还有很多小孩，有28名13至17岁的女生；10位7至12岁的女生；8位7至12岁的男生。在完成阅读角落的布置后，我们也到主部去参观及了解了该处的情况。在那里，我们见到了另一名负责人Ms.Sumathi，而她也给我们讲解了那边的情况。参观后，我们发现主部已有一个相对完善的图书馆，但其中的书籍也不是很适合小朋友阅读，所以我们也计划后续会再捐赠更多合适的书籍给他们。在那里同样也有菜园，而女孩们则是会制作一些纺织品，零钱包，铅笔袋成品等来售卖。Ms.Sumathi也给我们分享了每逢佳节，他们都会简单举办一些活动，让小朋友也可以感受到节日的氛围及学习不同节日的民俗文化，像是农历新年、小朋友还自己准备了舞蹈和舞狮表演。小朋友的舞狮道具还是自己制作的呢！以下给大家总结目前他们需要的帮忙：1. 男生分部不够宿舍，不足以让他们接济更多不幸的孩子2.主部有一栋比较成旧的楼体是需要重建及扩大的。目前正在等待善心人士的资金帮忙。3. 若有二手的舞狮服装，狮头或节令鼓也可捐赠给他们。4. 他们主部有小朋友制作的手工艺品，可到那里去选购支持。若有意提供援助也可直接联系：The Pure Life SocietyBatu 6, Jalan Puchong | 58200 Kuala Lumpur03-77829391 administrator@purelifesociety.org.my后续，我们也会跟进他们的情况。同时，我们也会继续联系其他有需要的孤儿院/福利中心以帮助他们。Sponsored by : OTS Lines Sdn Bhd谢谢您的善心，方能促成本次的捐赠活动。

description: Cycling Tour in Nicosia: Street Art Adventure Saturday, March 15, 2025 9 AM & 6 PM Ready to see Nicosia from a whole new perspective? Join us for an exciting bike tour exploring the city's most stunning street art masterpieces! Discover murals and the stories behind them. Nicosia is an open-air art gallery and street art is a very fragile form of art: many cultural objects are vulnerable to weather conditions, vandalism, and construction work. What you see now may change or disappear in the future! Capture these art objects in your memory and on your cameras while you can! The bike ride is conducted at a relaxed pace and is accessible to people of any fitness level. The only requirement is basic cycling skills. Participation Fee (per person): €16 with your own bike and without return transfer. This includes: street art tour, guidance and organization, first-aid kit, coffee, and halloumi. €39 with bike rental and return transfer. This includes: bike and safety gear, street art tour, guidance and organization, first-aid kit, coffee, halloumi, and return transfer to your home within Nicosia. Payment after the event. Pre-registration is required! description: Field Note, Late Morning - Ridgeview Trail, Appalachians I nearly stepped on it. Amid the leaf litter, it looked like just another fallen bloom—round and dense, tucked tightly like a red-petaled fist resting on the forest floor. Two hikers passed ahead, crunching over bark and twigs, and I crouched, curious. Then it shifted. Two furred stalk-legs unfurled beneath it, slow and deliberate. It lifted itself upright, and for a moment, stood still—listening, maybe. Then the petals began to peel back, layer by layer, until the center emerged: not soft and yellow like a daisy, but something stranger. Ribbed folds of flesh, pollen-streaked ruffles, and in the heart of it all, a glistening gland that pulsed faintly like breath. This was no ordinary bloom. Floravora rubra, sometimes called a "Red Maw Bloom," is thought to be a carnibotanical mimic—part plant, part ambulatory insectivore. Theories suggest the petals release a chemical lure mimicking fungal decay, drawing gnats, midges, and even beetles close enough for the glandular core to snap shut like a sea anemone. It's rare to see one move, and even rarer to witness its full blooming behavior while upright. Some believe the vertical stance increases its dispersal scent radius—others say it’s simply for better line-of-sight. Either way, after a minute of stillness, it folded again, collapsed quietly into itself, and disappeared among the fallen leaves—just a flower once more. . description: #showabuja Exploring the capital city of Nigeria and why people love the City  People love Abuja, Nigeria, for several reasons, part of which are: Beautiful Architecture: The city boasts impressive modern architecture, including the iconic Aso Rock, the Nigerian National Mosque, and the National Christian Centre, which reflect its cultural diversity. Green Spaces: Abuja is known for its parks and recreational areas, such as Jabi Lake Park and Millennium Park, providing residents and visitors with serene environments for relaxation and outdoor activities. Cultural Diversity: As a melting pot of various ethnic groups, Abuja offers a rich cultural experience, with festivals, art exhibitions, and traditional events that celebrate Nigeria's heritage. Vibrant Social Scene: The city has a lively atmosphere with numerous restaurants, bars, and cafes offering local and international cuisine, making it a great place for socializing and dining out. Safety and Cleanliness: Abuja is often regarded as one of the safer and cleaner cities in Nigeria, attracting individuals and families looking for a more secure living environment. Educational Institutions: The city is home to several reputable universities and colleges, making it an educational hub for students from across the country and beyond. Economic Opportunities: As the capital city, Abuja hosts many government offices and international organizations, providing various employment and business opportunities. These attributes contribute to the city's appeal, making it a desirable place to live, work, and visit.

description: Lawrence Malstaf (@lawrencemalstaf) is a Belgian artist and scenographer renowned for his immersive installations that intertwine elements of performance art, technology, and environmental design to explore the dynamic relationship between human bodies and space. His work is characterized by its innovative use of industrial materials and mechanisms to create experiential spaces that provoke deep sensory and emotional reactions from audiences. Malstaf’s installations often simulate natural phenomena and physical experiences—such as being enveloped in a whirlwind, navigating through dense fog, or experiencing the compression of space—thereby inviting participants to reflect on their own perceptions and physicality in unique, controlled environments. Drawing inspiration from the fields of psychology, nature, and technology, Malstaf crafts experiences that blur the lines between the physical and psychological, challenging participants to engage with the fundamental aspects of human existence in modern society. His approach not only showcases his technical ingenuity but also his profound interest in creating art that catalyzes personal introspection and interaction. #art #artist

description: Five years ago, I started documenting the art of my father, Piet Van. Not because he asked me to, but because I felt his work deserved to be seen. He creates without commercial intent, without a big budget, and often in spaces that were found rather than planned. What you see might look grand and polished, but behind the scenes, it’s all about creativity, perseverance, and a love for the craft. He doesn’t create for the wealthy; he creates for anyone who wants to be moved by his work. This is art born out of passion, not profit. description: カフェ接客　英語で？ 店員: Hello! What would you like to order?「こんにちは！ご注文は何にしますか？」 お客さん: Can I have a café latte? 「カフェラテをもらえますか？」 店員: Hot or iced? 「ホットですか？アイスですか？」 お客さん: Hot, please.「ホットでお願いします。」 店員: Sure! What size would you like? 「わかりました！サイズはどうされますか？」 お客さん: Small, please. 「Sサイズでお願いします。」 店員: Small, okay. Got it.「Sサイズですね。わかりました。」 Anything else?「ほかにご注文はございますか？」 お客さん：Actually, can I get soy milk instead? 「それを豆乳で作ってもらえますか？」 店員：Yeah, of course!「はい、もちろん！」 Good choice! That’s how I have it too.「いい選択ですね！僕もそうしてますよ。」 お客さん：Yeah? It’s so good, right?「そうなんですか？美味しいですよね。」 I'll go with that.「それでお願いします。」 店員：Okay, is that all?「わかりました。それで以上ですか？」 お客さん：Yeah, that’s all.「はい、以上です。」 店員：That’ll be 450 yen, please.「お会計450円です。」 お客さん: Here you go.「はい、どうぞ。」 店員：Thank you.「ありがとうございます。」 Here’s your café latte with soy milk.「こちらカフェラテのソイミルク変更です。」 Enjoy!「楽しんでください！」 お客さん：Thanks.「ありがとう。」 Have a good one.「素敵な一日を。」

description: 《在马来西亚，聊聊AI那些被误解的事儿！》   宝子们👋，现在AI真的就像空气一样，不知不觉就「渗」进咱生活里咯😮！早上被智能音箱「叫醒」，它报的天气比阿ma的「预言」还准；上班路上用手机导航，轻松避开KL那些「塞车黑洞」；午休在茶室滑手机，APP推荐的东西比闺蜜还懂我🤩。   但最近总听到有人讲：「AI会抢人做工啦！」「AI冷冰冰，无感情！」「用AI就是忘记传统！」今天咱就从马来西亚人的视角，「开诚布公」聊聊这些「误会」，看看AI在咱这儿到底是啥角色🧐。   👉 误会大啦！AI不是来「抢饭碗」的！ - 打工仔的烦恼：AI会让我们「食风」吗？ 做设计的阿杰之前老抱怨：「老板现在开口闭口讲AI设计，我画三天的图，AI几秒就生成，是不是要失业了？」讲真，一开始我也怕怕的😟！但后来看他用AI「打底」画草图，自己专心想创意，交稿速度更快，还有时间去茶室和我们「吹水」。你看嘛，好多头家（老板）用AI处理数据、写报告，员工反而能腾出时间做「有脑」的事。像茶室老板娘用AI算库存，不用熬夜对账，有更多时间研发新口味拉茶；做电商的表妹用AI分析顾客喜好，进货不怕「压货」。记住啦：AI不是来「抢饭碗」，是来「擦碗」的，让咱们能「腾出手」做更重要的事👏。 - AI有没有「心」？科技也会「讲人情」！ 以前觉得和智能音箱讲话像「对空气讲」，不如和隔壁阿婶聊天过瘾。但现在的AI「进步到吓死人」啦😱！医院里的AI帮医生看片子，还会「贴心」提醒：「病人等下需要家属陪，记得讲话轻声点」；本地公司做的「方言AI」，用福建话讲「阿妹，你今日步数够哦，去公园走走啦」，连目不识丁的三婶都听得懂，笑到合不拢嘴。前几天在巴刹看到卖菜aunty用的AI秤重机，不仅会算钱，还会用马来语讲「Terima kasih」、印度语讲「Dhanyavaad」，每个顾客都笑咪咪。你看，AI不是「冷冰冰」，只是「不懂讲话」，但只要「教」它讲咱们的「话」，它比很多人还「识做」🤗。   👉 从「生活被AI改」到「AI跟生活走」 - 以前的AI：「硬要」改变生活 以前的AI好像「很串」，像智能家居，全屋都是按钮，阿公第一次来我家，按错按钮搞到风扇和电灯「齐齐罢工」，他生气讲：「还是用回葵扇爽！」还有那些推荐APP，我就搜过一次「榴梿壳煲汤」，手机整天「弹」榴梿广告，烦到想摔手机😡。 - 现在的AI：「学乖」了，跟生活「妥协」 现在的AI「聪明很多」啦！像马来西亚的「MySejahtera」升级了AI功能，用语音讲马来语、华语、淡米尔语，老人家不用看字都懂怎么操作；电商平台的AI，看你逛很久没买，会弹个「休息一下，喝杯茶先啦」的提示，贴心到像你妈。最厉害的是本地创业公司做的「茶室AI」——你在APP点咖啡，AI会记得你「要少糖，多奶，走冰」，还会提醒你：「上次你讲茶太浓，这次帮你调淡5%啦！」这种「懂你」的AI，才是咱们要的嘛🥰。   👉 AI的「温柔」：原来科技的「终点」是人 在槟城老社区，有群「AI导师」——退休工程师教老人家玩「AI语音助手」，中学生帮小档口老板set智能收款机。看到新闻里一位拿督夫人用AI修复了已故丈夫的旧照片，她摸着屏幕轻声说：「好像又看到他穿西装去开股东大会的样子」，讲到眼湿湿。这一刻，AI不是「机器」，是「时光机」，是「传情筒」。在咱马来西亚，AI可以是这样的：   - 巴刹卖鱼的uncle用AI算「今日鱼价」，不用再怕被「坑钱」； - 妈妈用AI查「小孩过敏食谱」，不用半夜爬起来翻书； - 创业者用AI「自动回覆客户信息」，半夜可以陪孩子做功课； - 甚至庙里的「AI签诗」，都用福建话讲签文，比真人师父还「够力」！ AI的「代码」里，写的其实是咱们「想要更好生活」的愿望。它不是要「改变」咱们的生活，是要帮咱们「省时间」去做更重要的事——比如多陪阿公阿嬷讲讲话，多去海边看日落，多和朋友去吃沙嗲配啤酒。   🎈结语：和AI「做朋友」的智慧 讲了这么多，其实就想讲：AI不是「敌人」，也不是「神明」，它是「工具」，也是「伙伴」。就像以前电话、电视、手机，刚开始大家都怕，但现在谁离得开？关键是咱们怎么「用」它——用得好，它是「助手」；用不好，它才会变成「麻烦」。在咱马来西亚这个「多元」地方，AI应该像「Rojak」一样，混合各民族需要：华人要「够贴地」，马来人要「够简单」，印度人要「够实用」，老人家要「够亲切」，年轻人要「够潮」。只要AI「学懂」咱们的「生活方式」，它就会变成咱们的「好搭档」。最后讲句实在话：AI会不会「统治世界」我不知道，但我知道，只要咱们「做主」，让AI「听咱们的话」，它一定会帮咱们把生活过得「更爽、更轻松、更有人情味」！走啦，打开手机，试试用AI查「附近最好吃的椰浆饭」，说不定它会带你发现「隐藏版」美食哦😉。宝子们觉得有意思，点赞关注走一波呀🥰！   #椰浆饭 #AI #马来西亚 #AI的误解 #AI生活 #科技 #人情 #马来西亚文化 #AI应用 #AI发展 #科技改变生活 #人工智能 #生活中的AI #数字人 #跨境电商 #直播

description: Not enough people talk about this place in Seoul! If you’re looking for a peaceful afternoon exploring art, nature, and looking to take some aesthetic photos, you need to check out Mapo Oil Tank Culture Park! It’s a park and cultural complex that you may have spotted in several Kdramas or Kpop contents, and was previously an oil depot. You can easily spend a couple hours exploring the 6 oil reservoir tanks that have been transformed into performance venues, exhibition halls and learning spaces. Their current exhibitions is one called “ The Cloud Spotter’s Guide” and another that features beautiful Lego art pieces from various artists. They also hold cultural events and community activities as well~ I had so much fun walking around appreciating the greenery and art, it was truly an afternoon well spent! 📍Mapo Oil Tank Culture Park / 마포 문화비축기지 87 Jeungsan-do, Mapo-gu, Seoul/ 서울 마포구 증산로 87  Hours: 10AM - 6PM Admission: Free! #korea #seoul #koreatravel #seoultravel #hiddengem #art #culture #exhibition #seoulexhibition #seoulart #mustgo #seoulkorea #seoultrip #koreatrip #reccomended

description: Tainan art museum The establishment of an art museum is not only a landmark in a city and country's cultural evolution, but can also provide the backbone for further urban development. For great cultural cities, the establishment of art museums often accelerates the vigorous development of local art, and the resulting artistic atmosphere further pushes the city forward. The impact of such art museums on driving progress in quality of life, tourism, and industry cannot be underestimated. After the merger of Tainan City and Tainan County in 2010 and the elevation of their union to special municipality status, the newly formed Tainan City began work on a project to systematically bring together and organize its wealth of cultural resources and talents. To that end, the city government announced a plan to establish a museum of fine arts, a place for local arts and for educational opportunities for young and old alike. After seven years of work, the Tainan Art Museum formally opened its doors in 2019. #tainan #review #fyp

description: 在咖啡店的角落里 将《苏珊·桑塔格访谈录》看完 看知识分子界的摇滚女星，谈论自己的心智生命。在咖啡店的角落里 将《苏珊·桑塔格访谈录》阅读中 看知识分子界的摇滚女星，谈论自己的心智生命。 在看这本书之前，我没有读过苏珊的作品，甚至都不道她本人。 但是，拥有独立意识的女性，真的闪闪发光，被她的自立、智慧、坚强的特质吸引。 谈到阅读。 她说，她的阅读量很大，但大多数都没有怎么用心去读，都先囫囵吞枣，再择期消化。这一点，让读书很快不求甚解的我释然不已 谈到女性。 她说，女性气质是一个贬义词，意味软弱。但是更重要的不是去创造或维护女性价值，平起平坐就足够。要平静地去爱，毫不含糊地去信任， 毫无自嘲地去希望，勇敢地行动。 要平静地去爱，毫不含糊地去信任， 毫无自嘲地去希望，勇敢地行动。 “将自己出借给他人，但将自己交付给自己。”

description: Come with me to ArtHop! ArtHop is a monthly event that takes place in Downtown Fresno and the Tower District on the first Thursday of every month. ArtHop showcases the vibrant arts and culture scene in the valley by providing a platform for local artists and makers to display their work in various venues throughout the downtown area! It's a wonderful way to network with other creatives, be introduced to new art, and experience the local downtown culture. I'm lucky to call the @mstreetartscomplex in Downtown home to my studio so that every month I can open my door to showcase my work and meet lots of new people. Our building is home to lots of talented artists of all mediums including my friends @johnwalkerphotos (photojournalist and Fresno Bee photographer) and @erik_niemann_abstracts (architect and abstract painter). And of course we ended the night with food from one of our favorite downtown restaurants La Jacka Come join us for the next Art Hop on May 2nd at 1419 M Street!

description: 🌇 Discover the Beauty of Leipzig! 🏰 Leipzig, the vibrant city in eastern Germany, is a hidden gem waiting to be explored! 🇩🇪 With its rich history, stunning architecture, and vibrant cultural scene, Leipzig offers a plethora of experiences for every visitor. Here are a few highlights: 1️⃣ Historical Charm: Immerse yourself in the city's past as you stroll through the charming streets of Leipzig's Old Town. Marvel at the magnificent Renaissance-style Old City Hall and the iconic St. Thomas Church, where Johann Sebastian Bach once served as a choir director. 2️⃣ Music Capital: Leipzig has a strong musical heritage, and it is best known as the city where Bach composed some of his greatest works. Don't miss the opportunity to attend a concert at the Gewandhaus, one of the world's most renowned concert halls, or visit the Bach Museum to delve deeper into the life and work of the musical genius. 3️⃣ Cultural Hub: Leipzig's cultural scene is thriving! Explore the Spinnerei, a former cotton mill turned into an art complex, where you can admire contemporary artworks from local and international artists. Additionally, the Leipzig Opera and Leipzig Ballet offer world-class performances that will captivate your senses. 4️⃣ Parks and Gardens: Take a break from the bustling city and enjoy the tranquility of Leipzig's green spaces. The Leipzig Botanical Garden, with its diverse collection of plants, is a must-visit for nature lovers. Don't forget to also explore Clara-Zetkin-Park, a beautiful park along the Elsterflutbecken, perfect for picnics and leisurely walks. 5️⃣ Vibrant Nightlife: Leipzig comes alive after dark! The city boasts a thriving nightlife scene, offering a range of bars, clubs, and live music venues. From trendy cocktail bars to underground clubs, there's something for everyone to enjoy and dance the night away. Leipzig is a city that seamlessly combines history, culture, and modernity, making it a destination that will leave you with lifelong memories. Come and experience the magic of Leipzig for yourself! ✨🎶 #Leipzig #Germany #Travel #Culture #Music #Art #History

description: Kids on Bicycle, Penang Street Art Series  One of the most recognizable pieces of street art on the Island, "Kids on Bicycle" depicts two children painted upon the wall, seemingly riding a bicycle that is placed and propped up against the wall. The piece, originally commissioned by the Penang Municipal Council, was created by Lithuanian artist Ernest Zacharevic.  He purportedly created the piece to represent and capture the visuals of the laidback nature of the street. However, as of an article from 2019, he has [1] lamented about the street has been rapidly commercialized into a tourist trap, and that the street is no longer what it once used to be.  As of 2024 and at time of posting, the mural exists in states wear and decay. [1] Source: https://says.com/my/news/artist-who-made-famous-kids-on-bicycle-mural-in-penang-regrets-its-existence The mural can be found at the intersection of the tail end of Armenian Street crossing into Beach Street. It is a popular location amongst travellers and the street is lined with many attractions, shops, pubs as well as vendors selling merchandise and souvenirs. The exact location can be found at https://maps.app.goo.gl/8RUhErc9CuKgwiYA9 on Google Maps. description: Délices: Alexandria’s Iconic Pastry Shop Since 1922 محل الحلويات الأشهر في الإسكندرية منذ 1922 If you’re in Alexandria and looking for a place with history, charm, and mouthwatering desserts, Délices is a must-visit! This legendary pastry shop has been serving delicious treats for over a century, attracting locals, tourists, and even royalty. Here’s why it’s so special: Why You Should Visit Délices: 	 •	A Legacy Since 1922 – Originally opened in 1900 by a Greek, but officially named in 1922 after a French lady called the pastries “a marvel of delights.” 	•	A Sweet Paradise – Famous for pastries, chocolates, ice cream, and traditional sweets like mille-feuille, profiteroles, and cassata. 	•	Royal & Elite Clients – Délices made King Farouk’s wedding cake and hosted receptions for Egyptian presidents and Alexandrian high society. 	•	A Timeless Experience – Whether sitting outside watching the city or enjoying the elegant indoor setting, Délices brings old Alexandria to life. 	•	Seasonal Treats – From Christmas Bûche de Noël to Easter chocolates, their sweets have been made the same way for decades. 	•	Still Family-Run – The founder’s grandson continues the tradition while adding a modern touch. 	•	A Must-Visit in Alexandria! – Don’t leave without trying their famous mango syrup, chocolate dates, or traditional Ramadan sweets. 📍 Located in the heart of Alexandria, right on the Corniche! 👉 Follow for more hidden gems and food spots! إذا كنت في الإسكندرية وتبحث عن مكان يجمع بين التاريخ والطعم اللذيذ، Délices هو وجهتك المثالية! هذا المحل العريق يُقدّم الحلويات منذ أكثر من قرن، وجذب إليه السكّان المحليين والسياح وحتى العائلات الملكية. إليك لماذا يجب أن تزوره: لماذا يجب أن تزور Délices؟ 	•	تاريخ طويل من 1922 – تأسس على يد يوناني سنة 1900، لكنه حصل على اسمه رسميًا في 1922 عندما وصفت سيدة فرنسية حلوياته بأنها “أعجوبة من اللذة.” 	•	جنة الحلويات – يشتهر بـالمخبوزات، الشوكولاتة، الآيس كريم، والحلويات التقليدية مثل الميل فوي، البروفيتيرول، والكساتا. 	•	زبائن ملكيون ومشاهير – صنع Délices كعكة زفاف الملك فاروق واستضاف حفلات عائلات رئاسية وأرستقراطية. 	•	تجربة أصيلة – سواء جلست بالخارج لمشاهدة المدينة أو داخل المحل الفاخر، ستشعر بجو الإسكندرية القديمة. 	•	حلويات لكل المناسبات – من بوش دو نويل في الكريسماس إلى شوكولاتة العيد والفصح، تُحضر الحلويات بنفس الطريقة منذ عقود. 	•	عائلة تدير المكان حتى اليوم – حفيد المؤسس لا يزال يحافظ على الوصفات الأصلية مع لمسات عصرية. 	•	لا تفوّت زيارته! – جرّب شراب المانجو الشهير، التمر المغطى بالشوكولاتة، أو حلويات رمضان التقليدية. 📍 يقع في قلب الإسكندرية، على الكورنيش! 👉 تابعونا للمزيد من الأماكن السرية وأفضل المطاعم! #egypt #alexandria #مصر #الاسكندرية

description: On behalf of A Day In Your Life and the Your Local Artists projects, I want to extend my sincerest gratitude for your presence and support at the launch event last Thursday. I'd like to especially thank our partners The Earls Court Development Company and  Young K&C Foundation; your contribution has been invaluable in making this initiative a reality. I'd also like to thank K&C Foundation and the Rockspring Charitable Trust. Your generosity has enabled us to provide opportunities for young people to explore their artistic passions and develop their skills through workshops and exhibitions. From March 2024 until March 2025, Earls Court will be adorned with a captivating art programme, showcasing the remarkable talents of young artists from our community. The 3.1m tall artwork features monochrome portraits, taken by young people from the Earls Court Youth Club. Previously displayed in the Young Artists exhibition at the Saatchi Gallery, as part of our annual programme to celebrate creative talent from under-represented backgrounds in West London, this installation represents another chance to see works created by young, budding artists in the community. Together, we are fostering a culture of creativity and empowerment within our community. Once again, thank you for your unwavering support. Your commitment to nurturing local talent is truly commendable, and we look forward to continuing this journey together.  For more info on this project please go to: www.dayinyourlife.co.uk #younglocalartists #alisonjackson #earlscourt #adayinyourlife #fyp

description: Explore all free things to do in Vienna below👇🏻 ÖAW Festsaal The ceremonial hall of the Austrian Academy of Sciences (ÖAW) is an architectural gem, that is free to visit for everyone. Special Exhibition at Garden Palace Liechtenstein The Liechtenstein Garden Palace offers free admission to its annual special exhibition; in 2025, the exhibition “A Marvellous Science. Passion for Porcelain in Baroque Vienna” runs from January 30 to March 30. Melkerhof A hidden courtyard in the 8th district, featuring traditional Viennese architecture and a tranquil atmosphere, perfect for a quiet break. Justice Palace (Justizpalast) A grand neo-Renaissance building housing Austria’s Supreme Court, with a publicly accessible hall and a rooftop café offering stunning city views. Hirschstetten Botanical Gardens A free botanical garden with themed sections, a palm house, and seasonal floral displays, ideal for nature lovers. Military History Museum & Hermesvilla (free on the first Sunday of the month) Vienna’s Military History Museum showcases Austria’s military past, while Hermesvilla, a former imperial retreat, offers insight into Empress Elisabeth’s life. Both are free to visit on the first Sunday of each month. Setagayapark A serene Japanese garden in Vienna’s 19th district, featuring koi ponds, cherry blossoms, and traditional landscaping, perfect for a peaceful stroll. description: If you are visiting Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia, then make sure to add this place to your list of places to visit!  📍Thean Hou Temple | 乐圣岭天后宫/樂聖嶺天后宮 Also known as the Temple of the Goddess of Heaven, the temple is dedicated to the goddess Tian Hou (also known as Mazu) who protects fishermen and those at sea.  It’s one of the largest and oldest Buddhist temples in South East Asia, opened to the public in 1989.  I visited during the Chinese New Year and it was such an amazing experience!  Things to know before you visit:  • Location: It’s roughly 15-20 minutes away from the main city, and not the easiest to reach, so best way to visit is taking a Grab / taxi there  • Entrance Fee: It’s completely free to visit • Opening hours: 8am - 10pm daily  • Dress code: there is no strict dress code, but just remember that you are visiting a religious place so please dress appropriately  👉🏼 SAVE this reel for your next trip to Kuala Lumpur 🇲🇾 #visitkualalumpur #visitmalaysia #lovemalaysia

description: Treat instagram like a library, it’s free, it’s public & it’s available to literally everyone. People only go to the library for two reasons. 1) they want to study and learn 2) they want to be entertained with a story People don’t go to the library to read business classified or your local “yellow pages” they want substance & value. So before you approach your content strategy like a thirsty & vicious salesman, slamming people with how ‘amazing’ your product is or ‘how much your service transformed someones life’ hit PAUSE. Notice how people never go viral for this stuff? It’s because people hate being pitched, no matter how great you think you are at hiding it. Literally be an author, give it away for free - then maybe & only MAYBE. Will they read your book, and if it’s actually good. They will tell others about you. #branding #brand #brandidentity #branddesign #marketing

description: 一不小心闯进了哈利波特的魔法世界--位于四川省都江堰钟书阁，原本是一个书店，是一个读书人看书的地方，因为设计师独具匠心的灵感，使钟书阁成为都江堰乃至全国人气最火爆的书店，被网友称之为“最美书店”。 走进钟书阁，迎面而来的是一片书的海洋，环顾四周前后左右上下高低全都是书，仿佛走进了奇幻的世界，高大的书架和镜面墙壁的设计，体现出设计师的超群想像力，走进书店的刹那我的内心无比的震撼，在钟书阁，我所看到的不仅仅是一家书店，而是一座有二千多年积淀的古城文化，是都江堰福泽千年的文化传承。 据说，钟书阁是一位美女设计师设计的，她的设计理念是，“钟书阁不是爱书人的书店，而是让不爱书的人爱上书的地方”。#dujiangyan #chengdu #旅行 #travel #旅行推荐 #旅行vlog #bookstore #travelchina

description: 芒果冰 寶藏店🍧 @mzcoffee.hcm  來越南這麼多年，芒果一直是我很喜歡的水果。 這間位在於守德的咖啡廳，位置雖然不在鬧區，但也不遠，聽說越來越多台灣人住這。 MZ Coffee 是韓國人開的咖啡廳，店員也會講一點中文☺️ 氣房整體很有質感，設計也很俐落。 🥭 芒果使用的是越南同塔省生產的芒果， 果肉是金黃色的，比較沒有纖維感， 而且香氣濃郁，吃起來很甜香。 🍧 牛奶雪花冰吃起來也很綿密，沒有剉冰的冰晶感。 店家對品質還滿要求的，芒果切開後，店員會先試吃，確定是甜的，才會提供給客人。 💸 一份 25 萬，不算便宜，但是品質跟環境值得這個價位。 我在那休息了 2 個多小時，來的幾乎都是韓國人～ ☕ 椰奶咖啡也很推薦， 椰奶香味十足，是水準以上的飲料。 🥑 我還有看到上面有酪梨咖啡， 下次來我還要試試看！ 📍Block A Sadora Apartment, An Lợi Đông, Thủ Đức ☎️+84 901 967 276 #saigon #vietnam #vietnamtravel #saigonlife #胡志明市 #越南 #越南美食 #越南旅遊 #c克里斯在越南

description: HIKE LOCATION DETAILS BELOW ⬇️ 📌 SAVE THIS POST for Ontario summer travel inspo  The Niagara Glen Hiking Trail is located deep in the Niagara Gorge in Niagara Falls Ontario. Stairways lead to 4km of rugged hiking paths that wind through this pristine pocket of Carolinian Forest, past prehistoric geological formations, and along the Niagara River, which has beautiful turquoise waters. They have also recently launched the “Rekindling All Our Relations” Audio Tour, an Indigenous Audio Tour of the Niagara Glen. Free for the public, “Rekindling All Our Relations” is a unique self-guided hiking experience merging nature, culture, and storytelling into a profound exploration of Indigenous wisdom and connection. Curated by Michele-Elise Burnett, a respected member of Niagara’s Indigenous community, she shares her deep roots and understanding of Indigenous teachings through a carefully crafted experience that goes beyond the physical beauty of the Niagara Glen, delving into its spiritual essence.  TIPS BEFORE YOU GO: ✨ Visit the Niagara Glen Nature Centre to receive a handheld audio device or download Rekindling All Our Relations in advance to play the podcast from your smartphone.  ✨ This hike is free, but if you drive just pay for parking. ✨ The hike is approximately 1.5 hours in order to fully explore all the trails. ✨ Be sure to stay along the marked path, we highly recommend using a map, available in the Niagara Glen Nature Centre, to ensure you don’t miss any of the trail highlights.  ✨ Don’t forget to check out all the other amazing hikes and outdoor activities offered by Niagara Parks while you’re in Niagara Falls.  ✨Always remember to leave no trace ❤️♻️🌎 Have any questions about this hidden gem hike? description: The National Museum of Anthropology (3 of 3) was the last museum I visited within the complex. For me, it was part modern art and history? My favourite exhibitions were Bangsamoro Art and Philippine Textiles. There was an exhibition on Baybayin and it would not surprise anyone that UP was again bibida-bida because the “Sablay” was part of it. 🤭  As finis, I was glad to see loads of people in all the museums I visited. I realised that there must be a museum-going culture - that cuts across generations, gender etc. - we have yet to recognise. The fact that it was free to enter these museums might have largely contributed to that. I got me thinking about public spaces in the country and where there’s a lack of public spaces that do not require money to have access to them, or at least there’s no expectation that you should be spending any money at all whilst inside these spaces. #tiktokph #phtiktok #tiktokphilippines #nationalmuseumofanthropology #manila #philippines #museummoment

description: I apologize for not considering the inconvenience caused by peering into the quarrels of the life you’ve become so comfortable with. But I just keep going upon this path of fleeting youth where the end of the road seems much like the beginning. Lately I have an ache or an itch to do all that of which you deem unnecessary and I say you never had the strength to anyway. Maybe if I live longer I’ll see you marginalize the walls of my consciousness into smaller devices cause you couldn’t handle my vices. Control the weather than predict the forecast of my despair, I don’t think there was ever room for me at your table. But I hate your table and the chairs squeak when I try and dismiss myself interrupting your continuing growth in a world meant for you. Where you bleed and my red liquid stains my brother’s shirt. And my sister pain is a story and lesson for yours. I never liked it here anyway so why would I stay any longer than I need to.  #poem

description: ゴッホ『星月夜』 Vincent Willem van Gogh　『The starry night』 星月夜は、オランダの画家・ゴッホの代表作のひとつ。1889年6月、フランスサン＝レミ＝ド＝プロヴァンスのサン＝ポール・ド・モゾル修道院の精神病院で療養中に描かれた。 アルピーユの山並みの上に輝く星々と三日月に、S字状にうねる雲を描いた『星月夜』を制作した。 「夜のカフェテラス」「糸杉と星の見える道」など、ゴッホは夜と星を多く描いた。 「死によって星へと到達する」「星降るような空を創造したい」と自ら語っているように、ゴッホにとって「星」は重要な意味をもっていた。 ゴッホは糸杉も多く描いたが、地上と天を繋ぐ糸杉は、天国や死を連想させる。 療養中の精神病院の窓から見える風景そのままではなく、描かれている教会はゴッホの故郷オランダの教会であるように、ゴッホの心の中の風景となっている。 彼は、この時期の『オリーブ畑』、『星月夜』、『キヅタ』などの作品について、「実物そっくりに見せかける正確さでなく、もっと自由な自発的デッサンによって田舎の自然の純粋な姿を表出しようとする仕事だ。」と述べている。 心を病んだゴッホが精神病院の窓からみえる夜明け前の星空を描いた傑作である。 絵画の題名	星月夜 絵画の作者	フィンセント・ファン・ゴッホ（オランダ） 美術様式	ポスト印象主義 絵画の制作年	1889年 絵画の画材	油彩、カンヴァス 絵画の寸法	73.7 cm × 92.1 cm  絵画の所蔵	ニューヨーク近代美術館（アメリカ、ニューヨーク） #Gogh #ゴッホ #starrynight #星月夜 #ポスト印象主義 #ニューヨーク近代美術館 #アートの世界 #絵画のある暮らし  #絵画 #アート

description: The Metropolitan Museum of Manila in BGC, a vibrant hub of contemporary art and culture in the heart of the Philippines! I was blown away by the incredible thought-provoking exhibits on display, each one a unique exploration of the art scene in Manila from both local and international artists. There are currently three active art exhibits at the MET Museum Manila BGC: Ronald Ventura's "Quick Turn on Hyper Highways" exhibit was an absolute delight for fans of dynamic and unconventional art. Ventura's fusion of realism, cartoons, and graffiti resulted in a stunning portrayal of chaotic disarray inspired by science fiction, Western history, Asian mythology, Catholicism, and popular comic book characters. Jefrë's "Points of Origin" exhibit was equally fascinating, featuring a series of thought-provoking works that explored the artist's Filipino-American heritage. The pieces were a beautiful blend of culture, identity, and contemporary art, showcasing Jefrë's incredible talent and artistic vision. Finally, "Sounds of Blackness" was a powerful group exhibition featuring an ensemble of visual artists from the African Diaspora, many of whom were exhibiting in the Philippines for the first time. The exhibition was curated by Larry Ossei-Mensah and anchored by a selection of works from the collection of Filipino collector Timothy Tan. The exhibition showcased a diverse range of works that evoked expressions of joy, pain, beauty, and the complexities of Black life around the globe, across various mediums. Whether you're a fan of contemporary art, culture, or simply looking for a unique and inspiring experience, the MET Museum of Manila BGC is the perfect destination. description: The 8-meter-tall kinetic steel sculpture, "Ali and Nino" or alternatively known as "Man and Woman", graces the city of Batumi, Georgia 🇬🇪 The impressive statue was put in place in 2010. Its creator, @TamaraKvesitadze, drew inspiration from the critically acclaimed novel "Ali and Nino" by Kurban Said, penned in 1937. The narrative of the novel revolves around the romantic saga of Ali Shervanshir, a Muslim Azerbaijani man, and Nino Kipiani, a Christian Georgian woman. Their love story reaches a tragic end when Ali loses his life in a battle against the Russian Army, fighting for his homeland between 1918-1920. The captivating statues of the two lovers move gradually towards each other, share a fleeting embrace, only to be separated once more. This moving sequence lasts for 10 minutes. Video by @dj_roger  #art #sculpture

description: Ho Chi Minh City has given me a lot - opportunities, experiences, friendships, and countless moments that have shaped who I am. This city never sleeps, never stops moving, and never fails to inspire. Flying my drone over this vibrant metropolis has allowed me to see Saigon from a perspective that many don’t get to experience. The golden hues of sunrise reflecting off Bitexco, the endless stream of motorbikes weaving through Nguyễn Huệ Walking Street, the quiet beauty of the Saigon River at dusk - each frame in this compilation is a love letter to the city that has given me so much. This isn’t just a skyline; it’s a symbol of resilience and energy. It’s a city where traditions blend seamlessly with modernity, where every alley has a hidden gem waiting to be discovered. I hope these aerial views capture even a fraction of the magic that Saigon holds. description: 📖Hanako最新号 『あの喫茶店に帰りたい。』 4月28日発売！☕️ 何度も通って、ふと帰りたくなる—— そんな“マイ喫茶”を見つけに行きませんか？ 今号では、新世代の店主たち、魅力的な喫茶メニュー、建築の美しさなど、さまざまな角度から「喫茶店とは何か」を特集。 昔ながらの名店から注目の新店まで、一挙にご紹介！ ✍️特集トピックス ・新世代喫茶店からひもとく、今の喫茶文化 ・名作フードに隠された物語 ・#増田俊樹 さん、#中沢元紀 さんと喫茶店の関係 ・建築好き必見の喫茶店案内　…などなど！ 📌Hanako（ハナコ） 1988年創刊。食と旅、そして暮らしのヒントをお届けするライフスタイル誌。 雑誌、Web、SNSで最新情報を発信中。フォローお待ちしています！ #Hanako #喫茶店 #カフェ巡り #レトロ喫茶 #雑誌 #日本の喫茶文化 #純喫茶 📖 日本人氣雜誌《Hanako》最新一期來了！ 主題是——《我想回到那間喫茶店。》☕️ 4/28 發售！ 一探讓人一去再去的喫茶魅力，從新一代店主、經典菜單到復古建築。 從老靈魂到新風格，你的「命定喫茶」會是哪一間？ 👀 本期亮點： ✨新世代喫茶店特輯 ✨經典喫茶美食的秘密 ✨#增田俊樹 & #中澤元紀 對喫茶的愛 ✨復古建築迷會愛的咖啡店導覽 📌《Hanako》——1988年創刊的日本生活雜誌， 分享美食、旅遊與生活靈感。 歡迎追蹤我們，一起找回屬於你的喫茶時光！ #喫茶店 #日本雜誌 #Hanako #日系生活 #咖啡迷必看 #復古咖啡館

description: 1.	Choose Your Surface The paint typically used for this technique is acrylic. You can work on either a canvas or regular sketch paper or cardboard. However, I recommend starting with paper first and then moving on to canvas once you’re comfortable. 	2.	Prepare the Branches Before using the tree branches, trim them to create a relatively flat surface. This will help reduce the chances of unwanted paint smudging when the branch comes into contact with the canvas. 	3.	Apply Paint to the Branches Be careful not to overload the branches with paint. Instead of dipping the branch directly into the paint, use a brush to apply paint onto the branch. This will give you better control over the amount of paint and the effect it creates. 	4.	Paint on the Canvas When applying the paint, make sure to leave some empty spaces on the canvas or paper. Avoid covering the entire surface with paint, as the empty spaces can add to the overall aesthetic of your artwork. 	5.	Final Tips and Feedback Best of luck with your painting! Feel free to send me your attempts via DM. description: 已售出🅢🅞🅛🅓 《廣澤尊王》 Worship of Guangze Zunwang  (𝟚𝟘𝟚𝟛) 𝟞𝟘𝕔𝕞*𝟠𝟘𝕔𝕞 𝔸𝕔𝕣𝕪𝕝𝕚𝕔 𝕠𝕟 𝕔𝕒𝕟𝕧𝕒𝕤  ⋯⋯⋯⋯⋯⋯⋯⋯⋯⋯⋯⋯⋯⋯⋯⋯⋯⋯ 西羅殿位於臺南南勢街，主祀廣澤尊王。創建於康熙57年（西元1718年），舊名為鳳山寺，於日治時期改稱為西羅殿至今。 奉祀的主神是保安廣澤尊王，是由福建泉州的郭姓宗族，祀奉他們的祖佛郭聖王與部將陳欽差與黃太尉；後來郭家祖先遷渡來臺落腳，當時奉祀的規模不大，只有一座小館，姓郭的宗族才能進去參拜；後來因神蹟顯赫，蓋廟後一般民眾也可前來拜拜，祈求平安、保佑。 Guangze zunwang originated from Quanzhou (泉州), Fujian province (福建). He is the patron god of Quanzhou. Most of Guangze zunwang’s images are painted or carved in a children or a youth face. It is in relation with his story. In Taiwan, early temples dedicated to Guangze zunwang were established by the people from Quanzhou. It is estimated about seventy. Most of them are located at Tainan. Taizhong and Pingdong are in the second and third place. ⚘⋯⋯⚘⋯⋯⚘⋯⋯⚘⋯⋯⚘⋯⋯⚘⋯⋯⚘⋯⋯⚘⋯⋯⚘⋯⋯⚘⋯⋯⚘⋯⋯ 資料來源/完整詳細內容請前往ℹ️中華民國內政部 &Home Run Taiwan 查詢 #ペインティング #畫畫 #繪畫 #painting #페인트등 #tablo #maleri #pentrado #수채화 #cuadro #لوحة #จิตรกรรม #malen #måln

description: 家人们‼️谁懂啊❓ 我又挖到一间超好逛的本地家居城～ 一进门就被整个空间感+家具质感美到呆住了 这次让我彻底心动的，可是他们的家居可是集结了质感、实用、高级感实用派的天花板组合 本只是想随便坐坐，结果…一躺上去直接开启懒人模式 按个按钮就能调角度，腿部支撑、头靠全部贴合到位！ 重点是连外观都走极简奶油风，不像传统笨重电动椅～完全颜值在线！ 尤其他们这里沙发可都是用上FibreGuard黑科技的布料不仅防（字幕用F来代替防）污、防🦠、防Y味， 颜色还比市面上多出至少1️⃣倍的色卡选项呢 床褥区 ✨也有不同材质的软硬度支撑感可以让你亲身体验 这边真的很贴心～不管是衣柜还是电视屏风都可依空间大小/风格客制设计化哦 大理石纹的餐桌和吧台，还真的会一秒把你家餐厅变成ins风9️⃣馆 我已经脑补晚上小酌、朋友来家里打卡的画面了 还发现了个多功能屏风橱，即又能当开放式收纳柜，双面设计还能帮你制造空间层次感！ 重点是❗️价位也不会贵比我想象中还要友善好多呢 📍THE WHITE FURNISHING 🕐早上10点半～晚上8点半 #jbfurniture #新山家具 #jb家具店 #新山探店 #新山探店博主 #平价家具 #宝藏家具店

description: Field Notes – Entry #211 Location: Bankside ledge of the Grand Canal, just past the old fisherman’s steps Species: Heliambulans orientalis I first saw it as it stepped into view from the left, emerging from behind a rust-stained mooring bolt. Even at a glance, there was no mistaking it for something ordinary—its legs were unmistakably articulated, pale and claw-tipped like a wading bird’s, but emerging from beneath a dense crown of unopened bracts. It halted near the water’s edge, then stood motionless. From within the husk, the blossom unfolded—not upward, but outward, with controlled symmetry. The transformation was striking: yellow petals emerged in tiers, revealing the dense, patterned disk at its center. The newly bloomed form stood balanced atop four sturdy stalks, radiating heat and stillness in equal measure. It did not sway. It simply watched. Its center—glistening faintly like polished wood grain—seemed to respond to the shifting clouds above, angling subtly as the light shifted. Some kind of heliotropic instinct, perhaps, though no mechanism was visible. The man fishing nearby never noticed it. Or perhaps he did and said nothing. Known among canal farmers as Heliambulans orientalis, the “walking sunflower,” its appearance is considered a sign of early harvest. One elder told me: “If it opens near you, plant deep and early. The soil is listening.” . description: 白沙屯拱天宮原名「白沙墩」 因東北季風帶來的雪白沙丘而得名 清乾隆年間先民移民來台拓墾 為求平安奉請一尊媽祖供奉於民宅 咸豐晚年居民因媽祖長年輪值奉祀於爐主家 遂集資建廟，於1863年（同治二年）完成土埆厝廟宇 白沙屯媽祖承載超過170年的地方信仰與文化記憶 特別是神像的可動四肢與年度新妝儀式 體現了地方對傳統習俗的保存與尊重 最盛大的活動，就是白沙屯媽祖徒步北港進香 這項傳統從當地年輕人的成年禮 發展為全台信眾共襄盛舉的宗教文化盛事 如今已被列入台灣宗教文化資產 🔺文章內容資料來源於 國家文化資產網&臺灣宗教文化地圖 🔺特別感謝 進香素材由星旺教官提供 結緣素材由婷玫提供 Baishatun Gongtian Temple, once called “Baishadun,” is named after the white sand dunes shaped by the northeast winds. Back in the 18th century, local settlers placed a Mazu statue in their homes for protection. By 1863, the community came together to build the temple that still stands today. For over 170 years, the Baishatun Mazu has been part of local life. The unique movable-limb statue is carefully dressed each year before the annual pilgrimage. The biggest event is the Baishatun Mazu walk to Beigang — once a coming-of-age tradition for local youth, now a beloved cultural festival recognized across Taiwan as an important part of its heritage. #白沙屯媽祖 #art #painting #drawing #artwork #彩繪 #faith #信仰 #god #神明 #神 #malen #畫畫 #taiwan #culture #templeart #mazu #heritage #tradition

description: A mysterious museum is in this church ⤵️ This is the church of the Sacro Cuore del Suffragio. In Rome we call it “the little Duomo of Milan”, because we don’t have churches like this here, so it makes us think of Milan straight away 😊 This is not a gothic church, but a Neo-gothic one. What does that mean? To make it simple: the gothic style belonged to the Middle Ages, gothic churches are ancient. Neo-gothic is the style of “newer” buildings made in the 1800s/1900s that took inspiration from the gothic buildings. Anyways, there is an incredible gem inside this church: the Museum of the Souls of the Purgatory It is a tiny little room with a collection of visible evidence that the souls of the Purgatory left while establishing	a communication with the living people.  The Purgatory is where the souls are transitioning before they get to Paradise. In the Purgatory the souls wash away their sins. And the evidence in this museum tell us about these souls that got in contact with the living people and asked them for prayers, masses and good actions to help them atone for the sins they committed on earth. While establishing contact some of these souls left a sign, most of the times are fire handprint on books, clothes, walls.. And these signs are collected in this little museum, including the stories of each evidence. How impressive! Have you ever seen this church in Rome? Have you ever heard of these signs?  ➡️ Want to discover more Rome hidden gems with us? ⤵️Go to the link in our bio and we’ll tell you how 😊 #rome #hiddengems #rometours #rometravel #romeplaces #rometips #thingstodo #thingstodoinrome #thingstoseeinrome #romeguide

description: Craving an escape into a landscape that feels almost otherworldly? In the heart of Transylvania, there’s a hidden haven where nature’s splendor is on full display. Imagine standing amidst the towering Carpathian Mountains, their rugged peaks often kissed by clouds, offering a majestic and serene backdrop. This isn’t just scenery; it’s an immersive experience where every vista tells a story of timeless beauty and tranquility. Transylvania’s rolling hills and expansive valleys are a feast for the eyes. In spring and summer, the meadows burst into vibrant colors, blanketed with wildflowers that sway gently in the breeze. The forests here are ancient, filled with towering trees and crisscrossed by crystal-clear streams that sparkle in the sunlight. Each trail you take unveils new panoramas – from sun-dappled clearings to sweeping views that stretch across miles of untouched wilderness. The air is filled with the fresh scent of pine and earth, and the silence is profound, broken only by the rustle of leaves and the distant murmur of streams. As you explore, you’ll encounter some of the most breathtaking lookout points. Imagine the sense of awe as you stand on a secluded plateau, gazing out over a sea of green that seems to go on forever, framed by the dramatic silhouettes of the Carpathian peaks. Whether you’re hiking along scenic trails, resting by a mountain stream, or simply soaking in the panoramic vistas from a quiet hilltop, every moment here is a reminder of nature’s raw and untouched beauty. How does this place make you feel about the simple, unadulterated wonders of the world? description: TEAM 7-ELEVEN IS BACK — FOR ONE DAY ONLY 💥 Liège–Bastogne–Liège. April 27. The peloton turns green, white and red 💚❤️🤍 This Sunday, we’re not racing in red and yellow. We’re racing in history. Uno-X Mobility is reviving the iconic Team 7-Eleven.  For one day only, we’re reviving Team 7‑Eleven – not just as a tribute to cycling tradition, but as a celebration of the strong partnership between Uno‑X and 7‑Eleven, both proudly part of the REITAN family. Reitan Convenience is part of Reitan Retail, which manages 7-Eleven’s franchise operations in Norway, Sweden, and Denmark.  This is also a nod to the team that inspired an entire generation of Norwegian riders. Including a kid from Grimstad… named Thor Hushovd 👀 Now, our Grimstad guy is GM – and we’re bringing it all full circle. ___ The stunt also marks a tribute to the 80th birthday of one of the sport’s most influential riders, Eddy Merckx, whose name is deeply tied to both the race and the original 7‑Eleven team of the 1980s. Merckx won Liège‑Bastogne‑Liège a record five times, and his Merckx-branded bikes were key to putting the original 7‑Eleven squad on the map in Europe. For Liège 2025, Uno‑X Mobility Cycling will ride a special edition of the Ridley Noah Fast 3.0, provided by Belgian manufacturer Belgian Cycling Factory, which today owns the Eddy Merckx bicycle brand. The frames carry both modern race performance and a symbolic nod to Merckx — merging cycling heritage with cutting-edge engineering. Every detail has been considered to bring the 7‑Eleven tribute to life. CeramicSpeed adds a high-performance touch with its OSPW system, the Fusion jerseys blend heritage with speed, Sweet Protection supplies custom helmets, and GripGrab completes the look with matching gloves. Even the Škoda team cars are wrapped in 7‑Eleven graphics — turning the Ardennes back to the 80s.  For one Sunday in April, the clock rewinds and the peloton welcomes back an icon. Team 7‑Eleven rides again – see you in Liège.  #7ElevenRevival #team7eleven

description: Should I make this a series? 📍 380 Collins Street, Melbourne DETAILS ⬇️ Calling all millennial muggles (like me)! This might be Melbourne’s most magical hidden gem! Tucked away in the heart of the CBD, the ANZ Banking Museum is a free spot that feels straight out of Gringotts from Harry Potter. Housed within the heritage listed Gothic Bank at 380 Collins Street, this architectural marvel designed by William Wardell in 1887 is renowned for its grand arches, ornate ceilings, and marble columns, offering serious wizarding world vibes. Beyond its enchanting facade, the museum offers a self guided journey through Australia’s banking history, showcasing artifacts like gold rush era equipment, vintage banknotes, and antique moneyboxes. It’s a perfect blend of fantasy and history, right in the city’s core. 📍 380 Collins Street, Melbourne 🕰️ Open Monday to Friday, 9:30am to 4:00pm 🎟️ Entry: Free Send this to your Harry Potter loving date, or best mate. description: #聚啡馆一秒带你回到外婆家的情景 在古来这个小市镇里🏡，藏着一家具怀旧风情的咖啡馆，一踏入店内仿佛时光机般🛰让你回到了80年代的怀旧时光⏳️，好像回到了外婆家🥰。这里小镇的店多数是旧店铺，这家咖啡馆隐藏在店铺二楼，被店主用心布置得古色古香，有些复古摆设品☎️及家具是之前的住户留下来的📻，非常珍贵。 店内的每个角落都别具特色，充满了拍照的灵感📸。无论是怀旧的木制沙发，老式电视机📺，摄影机还是古典的唱片机💿，卡带相信都是摄影师们的最爱吧😍。那里还有些绿植在角落里静静生长🌱，为整个空间增添了一丝清新的氛围。真的是随手一拍像是经过精心设计的艺术品，只想停下默默欣赏☺️。 我们点了一壶香浓的咖啡🫖和一片烤芝士蛋糕🍰，店主非常贴心询问我们偏喜好哪种口味的咖啡☕️，然后再冲泡出最合我们口味的让我们慢慢品尝，蛋糕也很美味入口即化，甜而不腻。在这里让我感受到在家用餐的温暖🧡，我们选了靠近窗光线最好的位子，就这样惬意地坐在高架木椅边喝咖啡边享受幽静的片刻，也感谢小姐姐顾客帮我们拍了几张超有感觉的背影照，超爱🫰💕 若你已厌倦了城市的喧嚣🗯，就试着远离市区🚙来古来小镇这里的聚啡馆，在这里你可歇一歇尽情放松💯，体验不一样的感受，找到内心的宁静🫶 ⚠️个人口味，自行斟酌 【Cafe Jufei 聚啡馆】 📍地址 ｜3D, Jalan Ismail, Taman Kulai, 81000 Kulai, Johor ☎️联络号码 ｜ 0106684458 ⏰营业时间 ｜10am - 6pm (星期一休息) #聚啡馆 #古来咖啡馆 #复古咖啡馆 #怀旧时光 #柔佛美食 #美食推荐 #美食拍摄 #美食探店 #美食日记 #Jufeicafe #kulaicafe #johor #Foodie #malaysiafoodie #cafehopping #foodhopping #foodphotography

description: Vele di Scampia, 2024 Mixed media sculpture with video, lights,sound In 2022, I visited Scampia, a district on the  outskirts of Naples, Italy. The area, originally designed by Franz Di Salvo and completed in 1975, once consisted of seven buildings intended as utopian social housing. However, the planned infrastructure was never fully realized, leading to rising poverty, which allowed the mafia and drug  activity to take hold. Today, only three buildings remain. On July 22, 2024, a passageway in one of the remaining buildings collapsed, killing three people and displacing 800 others. Promised replacement housing, scheduled for years ago, remains delayed. Part of my solo exhibition How We Live, curated by Marc Wellmann, @hausamluetzowplatz through November 9, 2025. #velediscampia #sculpture #installationart #videoart #traceysnelling #howwelive #berlinart #napoli #scampia #architecture #brutalism

description: 越南人氣咖啡「Cộng Cà Phê越共咖啡」插旗台灣！🇻🇳☕️  台灣首店位於台北市中正區開封街一段16號，地理位置十分便利，從台北車站步行至僅需5.6分鐘可抵達。 - 台灣首店的裝潢也是用了越南本店的軍綠色系，店內復古的設計隨處可見，從店面擺飾著共產時期懷舊風小物，到員工越南風情的制服，以及懸掛在半空中著迷你造型戰鬥機，讓來訪的人一踏入店內，彷彿置身於越南街頭，而且Cộng Càphê 台北總店也有很多越南籍員工，服務非常親切，趕快來感受那份獨特的越南情懷吧！ - 這次點了👇🏻 #椰子咖啡冰沙 這杯咖啡招牌一定必點！保證會愛上😍 椰子冰沙口感非常綿密帶著椰子香氣，加上濃厚咖啡冰沙，兩個完美融合為一體，椰子中和咖啡的濃厚後格外順口， 讓人不禁一口接一口，喝完又想再來一杯！ 另外還有點了 #越南PHO美式 ＆ #茉莉茶 美式喝起來口感也是較濃一點帶著香醇，但竟然不會苦澀！推一個👍🏻 讓我意外的是茉莉茶！竟然也神好喝的，茉莉的清香真的抵擋不了，不管男女生都會超愛！ - 影片是試營運期間到訪就已經人潮眾多，建議可以一開店就到訪，內用記得先找座位再排隊，晚來可能要排隊4.50分鐘以上的準備，這次從外帶排隊到取餐整整排了一個小時半，但值得來一喝！ #越南咖啡 #CộngCàphê #越共咖啡 #台北美食 #咖啡廳 #椰子咖啡 #特色咖啡廳  #台北車站 #台北景點 #北車美食 #中正區 #congcaphe #coffeelover #caphe #softopening

description: Dark academia in Vienna is a fascinating blend of rich history, architectural beauty, and intellectual pursuit. This European city, known for its artistic and intellectual legacy, provides the perfect backdrop for the dark academia aesthetic. The city’s gothic and baroque buildings, winding cobblestone streets, and the pervasive sense of history lend themselves to a moody and romantic atmosphere. Vienna’s historic coffee houses, where writers and philosophers once debated, are now ideal spots for contemplation or diving into a classic novel. The University of Vienna, with its grand architecture and legacy of scholarly excellence, embodies the academic aspect of this aesthetic. The city’s numerous museums and libraries, brimming with old texts and artefacts, offer endless opportunities for exploration. Vienna, with its blend of dark, historical elegance and academic tradition, is a living tableau of the dark academia aesthetic. 🕰️📚🕯️ Locations: 📍Griechengasse  📍University of Vienna  📍Vienna State Opera  📍Votive Church  📍Austrian National Library  📍Antiquariat bookstore  📍Augustinian Church  📍Minoritenkirche  📌 Save this for later! description: Let’s visit Livraria Lello, the most beautiful bookstore in the world! ✨📚 Livraria Lello is one of the most stunning bookshops in the world and is a must visit for book lovers. Stepping inside this library is like taking a journey back in time with its Neo-Gothic and Art Nouveau design. You can browse their collection of beautiful books on their dark wood shelves and take a journey up their winding staircase under a colourful stained glass skylight. Seeing the impressive red staircase for the first time took my breath away and it’s such a magical experience to go book shopping here. Despite being beautiful, you should know that it's one of the most popular attractions in Porto and you can expect this place to be crowded throughout the day. It’s been on my literary bucket list for years and it was a dream come true to finally make it happen. Here are some tips for visiting Livraria Lello ⬇️✨ 🎟️You must buy tickets online to visit the bookshop 🩶Silver Tickets are 8 euros and you can use the cost to purchase a book 🏆Gold Tickets are 16 euros and allow you to skip the line and come with a free book ⏰I would visit very first thing for a chance of seeing the staircase empty 📸That, or visiting later in the afternoon around closing is better for crowds ⭐️Regardless of when you go expect this place to be crowded 🌙Make sure to take some photos of their incredible winding staircase! *Press visit with @livraria.lello - thank you for letting me take photos after closing. 👩🏻‍💻I have a complete guide for this magical library my blog thirdeyetraveller.com 🧚🏻‍♀️ Like this post? description: What if you spent the night with Rembrandt? In 2017, Dutch schoolteacher Stefan Kasper became the Rijksmuseum’s 10-millionth visitor since its grand reopening—and the first person ever allowed to sleep inside the museum. To mark the occasion, he was treated to a surreal experience: a private dinner and an overnight stay beneath The Night Watch, Rembrandt’s towering masterwork in the Gallery of Honour. It wasn’t just a reward—it was a moment where art history met dreamlike reality. Beneath the eyes of 17th-century musketeers frozen in oil and time, Kasper became part of a story that no other museum-goer could claim. For one night, the museum wasn’t just a place to observe art—it was a place to live inside it. #BaroqueBlended #Art #Artist #Rijksmuseum #TheNightWatch #Rembrandt #ArtHistory #MuseumMoments #LivingWithArt #DreamscapeHistory

description: Would you visit here?   Hidden beneath the Texas Hill Country, this underrated state park is packed with history, geology, and adventure. Here’s everything you need to know before you go: 📍 Location: Located in Burnet, TX—just 90 minutes from Austin or San Antonio, and nestled within the Highland Lakes region. Longhorn Cavern State Park.    🕳️ The Main Attraction: Take the Guided Cave Tour (1.1 miles round trip, ~90 minutes). It’s the only way to explore the cavern and totally worth it. Expect stunning underground chambers, unique rock formations, and wild stories (think speakeasies and outlaws).   🕐 Best Time to Visit: Year-round! The cave stays a cool 68°F no matter the weather, making it a perfect escape from Texas heat ☀️ or rain 🌧️.   📸 Must-See Spots: – The Crystal City (sparkling calcite walls!) – The Hall of Marble – Queen’s Throne Room/Queen's Watchdog for an epic photo op – Observation Tower above ground for sweeping views of Hill Country   🎟️ Tickets: – Book online in advance, especially on weekends. – $20/adult, $11/child (6–12). – No self-guided access to the cave.   🥾 Extra Adventure: Try the Longhorn Cavern Hiking Trail (1.5 miles loop). It’s short, easy, and great for spotting local wildlife or catching a sunset.   💡 Pro Tips: – Wear closed-toe shoes—some parts of the cave require careful footing. – Bring a light jacket (it’s chilly inside). – Arrive early to explore the above-ground trails or have a picnic before your tour. – No pets inside the cave, but they’re welcome on surface trails!   👻 Bonus: Rumor has it this cave is haunted. You didn’t hear it from us. 👀   Save this post for your next Texas adventure! 🤠   #texasadventures #longhorncavern #texasstateparks #hillcountryhiddengems #undergroundtexas #texasroadtrip #visittexas #traveltex

description: 🇲🇾柔佛小众的隐藏景点‼️真的就剩这一个了…不是船长的讲解还真不知道…观看萤火虫的地方，在柔佛就只在哥打丁宜啦虽然正逢它们交配的季节，但真的肉眼见到啦，真不是动画，更不是灯光秀，是大自然在发光，变成了会动的“圣诞树”🎄这个小旅程非常值得👍 除此之外这里还有平价美味的海鲜煮炒💯 被虾菇拉住了我的胃，咸蛋的沙沙口感和虾菇的嫩鲜肉质， 有着不同层次，却都平衡的那么好，想得到吗，这么一盘才RM17😍 我们order的4-5人份，大概在RM390+  🦀 🦐 🦑 豆腐，啦啦汤真的很好喝🤤平常心说一句：餐食都很有水准，加上这自然生态的环境，距离新山1小时车程，为了这美食和价钱下次还要去🥳有水有河，很是休闲，知道吗？150年历史的天后宫就在岸边…兔子🐰 🐔🦢🐟🐑 🐒 亲子出行很适合👍 和我们同船的还有好多海外🇰🇷🇨🇳游客… 亲眼看到的浪漫大家都好开心，只是无法拍照📷 不过船长有发我15秒的视频（那是他们在正确方式下所拍摄） 还是去亲眼目睹传说中的不可思议吧，视频里面有正确的买票方式（⭕️可whatsapp或WeChat⭕️） 因为店家有说许多人在网上购买，但其实都不是他们，认准⚠️【Firefly Valley Leisure Park】📍Jalan Jemaluang，81900 Kota Tinggi，Johor Darul Ta'zim （11am - 9pm）📲 MR.Tan +60 12 789 6224  #kotatinggi #萤火虫 #firefly #yummyfoodreels #yummyfood #seafoodlovers #seafood #crab #海鲜 #亲子互动 #马来西亚美食

description: Have you check out @spruce.sg, the Indoor Air-Conditioned Pet Friendly Restaurant at the West? We love how Spruce is indoor & air conditioned with a specific pet friendly area for us.. As we know, there are barely a handful of indoor aircon places in Singapore for us, and this place is just so perfect! It’s also super clean, pretty & spacious 🥹  There are about 7 sets of tables in the pet friendly area.. Do remember to make reservations before heading down, especially on weekends! My hoomans had tried 4 out of 5 dishes crafted by MasterChef Singapore Season 4 Winner, Inderpal Singh. Here is what we ordered:  🎃 MasterChef - Pumpkin Laksa Soup 🦀 MasterChef - Fenugreek Crab Cake 🦐 MasterChef - Chilli Prawn Roti John 🐠 MasterChef - Barramundi & Coconut Briyani 🥥  🍰 Blueberry Banana Hotcake 🫐🍌  🍸 Spruce Sunrise ☀️  🍹Lychee Soda Both my hoomans have the same top pick & their favourites are the Chilli Prawn Roti John & the Blueberry Banana Hotcake!  Thank you Spruce for the invite 🧡 We will be back to try out all the other dishes in store!  If you have yet to check them out, it’s worth a visit! The most famous painting is the 15th-century Adoration of the Mystic Lamb by the Flemish Masters Jan and Hubert Van Eyck. Other highlights include Christ on a Cross by Antoon van Dyck (in Saint Michael's Church) and Triptych of Christ on the Cross by the hand of Michiel Coxie (Saint James’ Church. Aside from the classics, Ghent is also brimming with modern art galleries and little theaters! 🏰 The medieval castle in the city centre 🏰 How many cities do you know that have a well-preserved medieval fort smack in the historical centre? Het Gravensteen was the home of the Count of Flanders no less!  🍀 Sustainability is their middle name🍀 Ghent spearheaded the plant-based movement in Flanders and is still considered the veggie capital of Europe.  Aside from that it was one of the first cities to implement a low-emission zone for cars, has the largest offering of low-impact accommodations and a tons of little local artisanal shops. Can you blame me for loving this city to bits? 🚲 Bike until you drop… 🚲 Ghent is the biking capital of Flanders. It’s a breeze to cycle around as the city centre has really good cycling infrastructure. We ended up renting a bike and cycled the 58 km Lys region route around the city. This route is one of the circular bike routes aptly named Flanders' Finest Cycle Routes. These easy to follow paths take you through the prettiest natural, cultural and culinary heritage of the region! #belgium #belgique #gent #ghent #belgie #vlaanderen #belgiumtiktok #europe #eurosummer #hiddengemseurope #hiddengems #beautifuldestinations

description: Fresno’s next ArtHop will be a strictly indoor-only event – and it will be watched over by Fresno’s Code Enforcement “to ensure that those rules are enforced.” That announcement was made by Fresno City Councilmember Miguel Arias on Friday. Any outdoor activity including pop-up vending and food trucks will be strictly prohibited.  Officials emphasized the city does not charge ArtHop organizers or the vendors for any additional police presence or time that the event requires. They says it’s one of the few events the state doesn’t impose costs for police services, instead officers are simply reassigned from other areas to cover the downtown area— something he says spreads the police force thin.  Arias cited bigger crowds, potential health and safety concerns, and the heat as cause.

description: Steps for Creating a Painting with Tree Branches 	1.	Choose Your Surface The paint typically used for this technique is acrylic. You can work on either a canvas or regular sketch paper or cardboard. However, I recommend starting with paper first and then moving on to canvas once you’re comfortable. 	2.	Prepare the Branches Before using the tree branches, trim them to create a relatively flat surface. This will help reduce the chances of unwanted paint smudging when the branch comes into contact with the canvas. 	3.	Apply Paint to the Branches Be careful not to overload the branches with paint. Instead of dipping the branch directly into the paint, use a brush to apply paint onto the branch. This will give you better control over the amount of paint and the effect it creates. 	4.	Paint on the Canvas When applying the paint, make sure to leave some empty spaces on the canvas or paper. Avoid covering the entire surface with paint, as the empty spaces can add to the overall aesthetic of your artwork. 	5.	Final Tips and Feedback Best of luck with your painting! Feel free to send me your attempts via DM. description: Un’architettura straordinaria che riesce a essere contemporaneamente un ponte, uno spazio espositivo e una visionaria opera scultorea, nonché il simbolo di uno dei musei a cielo aperto più affascinanti d’Europa. The Twist è un’incredibile struttura progettata dallo studio danese BIG e inaugurata nel 2019 come nuovo landmark di Kistefos, un parco delle sculture situato nei boschi norvegesi a circa un’ora di auto da Oslo. Il concetto alla base del progetto è tanto semplice quanto geniale: un volume a forma di parallelepipedo che connette le due sponde del fiume Randselva e che a metà strada si torce secondo un angolo di novanta gradi.  Il risultato finale è un’architettura dalla sbalorditiva plasticità e dinamicità che non colpisce soltanto dal punto di vista estetico e visivo ma che è anche molto importante a livello logistico e funzionale. The Twist, infatti, è accessibile da ambedue i lati e costituisce a tutti gli effetti il secondo ponte all’interno dell’area dove si sviluppa Kistefos, permettendo ai visitatori di vivere il parco attraverso un percorso ad anello, cosa che prima non era possibile. #thetwist #thetwistkistefos #big #bjarkeingelsgroup #bjarkeingels #kistefos #kistefossmuseet #kistefosmuseum #architecture #contemporaryarchitecture #architecturephotography #archilovers #archdaily #architecture_hunter #architettura #architetturacontemporanea #arquitetura #jevnaker #oslo #norway

description: “사랑을 주제로 한 500여 점의 픽사 전시” 인사이드아웃, 엘리멘탈, 토이스토리 등 수많은 명작 애니메이션을 제작해 온 픽사의 전시가 오늘부터 5월까지 여의도에서 열린다. 국내 최초로 선보이는 이번 컬렉션은 ‘사랑’이라는 인류의 근원적 감정을 중심으로 5개의 테마가 구성됐는데, 픽사가 39년 동안 쌓아온 마법같은 이야기를 사랑이라는 주제에 맞춰 따뜻하게 풀어낸다. 500여 점의 작품이 동원되는 이번 전시는 픽사 영화 수십여 편의 초기 드로잉과 컨셉아트도 공개되는데, 여느 전시에서는 볼 수 없는 희귀한 작품들인 만큼 색다른 감동과 깊은 여운을 선사할 전망이다. <픽사 아트 컬렉션 : 매직 포 러브> 🗓️ 2025. 02. 27.(목) - 05. 18.(일) 🏷 서울특별시 영등포구 국제금융로 10, IFC몰 L3층 🕰 매일 11:00 - 20:00 ╱ “Pixar Art Collection: Magic for Love” An extraordinary Pixar exhibition, featuring over 500 pieces, is set to take place in Yeouido from today until May. Pixar, the studio behind beloved animated classics like “Inside Out”, “Elemental”, and “Toy Story”, presents this special collection in Korea for the first time. The exhibition revolves around “love”, one of humanity’s most fundamental emotions, and is structured into five thematic sections. Bringing 39 years of Pixar’s storytelling magic to life, this exhibition reinterprets its timeless narratives through the lens of love, offering a warm and heartfelt experience. With over 500 artworks on display, including rare concept sketches and early drawings from numerous Pixar films, visitors will have the unique opportunity to witness never-before-seen treasures. A must-see for Pixar fans, this exhibition promises a deeply touching and unforgettable journey. <Pixar Art Collection: Magic For Love> 📅 February 27, 2025 (Thu) – May 18, 2025 (Sun) 🏷 10 International Finance Road, Yeongdeungpo-gu, Seoul (IFC Mall, L3F) 🕰 Everyday 11:00 - 20:00 #전시 #전시회 #pixar#전시pixaron #disney #exhibition #seoultravel #koreatravel

description: 🇲🇾这应该是😁小编我去的超省心又好玩的露营🏕️了！！！还带着我的老板同事一起来摸鱼🤣 最近工作真的是多到超累的🫠！所以今天小编我决定偷懒不上班，抓老板和同事们一起去 #DusunBonda 露营🏕️，来放松最近紧绷的心情！重点这里的帐篷里面不仅有冷气❄️，还包🌙晚餐和☀️早餐，真的😍超省心！ #DusunBonda 的早餐里面有，椰浆饭🍚、面包🍞、果酱和牛油🍓🧈、3 in 1咖啡☕️、茶包🍵、果汁🥤、糕点🍰、Curry puff🥟和西瓜🍉等等。 他们的晚餐当然是露营怎么能少的烧烤套餐！里面有，腌制的鸡🍗和鱼🐟,玉蜀黍🌽,热狗🌭,中式炒饭🍚,土豆沙拉🥔和水果🍉。而且分量都很足！当然你也可以自己喜欢带食材，然后和他们租BBQ烤架来使用（RM18）。可是需要注意的是烧烤只能是HALAL食品！不过小编没有订到他们的烧烤晚餐🥹🥹，就外卖点了pizza 当然😁活动安排也很丰富！ #DusunBonda 泳池开放到晚上7点,晚上9点有🔥营火会,可以免费拿棉花烤着吃。当然你还可以去 #DusunBonda 提供给你的丛林🚶徒步指导，穿越森林到一个😱隐藏的瀑布！而且想玩水的营地旁就有🌊河流，水非常🌟清澈，流水不会太急，可以放心大胆的去玩！ 小编我个人的体验分享： - ✅ 外面的停车场非常充裕，而且距离营地也很靠近 - ✅ 有网线！（要是没有这个小编我真的会疯掉🤣） - ✅ 有私人厕所而且还有热水器！（但别忘了自己带厕纸、牙膏牙刷和毛巾） - ✅ 营地里面铺了洋灰路！ - ✅ 多数帐篷都有自己的私人前院和共享厨房 - ✅ 厨房提供调味料和洗碗液，但建议自备 - ✅ 厨房有冰箱、饮水机、煤气炉、微波炉、锅碗瓢盆（只可以HALAL食品使用） - ✅ NON HALAL的食物可以带，但餐具厨房用品和冰柜等等需自备 - ✅ 晚上11点营地篱笆就锁门了很安全！ **温馨提醒这里是不能带酒的呀~ 这次的露营真的是超省心又好玩😍，小编我和老板、同事们都玩得超爽的！玩到都不想回去做工了😢！不管啦！！！下次有机会一定还要再来！所以家人们！快带上你的家人朋友一起来 #DusunBonda 露营放松心情把！ 🔸🔷🔸🔷🔸🔷🔸🔷🔸🔷 「 Dusun Bonda 」 📍 地址: Lot 2121 (2996) Jalan Ulu Tamu, Kampung Orang Asli Gurney, Ulu Tamu, 44300 Batang Kali, Selangor LIKE ⬇⬇ 新山去哪儿 JB Go Where 跟着打卡就对了! 🎞Follow TikTok ➤➤ https://www.tiktok.com/@jbgowhere?_t=8ifNWwCVFFi&_r=1 📽Follow抖音➤➤ https://v.douyin.com/i8vfFasb/ 📕Follow 小红书 ➤➤ https://www.xiaohongshu.com/.../5facaf42000000000100650c 📸Follow Instagram ➤➤ instagram.com/jbgowhere 💻Website ➤➤ https://www.jbgowhere.com/ 🎥Subscribe YouTube ➤➤ youtube.com/c/新山去哪儿JBGoWhere #大马去哪儿 #malaysiagowhere #新山去哪儿 #JBGoWhere #KL好去处 #露营 #露营推荐 #户外 #逃离城市

description: The British Museum's new exhibition, China's Hidden Crntury, features interviews with Jessica Harrison-Hall and Ms. Wenyuan Xin, curators of the British Museum. How the exhibition themes were chosen and how the areas were divided? description: Reading nook 🩵 it’s not totally finished as I still have a few bits to add but it’s close enough & I’ve never been good at “reveals” 😂  A big thank you to the masses who messaged saying this corner was crying out for a nook. I was saying a hard no to Kev when he was suggesting to make one & I started to listen when lots of others were saying the same thing. I pictured a chest of drawers in this space but I’m so glad I listened ☺️  I still need to decide on fabric for a seat cushion & we have a few finishing touches to add but you get the idea.  There are shelves on the right for books & toys, underseat storage (with a soft close lid - a must!) & a reading light. I have some decorations to add to the ceiling when I get a moment. I should have waited until then to show you but as I’m sure you’re already aware if you know about my chocolate habit, I have no willpower 😂  A big shout out to Louie who did lots of hammering, hoovering & general noise & mess creation throughout.
