description: We took a different kind of field trip today. A quiet one. A sacred one. Ronin, 4 years old, still screen-free — wandered the aisles of a used bookstore with his dad. No distractions. No overstimulation. Just old paper, imagination, and the magic that happens when you let a child lead with curiosity. There’s something about bookstores — how the air hums with old stories waiting to be picked up again. He ran his fingers along the spines like he already understood: every book is a door. He doesn’t ask for screens. He asks for stories. And that’s the kind of childhood we’re building. One without flashing lights, but full of wonder. Still screen-free. description: Georgia Street renovations are in full swing right outside the Indiana Convention Center downtown. The city-supported project aims to reimagine a new, vibrant public space along a key stretch in the downtown core. Megan Vukusich, director of the Indianapolis Department of Metropolitan Development, said many visitors end up along Georgia Street, which is anchored by Gainbridge Fieldhouse and the convention center. “If this is the first stop that they're making in our city," Vukusich said, "then we're also seeing so much development happening on Georgia Street. Another thing that we're focusing on downtown is creating these new public spaces that really support economic development.” Major projects along Georgia Street include the new Signia Hotel that is under construction and the revitalization of Circle Centre Mall. Georgia Street received its most recent makeover in 2012 for the Super Bowl. The public space created boardwalks, overhead shade system, seating and has been consistently used for large downtown events over the years. Chris Merritt, principal architect for Merritt Chase, has contracted with the city on the street design. He said they’re trying to build on that legacy investment. “So with the West Block in particular, it will transform from what is still essentially a street today to a more park-like environment,” Merritt said. Plans for the western section of the street makeover include more trees, greenspace, canopies and flexible plaza spaces. The section of street will be closed to traffic on a day-to-day basis with lanes accessible if needed. One of the goals of the $9.1 million project is to create a safer, more walkable environment in line with downtown connectivity plans. description: Read your card’s message👇🏼 🐦‍⬛ King of Swords 🐦‍⬛ • be mindful with words: today they are even more powerful • you don’t have to share all of it just because you’ve got asked • your mind can create wonders and rule kingdoms: never doubt or underestimate its magic  The mighty raven king is observing his lands, quietly and with dignity.  He knows enough to rule his realm, but he always stays alert. He is the keeper of the forest’s secrets. He is the key to all mysteries, the librarian of all inexplicable events, both accounted and unaccounted for. But the king is cautious with the information. He will share only what suits his interests.  Maybe you won’t know everything from him. But you can learn to honor your knowledge, to remember that it has power, to dispense and utilize it the way you find both right and useful. Just like the raven king does. 🧙🏻‍♀️ This can be your daily card or your advice on that situation you have in mind. description: 7 Camera Movements With Actor 🎥 هفت حرکت دوربین همراه با بازیگر Make Your Shots Come Alive! Want your shots to feel more cinematic and engaging? Try these 10 powerful camera movements with just one actor to add depth, emotion, and motion to your scenes: 1. Follow Shot – Camera follows the actor from behind or the side. Creates a sense of journey. 2. Lead Shot – Camera moves backward as the actor walks forward. Builds intimacy and tension. 3. Walk & Talk – Classic dialogue shot with the actor walking and talking. Natural and fluid. 4. Over-the-Shoulder Tracking – Tracking from behind the shoulder. Immersive and personal. 5. 360 Around the Actor – Camera circles the actor. Great for drama or inner conflict. 6. Push-In (Dolly In) – Camera slowly moves in. Builds emotion and focus. 7. Pull-Out (Dolly Out) – Camera moves away. Suggests isolation or realization. 8. Side Tracking – Camera moves sideways alongside the actor. Perfect for motion and space. 9. Crane with Subject – Vertical movement with the actor. Adds scale and visual drama. 10. Handheld with Actor – Unstable, raw movement. Feels real, urgent, or emotional. 🎥 These techniques work even in small spaces or low-budget setups! 🔖 Save this post to try these moves in your next scene! #videography #videographer #filmmaker #filmmaking #filmmakingtips #cameraman #cinematographer #cinematic #filmup #dollyzoom  #behindthescenes #blechfilm #filmmkrs #contentcreator #contentcreation #فیلم  #فیلمبرداری_حرفه_ای #تصویربرداری #تصویربردار #فیلم

description: Astăzi am filmat un video plin de caterincă! L-am provocat pe un băiat: dacă nu știe să cânte, îl tund chel! La prima încercare, a cântat o piesă, dar sincer, am simțit că e cam slabă vocal. I-am spus asta direct, fără ocolișuri. Dar băiatul nu s-a lăsat! A mai încercat o dată, de data aceasta cu o piesă de-a Theo Rose, și trebuie să recunosc, m-a surprins foarte tare! A cântat atât de bine încât aproape că am uitat de provocare. Dar ce să vezi? În loc să se oprească aici, a luat mașina de tuns în mână și mi-a zis: „No, acum eu te tund chel dacă nu știi să cânți!” 😅🥴 Dincolo de glumă, adevărul e că în Sighetu Marmatiei  sunt mulți tineri talentați care au nevoie doar de puțină promovare pentru a-și atinge adevăratul potențial. Dacă acest video adună 100.000 de vizualizări, facem o repetiție cu Daniel, Nikolas și formația lor și le dau ocazia să urce pe scene tot mai mari. Nunțile sunt doar începutul – visul lor merge mult mai departe! Susțineți talentul local și hai să facem împreună un prim pas spre succes! #barberinternational

description: 家人们！今晚锁定直播间，超厉害的达人老师 Cindy 要来和我一起给大家送惊喜啦！今晚有鹅梨王中王线香，以鹅梨搭沉香、檀香，果香与木调交融。轻燃间，清甜悠远，伴你读书、冥想，静享雅致生活。还有高阶沉香 4 盘香。轻捻点燃，油脂饱满的沉香释放出层次变幻的香气，每一刻呼吸，都是与自然精华的亲密对话。以及崖柏枕头的天花板！精选重庆城口珍稀崖柏原材料刨花，不同于普通崖柏，城口崖柏散发着沁人心脾的香甜气息，初闻如蜜饯般清甜，细嗅又有淡淡的奶香交融。这抹甜香都能带你坠入温柔梦乡，让深度睡眠不再遥远。城口崖柏枕头，以香甜为引，守护你的每一个安眠夜，让生活满溢幸福与惬意。今晚七点锁定直播间，好物多多，千万不要错过哦！

description: #新北市美術館 開箱！ 🔥免票入場 展覽搶先看🔥 最近最讓我期待的新景點就是這裡 新北市美術館終於要開幕啦🎉 幫大家搶先參觀 真的比想像中還精彩 從外面到裡面都超級美🥰🥰 一走進來就是挑高空間+大片的落地玻璃 自然光灑進來的感覺超舒服～ 戶外大片草原 不論是辦活動或野餐都很舒服的地方 這次有兩個展我覺得都很值得來看 ➡️「往來／照見」展：用藝術作品回顧新北的城市故事，有些照片跟裝置作品真的會讓你停下腳步多看幾眼。 ➡️「新店男孩」展：有AI影像、投影、互動裝置，完全就是走進一個虛擬藝術世界，燈光打下去的畫面超美，怎麼拍都像電影感～ 4/25起，連續六週的活動 （表演、市集、燈光秀） 4/26、4/27晚上還有煙火秀 如果你最近有空 真的可以衝一波～ 美術館不只是看展 整個園區也很適合 散步、發呆、野餐 快把這個免費又好拍的新景點存起來 下次休假直接來走走！ 新北市美術館 試營運：4/8～4/13 正式開館：4/25 開放時間：平日10:00-17:30，假日10:00-18:00 🎫 試營運&新開幕期間（4/8-4/13，4/25-6/30） 入場＆展覽免票參觀 #栗栗子玩新北 #新北景點 #新北 #新北景點 #新北旅遊 #鶯歌 #鶯歌景點 #新開幕 #免費展覽 #期間限定 #展覽 #展覽資訊 #週未好去處

description: 10 LUGARES PRA CONHECER NA COLÔNIA WITMARSUM, EM PALMEIRA-PR 1 - Vila Katarina: um espaço ao ar livre onde estão localizadas a Cervejaria Witmarsum, o restaurante Bierwit Garten e a gelateria Oak Farm. Abre de sexta a domingo das 11h às 18h. 2 - Kakaowit: fábrica e loja de chocolates. Qualidade fantástica dos chocolates, um melhor que o outro. Pra fazer a degustação é ideal agendar com antecedência. Abre de terça a domingo. 3 - Vinícola Witmarsum: uma vinícola familiar que produz vinhos de mesa e mais de 20 tipos de geléias. Lá também tem uma planataçãao de pés de amora e é possível fazer um picnic com vinho e tábua de frios por 140 reais. 4 - Lavandário Vale dos Sonhos: eles oferecem uma visita guiada bem interessante. Dá pra aprender bastante sobre as lavandas. O lavandário é perfeito para ensaios fotográficos. Visita é 35 reais. 5 - Confeitaria Kliewer: tradicional café colonial que conta com deliciosas opções de doces e salgados. Valor: 58 reais. 6 - Heimat Museum: conta a história da Colônia Witmarsum. Entrada é 15 reais. 7 - Centro de Informações Turísticas: fica em uma casa no estilo Enxaimel e conta com uma lojinha com diversos produtos típicos da região. Os queijos são excelentes! 8 - Let's Road: um pouco mais afastado dos outros atrativos, na BR376, o Let's Road é um restaurante temático do velho oeste americano. É bem divertido! 9 - Chalé do Pão Sauerteig: os pães artesanais dessa padaria são sensacionais. Ainda é possível ver um pouco o processo dde produção. 10 - Kaffeewit: loja de cafés especiais e torrefação. Pra quem gosta de café não pode perder. Observação importante: boa parte dos estabelecimentos da Colônia Witmarsum só abre aos finais de semana. Visitar durante a semana pode ser um pouco frustrante.  #coloniawitmarsum #parana

description: 朱柳莉是中国著名的国礼画家，以她的工笔画和刺绣作品闻名。她在艺术领域取得了显著的成就，以下是她的一些主要艺术成就和贡献： 1. **工笔画大师**：朱柳莉擅长工笔画，其作品细腻精致，色彩丰富，常常描绘花鸟鱼虫等自然题材，展现了极高的艺术造诣。 2. **刺绣艺术家**：她不仅擅长绘画，还精通刺绣艺术，将绘画与刺绣完美结合，创作出许多精美的刺绣画作。她的刺绣作品色彩鲜艳、针法细腻，受到广泛赞誉。 3. **国礼艺术家**：作为国礼画家，朱柳莉的作品被选作国家礼品，赠送给外国政要和贵宾。这不仅体现了她个人的艺术成就，也代表了国家对她艺术才华的认可。 4. **艺术教育**：朱柳莉在艺术教育领域也做出了重要贡献，她致力于培养新一代艺术人才，传授工笔画和刺绣技艺，推动传统艺术的发展和传承。 5. **文化交流**：通过参与国际艺术展览和文化交流活动，朱柳莉为中外文化交流做出了积极贡献，提升了中国传统艺术在国际上的影响力。 6. **作品收藏**：她的作品被许多博物馆和美术馆收藏，如中国国家博物馆、故宫博物院等。这些作品不仅展示了她个人的艺术成就，也为公众提供了欣赏和学习的机会。 朱柳莉在艺术创作、教育和文化交流等方面的卓越贡献，使她成为中国当代艺术界的重要人物。她的艺术作品既保留了传统的精髓，又融合了现代的创新，具有很高的艺术和文化价值。#名画 #朱柳莉 #国画 #国礼画家 #手绘画艺术 #点赞关注

description: The Baile Gean is a traditional 1730s township in the Scottish Highlands and forms part of the Highland Folk Museum.  Visitors can step inside the cruck-framed and heather thatched buildings, smell the peat smoke rising from the central hearth, and learn about rural tenant life in the era of the Jacobites.  The collection of turf and thatch buildings is based on the archaeological remains of Raitts, which was one of the principal townships in the Badenoch area, five miles north-east of the museum.  If the Scottish historical drama Outlander is your thing, then you won’t be disappointed to learn that this recreated 1730s township was used as a film location for Series One, Episode Five (Rent). The local Badenoch waulking group – Comhlan Luadh Bhàideanach – featured in the episode, carrying out the shrinking of the homespun and woven cloth whilst singing Gaelic folk songs. Visitors can enjoy views across to the Cairngorms, as well as the costumed interpreters who bring Baile Gean (Township of Goodwill) to life with traditional crafts such as spinning and thatching.  The township is only one part of the much larger open museum. It is free to visit, however donations are welcomed to support with the upkeep.  #scottishhighlands #outlander #scotland #history #travel #scottishtiktok #bucketlist #beautifuldestinations #outlandertiktok #traditional #visitscotland #fyp #jamiefraser #outlanderfans

description: This has to be the most unique trail we have ever hiked 👇👇 Save this post for future travels to New Mexico! We recently visited Bandelier National Monument, a park that protects thousands of ancestral Pueblo dwellings, less than an hour outside of Santa Fe. This park is a must visit if you want to explore unique trails and learn about local history and the Pueblo people. To see the most during your visit, we recommend hiking the Pueblo Loop Trail to the Alcove House Trail. This 3 mile hike leaves from the visitors center and park museum so definitely check those out after your hike! During the hike, there are QR codes to scan so you can learn about the dwellings and history. There are also quite a few ladders along the trail that allow you to go into some of the dwellings. This hike is not dog friendly! And do not climb anywhere off trail unless there is a ladder present! There are fees to enter the park - $25 per private vehicle however the fees were waived when we went on a random Thursday 🤷‍♀️ Would you hike here?? description: 斯坦福博物馆里的镇馆之宝，奥古斯特·罗丹，法国 ，1840-1917 年 思想家，这尊雕塑是罗丹为 1880 年委托 作品《地狱之门》构思的首批人物 之一。它最初是对意大利作家但丁 ·阿利吉耶里 (Dante Alighieri) 的象征性 描绘，他的 14 世纪史诗 《神曲》在一定程度上激发了罗丹 的灵感。罗丹把他安置在纪念碑 的顶部，俯视着地狱中受苦受难 的灵魂。随着时间的推移，但 丁演变成《思想者》，这是一部致敬 人类智慧力量的独立作品。 1902 年之后，罗丹将其扩大到这个尺寸 ，创作出的雕塑成为世界上最受 认可的现代艺术作品之一。

description: Let’s visit one the best museums in Glasgow - Kelvingrove Art Gallery & Museum! 🎨💫 The Kelvingrove Museum is one of my favourite places to visit in Glasgow.  It’s a huge building that has many sections with award-winning art galleries, museums, heritage areas and exhibitions.  Not to mention that the architecture there is stunning! I highly recommend stopping by their café in the foyer for a pick me up during your visit. You could spend hours here so make sure to leave enough time to see everything. It’s the place to go on a rainy day.  Top tips for visiting the Kelvingrove Museum ⬇️✨ 🎟️You don’t need to book tickets just drop by 🆓Entry is free but donations are always appreciated  🚗Parking is expensive, it’s easier to get here by public transport  ⏰Leave at least 2-3 hours for your visit - it’s a big place 📸Get your camera ready as the architecture is breathtaking! description: Read your card’s message👇🏼 ⚫️ The World ⚫️ • time to finish something; work through this until it’s complete • let go of what’s ending for you, peacefully and when you’re ready  • some big new story will start unfolding soon, after you say goodbye to this one This cosmic event looks like an eclipse, but this time it is something bigger. The whole world is shifting, the whole era ends here. This world had gone through massive changes before, and it changed the whole way life looked like.  It was a glorious time and place to live in. It was perfect in its own way. We can’t add anything more to the story of the Bird King’s realm, but we’ll remember it. What’s going to be next—no one knows. We’ll (probably) live and see. Some big chapter of your life is going to close for you, too. Not in a dramatic way, but with a quiet realization that it’s complete: nothing to be added, no way you can make it better. It is perfect in its own way, and even if it’s not—it’s finished, like a book you’ve read to the very last word.  This story ends in harmony, it is full and complete. description: The Arte Museum in Dubai Mall is an immersive digital art space that offers a mesmerizing, multi-sensory experience with stunning visual and auditory installations. Located on Level 2 of the mall, near Galerie Lafayette, it features themed exhibits like “Eternal Nature” and “Infinite Space”. These exhibits combine vibrant, dynamic visuals with ambient soundscapes, creating a breathtaking environment for visitors. The experience typically lasts about 90 minutes and includes activities for all ages. For children, the museum offers interactive art stations where they can color animals like turtles, dolphins, cheetah or flamingos and watch their paintings come to life on digital screens. The artwork appears integrated into the exhibits, such as animals swimming in digital oceans or framed within the museum displays.  There are various ticket options available, including VIP packages that provide guided tours, priority access, and additional perks. Visitors can also relax at the ARTE Tea Bar, which serves themed refreshments to complement the artistic experience. We enjoyed some matcha drinks at the tea bar, and when the cups were set on the table, they featured beautiful floral artwork. It was such a unique experience! If you’re a fan of interactive art or looking for a family-friendly cultural outing in Dubai, the Arte Museum is a fantastic choice. For more details, visit their website or check the Dubai Mall directory. #artemuseum #fyp #viral #mustvisitplace #explore @ARTE MUSEUM DUBAI

description: I would like to tell you the story of Cyber Dreams exhibition. A year ago this journey began. It was just an idea. Inserting digital works within scenographic installations, to accompany people on a journey where digital art is inserted into a story, told through the use of immersive elements The Cyber Dreams art exhibition will take place in Asilo Ciano from tomorrow till Monday.  It represents the intersection of technology, creativity and contemporary society. It will present over 40 works by artists worldwide. description: 【享吃 | 吉隆坡OUG | 超高人气面包咖啡馆】 讲到Kenny Hills Bakery, 大多数Cafe Kaki 应该对这家咖啡馆都不陌生😊，它由小型面包店经营到成为咖啡馆☕️，后打响了品牌，现阶段共开了6间分行😳，还发展到5个品牌⭐️，有Bistro 酒馆，亚洲美食餐厅，nourish vegan专门店等, 还真是厉害 ‼️ 最初也是因为朋友介绍去了其总行Bukit Tunku后，就很想再回头去光顾了。其实Kenny Hills Bakers 闻名的是其手工烘培食品🥞🥐，蛋糕🍰，甜点和有机面包🍞，每次去那里用餐后，就想买些面包带走，尤其是其牛角包😋，不懂有谁也和小编一样呢😅 而这家在OUG 的Kenny Hills Coffee与其他的咖啡馆分行是很相似, 只是少了热食，就只有面包类如牛角包，Croffle包华夫饼🧇，土司，三文治🥪，蛋糕🍰等, 属于加强版的咖啡馆。 咖啡馆的店面就在The Food Merchant超市里的角落间，第一次去那里有点感觉像是去了国外的超市场🥰，加上咖啡馆又有户外的位子🪴🌿，可以坐着悠闲地喝杯咖啡☕️，吃它著名的牛角包🥐以及桃馅饼🥞 (Peach Strudel), 真的不亦乐乎。 若你是住在这一带又想要享用他家的烘培食品可以来这家间咖啡馆哦☺️ 【Kenny Hills Coffee, The Food Merchant OUG @  Kenny Hills Bakers 】 📍地址: WCity OUG Sales Gallery, Lot PT 15210, Jalan Awan Besar, Taman Overseas United, 58200 Kuala Lumpur ☎️联络号码：0379712898 ⏰营业时间：8AM - 10PM 🚗Google Map https://goo.gl/maps/heToQhRXRvu4Toga6 📷图片来源: 部分图片取自于网络，若有侵权请告知，谢谢 广告商务合作请电邮：eatfunplayfun@gmail.com  ➕关注享吃享玩获取更多美食旅游资讯及好康 Insta🔗 instagram.com/eatfunplayfun Tik Tok🔗tiktok.com/@eatfunplayfun YouTube🔗youtube.com/c/享吃享玩EatFunPlayFun 小红书🔗https://bit.ly/3AKaIDQ #KennyHillsBakery #KennyHillsCoffee #OUG #KualaLumpur #BakeryCafe #Pastries #Coffee #Strudel #Croissant #EatFunPlayFun #咖啡馆 #吉隆坡 #美食推荐 #去哪吃 #大马美食 #享吃享玩

description: 🖤   🌟 新開幕 一人$1250 豪華雙人房 高CP值 桃園大溪住宿 慕杉居 豪華雙人房（附浴缸）無早餐 平日最低$2500 /晚～ 在秋冬的季節，慕杉居周邊的自然美景與人文歷史交織， 特別適合安排一場兩天一夜的小旅行。 可以前往月眉人工濕地生態公園、中庄吊橋看看桃園的秋冬美景！ 🖤  房型介紹 🖤   我非常喜歡慕杉居房間內的色調設計。 整體以黑色、米色和灰色為基底， 營造出一種現代而典雅的氛圍。 入住慕杉居豪華雙人房配備一張加大雙人床， 房內設有舒適的浴缸，讓人倍感放鬆。 窗外的景色更是令人驚艷，能夠直接俯瞰到著名的中庄吊橋， 無論是白天還是夜晚，都是一幅美麗的畫面。 床墊的軟硬度適中，優質的睡眠，醒來時精神飽滿。 最讓我感到滿意的是，寢具完全沒有消毒水的味道， 這一點讓我倍感安心，讓整個住宿體驗更加分。 廁所配備了高效的抽風機，具備換氣、暖房及乾燥功能， 這讓整體使用體驗大大提升。 特別是在寒冷的冬季，可以安心享受洗澡的樂趣，不再擔心受寒。 抽風機的暖房功能能迅速提升室內溫度， 在洗澡時感受到舒適的熱度， 而乾燥功能則能有效排除潮濕，保持空氣清新。 如浴時，無論是想要悠閒地浸泡在浴缸中， 還是快速清潔的淋浴，這裡都能滿足需求。 邊泡湯還能邊眺望大漢溪，真的是非常愜意呀！ 請注意因政府規定114年一次性用品旅宿業將不再提供唷～ 🖤 大廳環境 🖤   慕杉居的大廳展現了極致的清新自然氛圍， 無論從哪個角度拍攝，都能捕捉到其獨特的美感。 這裡的木質感牆面散發出溫暖的質感， 搭配生機盎然的綠植，讓人彷彿置身於大自然的懷抱中。 大廳的整潔與明亮，讓每一個細節都顯得格外迷人， 無論是晨光中的柔和光影，還是黃昏時的溫暖色調， 都能呈現出不同的美麗畫面。 店內可愛的店狗森森更是增添了不少活力與親切感， 牠的親人性格讓每位來訪者都能感受到無比的溫暖。 🖤  會議空間 🖤   慕杉居的二樓提供寬敞的會議空間， 適合各類會議和活動的舉行。 這裡配備了白板、板擦和白板筆， 還提供投影機，能夠輕鬆展示資料和視覺內容， 提升會議的效率和效果。 房間內的桌椅設計新穎，為與會者提供舒適的座位， 讓每位參與者都能專注於會議內容。 🖤  用餐環境 🖤   用餐區的採光極佳，讓人可以在明亮的環境中享受美食， 窗外的景色更為用餐增添了愉悅的氛圍。 這裡設有飲料與咖啡機，方便住客隨時取用。 慕杉居有提供中式、西式。中式早餐以白粥為主， 搭配多樣的配料，如醬瓜、花生、肉鬆、麵筋、蔬菜、荷包蛋等等， 讓每位食客都能根據自己的口味調整。 西式早餐則提供了卡拉雞腿堡、薯條 ～ 還不知道要去哪裡走春，歡迎來桃園玩呀！！ 趕緊訂房訂起來吧！ _____________🅘🅝🅕🅞_____________ 慕杉居 ♥ 官網｜https://www.moonshineinn.com.tw/ ♥ 地址｜335桃園市大溪區信義路525巷10弄371號 ♥ 電話｜03 387 8310 #慕杉居 #桃園飯店 #桃園住宿 #桃園大溪 #桃園大溪住宿 #大溪 #桃園 #月眉人工濕地生態公園

description: Color Stacked Frames: A Tower of Balance and Boldness #neworleans #hiddengems #nola #citypark #thingstodo #magical #sculptures #sculptureart #gems   Bold. Blocky. Unapologetically vibrant. “Colored Stacked Frames” by Sean Scully might look like a playful sculpture made of oversized building blocks—but don’t be fooled. This stainless steel tower is carefully crafted to be both powerful and poetic, standing tall in the peaceful greenery of City Park’s Sculpture Garden. Each colored slab is stacked with intention, just slightly offset, creating a sense of movement and tension while still feeling grounded. Scully is known for his abstract work that blends structure and emotion, and this piece captures that perfectly. The colors—deep reds, mustard yellows, forest greens, midnight blues—are more than paint. They represent memory, conflict, harmony, and identity. But what truly elevates this piece is its setting. You don’t just walk up to it—you approach it. Along a curved brick path, under oak trees dripping with Spanish moss, as dappled sunlight filters through. It feels like stepping into a hidden storybook world where color has weight and silence has meaning. It’s the contrast that makes it hit—this modern, industrial form rising up in a space shaped by nature and time. It doesn’t clash. It converses. If you’re into art that surprises you with its strength, color that makes you pause, and a setting that feels straight out of a dream, this one’s for you. Follow me for more vibrant gems, peaceful paths, and art that quietly demands your attention in the heart of New Orleans.

description: The Bagel Factory：最靠近关卡的宝藏咖啡馆 在新山寻觅美食的旅程中，偶然发现了这家隐世宝藏——The Bagel Factory。从店名就能猜到，这里的主角是贝果！但没想到，看似简单的贝果竟能被玩出如此多花样：从甜口到咸口，从经典到创意，每一款都让人惊艳。这次一口气尝遍五款贝果配三杯饮品，直接刷新了我对贝果的认知！   🍩 甜口贝果：每一口都是幸福感 1️⃣ **Pistachio Cheesecake（开心果芝士蛋糕）**      - 咬下瞬间，开心果的浓郁坚果香与芝士的绵密奶香交织，仿佛在吃一块会呼吸的贝果版芝士蛋糕！表面撒满的开心果碎增添酥脆感，甜而不腻，堪称下午茶搭档。   2️⃣ 黑芝麻巴斯克配麻糬    - 黑芝麻控必点！贝果夹着黑芝麻巴斯克馅，香气直冲天灵盖，中间还藏着Q弹麻糬，口感层次超丰富。黑芝麻的微苦与麻糬的甜糯平衡得刚刚好。 3️⃣ Jun's Organic Farm Marmalade（柑橘果酱贝果）    - 清新的柑橘果酱搭配原味奶油芝士，酸甜中透出淡淡奶香，像夏日微风拂过舌尖。 🥯 **咸口贝果：咸香与创意的双重暴击**   1️⃣ **Smoked Salmon with Scallions Cream Cheese（烟熏三文鱼葱香奶油芝士）**      - 烟熏三文鱼的咸鲜与香葱奶油芝士的浓郁融合！三文鱼柔嫩油润，奶油芝士丝滑带一丝葱香辛辣，贝果烤得微微焦脆，每一口都充满高级感，像在吃贝果版Brunch。   Scallop Aglio Olio  蒜香橄榄油炒制的意面搭配鲜嫩扇贝，蒜香浓郁、海鲜弹牙！吃完超满足。   ☕ **饮品：  1️⃣ Tiramisu Latte（提拉米苏拿铁）    - 咖啡、鲜奶、提拉米苏奶油层层叠叠，顶部还放了一颗迷你贝果当装饰！入口先是绵密奶盖的甜，随后是咖啡的醇苦，可可粉撒得毫不手软，像在喝液体版提拉米苏。   2️⃣ All About Strawberry（全莓出击）    - 草莓控狂喜！草莓奶上面加了草莓威化和整颗鲜果，酸甜清爽   The Bagel Factory 的贝果绝非“普通面包圈”，每一款都是当天制作的。店内实木风装潢搭配暖黄灯光，随手拍都能出片，适合闺蜜下午茶或独自放空。   📍地址 The Bagel Factory 0900 - 1800 (Monday off) 下次来新山，别只盯着肉骨茶了，来The Bagel Factory解锁贝果的无限可能吧！ 🥯✨ #新山美食 #TheBagelFactory #贝果爱好者 #新山老街 #咖啡馆推荐 #新山咖啡馆 #美食探险 #贝果工厂 #提拉米苏拿铁 #草莓牛奶 #新山陈旭年 #烟熏三文鱼 #贝果控 #新山必吃 #咖啡馆生活 #美食视频 #贝果工厂新山 #新山咖啡 #贝果爱 #美食推荐 #新山美食探索

description: Hidden in the heart of Papua, Bukit Tungku Wiri rolls like waves of green velvet, soft and surreal. description: Île de Nantes is the best large-scale playground for adults and kids I’ve experienced in a long time. You could easily stay from day, to morning after - without running out of things to do 😅 It’s not just fun - there’s a huge academic presence on île de Nantes. With design schools, architecture labs, tech hubs and art everywhere, this little island is where fun, creativity, intellect and sustainability all intersect.  Nantes is really scoring high in the “I could see myself living here” category.  Here are a list of spots I visited during a full 8-hour day (next time I’m coming for nighttime activities!): • Les Machines de l’Île – Giant mechanical animals and pure imagination on display. • Magmaa Food Hall – International eats in a super cool setting.   ↳ Lunch at Moaa – Korean Soul Food (bless the midday food window). • Trempolino – A creative hub for music, events, and art that radiates raw, local energy. • ENSA Nantes – Architecture students literally shaping the future. • L’École de design Nantes Atlantique – Creativity flowing from every corridor. • Moon Walk Exhibit – Yes, I bounced on the moon.  • Hangar à Bananes – Industrial-chic strip of bars, galleries, and riverfront good vibes. • Buren’s Rings – Public art meets city skyline. • Promenade des Belvédères – Scenic walks, riverside views, and outdoor art. • Quai des Antilles – A perfect spot to end the day with a drink and a view. description: 📍Pennsylvania State Museum Learn more about the history of the Keystone state at The State Museum of Pennsylvania in Harrisburg. This museum was created in 1905 and has been collecting and preserving Pennsylvania history and culture to share with the public for the last 120 years.  With three floors and many permanent and changing exhibits, the museum is filled with rich history and culture about the state. Exhibits include mammals, anthropology, civil war, transportation, geology and more. Visitors can learn about the state history and how the area has evolved over millions of years.  Not only does the museum have several exhibits, it has a planetarium, event spaces, large play area for kids and a gift shop. The museum is open Wednesday through Sunday. Check the museum’s website for detailed hours and entry prices. description: BRUTUSロゴの生みの親。アートディレクターで絵本作家、堀内誠一の展覧会が立川でスタート 絵本作家として『ぐるんぱのようちえん』『オズの魔法使い』などの名作を遺し、「anan」「POPEYE」「BRUTUS」などの雑誌ロゴをデザインしたことでも知られる堀内誠一。そんな彼の多彩な功績を紹介する展覧会が、立川〈PLAY！MUSEUM〉で開催中だ。 本展は、「FASHION」「FANTASY」「FUTURE」の3テーマで構成。創刊から49号までアートディレクションを手がけた雑誌『anan』にフォーカスしたブースや、絵本作家としての歩みを振り返る展示まで、その幅広い活躍を見ることができる。 会場内には、絵本の世界に紛れ込んだような『ぐるんぱのようちえん』の祝祭広場も登場。絵本を手に取って読めるスペースが設けられ、子どもから大人まで楽しめる展覧会になっている。 【堀内誠一展 FASHION・FANTASY・FUTURE】 会期：2025年1月22日〜4月6日 会場：PLAY！MUSEUM 住所：東京都立川市緑町3-1 GREEN SPRINGS W3 2F 開館時間：10:00～17:00（土日祝〜18:00） 休館日：2月16日 #BRUTUS #magazine #堀内誠一 #堀内誠一展 #playmuseum #立川

description: Gasparilla Island, Florida. 🏝️ Prettiest Island in the States!  ——————————————— #traveltiktok #island #vibes #travel #florida #fypシ  ——————————————— Key Highlights of Gasparilla Island: 1. Boca Grande The main town on the island, Boca Grande, is quaint and historic. Known for its old Florida feel, with charming streets, boutique shops, and golf carts as the main mode of transportation. Popular with celebrities and seasonal residents seeking privacy and luxury without the glitz. 2. Pristine Beaches Gasparilla boasts some of the most beautiful, quiet beaches in Florida. Soft white sand, turquoise water, and a peaceful atmosphere. Excellent for shelling, swimming, sunbathing, and spectacular sunsets. 3. Gasparilla Island State Park Offers walking trails, picnic areas, and access to scenic lighthouse beaches. The Port Boca Grande Lighthouse (built in 1890) is a must-see and includes a small museum. Great for nature lovers and bird watchers. 4. Tarpon Fishing Capital Boca Grande Pass is world-famous for tarpon fishing, especially in spring and early summer. Attracts anglers from all over the world. 5. No High-Rises or Chains Gasparilla Island is deliberately preserved — no fast food, no high-rise hotels, no big box stores. Luxury is present, but in a low-key, elegant way. 6. Accessibility Accessible by car via the Boca Grande Causeway (a toll bridge) from the mainland. Closest airports: Punta Gorda Airport, Fort Myers (RSW), and Sarasota-Bradenton International. Fun Fact: The Pirate Legend The island is named after the legendary pirate José Gaspar ("Gasparilla"), who supposedly terrorized the Gulf Coast in the 1700s. Though the legend is more folklore than fact, it's part of the island’s mystique and local lore. Hands down best island in the United States! 🤩

description: A new cafe within Chinese Garden of Jurong Lake Garden 🌳  📍 Eden Cafe  🥊 PRO TIPS • Getting there by car: Eden Cafe is about a 25 minute walk from the North Carpark • Getting there by public transport: A 7 minute walk from the Chinese Garden MRT station • Don’t miss out on their refreshing drinks! I recommend the ‘Sakura Lychee’ and ‘Osmanthus, Wolfberry, and Pear’, which are both packed with lots of jellies and toppings!  • They are family-friendly with an extensive kids menu + pet-friendly outdoors They offer a wide range of dishes, from classic all day brunch, fusion local mains and even traditional Singaporean kaya toast!  What I tried  ⭐️ Creamy Avocado & Buttermilk Fried Cod Fish Pasta Fresh pasta in a light and slightly herbaceous creamy avocado sauce, topped with thin battered crispy codfish. Simple but delicious.  ⭐️ Rendang Burger (❤️) A hefty, spice-driven juicy rendang-infused beef patty is sandwiched between 2 buttered charcoal burger buns in this interesting Rendang Burger. I found this dish really satisfying, with a confident display of rich flavours balanced with acidity from slices of tomato. Would definitely recommend this! ⭐️ Nyonya Mee Siam (❤️) Tangy rice vermicelli topped with sliced chicken and egg in a sweet, sour and ever so lightly spicy tamarind gravy. A classic Singaporean breakfast! ⭐️ Truffle Infused Fries The simple tried and true classic, sprinkled with parmesan.  ⭐️ Chicken Dumplings  Steamed dumplings with a dense and juicy chicken filling.  ⭐️ Ice Cream They have an ice cream kiosk right outside, with rows of delicious and unique ice cream flavours calling out your name. Highly recommend their Ondeh Ondeh ice cream if you’re up for something a little different from the usual— a delightful mix of sweet pandan, coconut and palm sugar syrup, scattered with generous amounts of sticky and chewy rice cakes! I loved this. Otherwise, their Passionfruit Raspberry Sorbet was extremely refreshing in the afternoon heat.  Overall, definitely a great option if you’re looking for lunch in the gardens!  Have you been to Chinese Garden?

description: 当我亲眼见到未来主义 Башня-лаборатория ЦНИИ робототехники и технической кибернетики 机器人与技术控制论中央研究所塔式实验室 起源： 1968年1月29日，技术控制论特别设计局（OKБ TK）成立。 OKБ TK参与了联盟号飞船软着陆控制系统的开发（软着陆控制系统、生命支持系统等仍在为联盟号供应）。1986年至1987年，该研究所参与了用于辐射侦察和清理切尔诺贝利核电站事故后果的移动机器人的创建和操作，并在20世纪90年代初参与创建了用于核电站事故后果的机器人操纵器系统。暴风雪号宇宙飞船。 现为中央机器人和技术控制论研究所（ЦИНН PTK）。 建筑： 研究所综合大楼由两栋实验室和生产大楼组成。该建筑群的主要特征是一座 77米高的塔楼，其天线塔高近 105米。该塔是测试空间技术的实验室。 建筑的构成基于水平体积的鲜明对比和突出的塔楼体积，是苏联未来主义建筑的经典。建筑站尖锐的“肋骨”赋予其宇宙般的外观，同时营造出带有肋骨和尖锐尖顶的哥特式大教堂的形象。 塔楼形状复杂的单个面板是在列宁格勒用膨胀粘土混凝土专门制造的，并得到了国家建设委员会的特别许可。 设计师： Лопота Виталий Александрович 建造日期：1973-1987 图片均为本人在参观时拍摄© 拍摄于2024年6月 #建築 #摄影 #建筑摄影 #建筑设计 #苏联 #苏联建筑 #未来 #未来主义 #夢核

description: The Wobbling Collage This is a mix of all kinds of bird sounds—some are completely synthetic and generative, while others are real bird songs. I brought them together into one space, layering everything on tape to create this collage. These birds are fresh takes on something I’ve been working on for years. I reprogrammed them specifically for The Cloud Orchestra, my sound installation that was featured last November at Walt Disney Concert Hall in LA. description: Where is the water born, and to what forgotten dream does it surrender? In Sâmbăta Valley, it tears through the womb of the mountains, a silver serpent lashing against stone, unbothered by the centuries it devours. The hills around heave with an obscene green, pulsing with the rude vigor of life just uncaged. Sheep, ragged phantoms stitched from wool and earth, begin their solemn crawl upward, trudging into mist and myth, as if pulled by an invisible thread older than memory itself. This is no pastoral lullaby, no soft-focus daydream for catalogues and cowards. It’s a bruised, magnificent theatre where every rock, every gnarled root, every gasping leaf testifies to a wilderness that neither needs you nor apologizes for your discomfort. The stream snarls and moans against the stones like a chained beast, indifferent to your thirst for spectacle. Above, the air grows thinner, the trees more gnarled, the silence stitched tight with the soft dirge of sheep-bells — a funeral march for the part of you that forgot how to listen. When did we become so small we feared the wildness that made us? When did beauty become something to consume instead of endure? If you stood barefoot in this valley, skin bared to the raw breath of the mountains, what would be left of you — and would it be enough? description: 上次跟媽媽一起去 #文化部文化資產園區 走走，意外發現一個限定期間的免費藝文特展——【發現第一人-臺中站】 此特展相當有趣，是一個關於「找尋臺灣史前第一人」的考古探險之旅，主要分為五大主題，以下簡要分享： 首先透過形態學與生物人類學的研究探討，匹配人骨外型表面等痕跡找出【1.誰是第一人？】；史前第一人出土地後，周圍開始發掘探討，結合地質學、古生物學等多領域考古相關領域的學者來推測出【2.第一人在哪裡？】包含當時生活與環境的樣貌。 接著從史前第一人骨骼體內、周邊等區域，藉由生態遺留學分析出【3.第一人吃什麼？】，從遺骸推測當時的食物種類；隨著科技與研究技術進步，雖然出土的第一人已成白骨，但透過法醫的修復面貌技術以及考古學和民族學等各領域專家攜手合作，還是成功推測出【4.第一人長什麼樣？】，包含大致的髮型膚色或面容比例等等。 最後跟大家分享【5. 為什麼會發現第一人？】其實展區內的答覆還蠻有趣實在的，因為考古挖掘的文物，一旦出土就無法復原甚至可能遭受破壞，因「文化資產保存法」的關係不得已馬上啟動修復發掘與文物認證的工作，因此這位臺灣史前第一人只是臺灣目前恰好最先找到的出土保存的人物或人群。是否還有更早時代的人，我想這也是不無可能～～ 看到這邊……我想很多人應該都一頭霧水了🥹，如果展覽就這麼生硬的把考古資訊呈現給大家，我想……可能只有真心喜愛相關領域的觀展人才會細細咀嚼並領悟到這些資訊。 細心的文化部文化資產局也有想到這層面，所以在展區內設計了非常多有趣好玩的互動體驗活動，無論男女老少，各年齡層的族群都能在玩樂中學習！ · 人骨拼拼看：讓觀展人嘗試拼回分解的人體骨骼，以此體驗研究學者在修復出土人骨的過程（展方已經算很客氣了沒有把206根骨頭全分解😂）。 · 工作室徵才：讓觀展人試著從骨骼、肌肉紋理、皮膚到感官等，按順序拼湊出完整的面容，也能從中體會研究學者在面部修復上的不易。 ·創造特有塚：在挖掘當時人群的生活飲食殘骸中，很常發現由貝類堆積出的貝塚，貝塚中有非常多不一樣紋路外形的貝殼，觀展人可以挑自己喜歡的貝殼外型，繪畫出屬於自己的貝塚～畫完還能掃描保留到投影幕上做紀念呦！ · 史前生存之道：在迷宮中有設置各種蓋章關卡，集滿所有印章就能到櫃檯服務處兌換小貼紙，在每個蓋章處與道路中都放置了各種教學展示板，包含介紹當時常使用的獵捕工具，以及當時常食用的動物魚類等，帶領各位觀展人成為史前文化生存大師。 讓我印象深刻的便是這個仿造Minecraft 麥塊的迷宮探險，做工真的非常精緻相似，甚至連火把都做的非常好（好想帶一隻火把回家當小夜燈🥹） 除了互動體驗的區域，其實在考古資訊呈現上，也規劃許多考古出土的實體文物、影片以及圖片等非文字內容，不同的展示方式讓整個特展更加豐富多元！ 離開前還能掃描QRcode填寫參展問卷，填完也能到服務台領取非常可愛的擬真卡尺筆～（數量有限，以現場送完為止） 可惜我太晚參觀到，目前離展覽結束僅剩不到一個月，趕工產出希望能讓更多人知道這個好玩、有趣又富有學習價值的考古成果特展！趁著還沒開學，趕緊揪朋友、帶著小朋友一起來文化部文化資產園區發現臺灣史前第一人吧～～ *以上關於展覽的介紹資訊，皆為參展後結合個人心得闡述，僅供參考，詳細完整內容請以展方為主。 🔍特展資訊 【發現第一人-臺中站】 期間 ☞ 2024.09.17～2025.03.02 時間 ☞︎ 9:00-17:00/週一不開放//免費入場 地址 ☞ 文化部文化資產園區B03 DC棟（臺中市南區復興路三段362號）  #台中展覽 #台中文創園區 #特展 #免門票景點 #免門票 #免門票入場 #免費展覽

description: ♾️⭐️ I just found my top read of the year. Shield of Sparrows is pure, all-consuming magic, both literally and figuratively. This book was absolutely incredible, I truly have no other words. I went into this book completely blind, and I really urge you to do the same so you can experience all of it the way I just did.  This was my very first romantasy and my very first Devney book, and I feel like the course of my life has been altered, I’m being so serious. I didn’t want to sleep or eat, ALL I wanted to do was stay glued to these pages. Devney said it best when she said this book is first and foremost a romance, and god was it beautiful. The banter, the mystery, the magic, the tension, the secrecy, the plot twists—all of it was done so well that I truly could not think about anything else. The world building and character arcs were also just brilliant. I never felt lost and I could picture these characters and scenes so vividly that it made reading all the more intriguing. I don’t think there was a single emotion I didn’t feel while reading this book, and when I say this is a must read, I mean it! I cannot wait for book two and to be back in this world!! tysm to @Entangled Publishing , @Red Tower Books, and Devney for the arc🤍 #shieldofsparrows #romantasy #devneyperry #redtowerbooks #enemiestolovers #slowburn #romancebooktok #spicybooktok

description: NOT TATSUYA, NOT KINOKYNIYA — YOU GUYS KNOWWWW i wouldn’t say this lightly abt places ive been visiting⁉️🫵 GENUINELY CANT BELIEVE we FOUNDDD this aesthetic (HIDDEN GEM) in the middle of that ABANDONED lookalike place at KL 😭 . rating this hidden gems of bookstore in KL for 9/10 🏅😍 WOULD DEFINITELY COME BACK to run away from the busy KL⁉️  . • spoke to both workers there and LMAO their english have an UK accent?! they genuinely sounds very well educated TBH (one of them was writing LETTER when i came in 😭 like? SWEET HOPELESS ROMANTIC SOUL 🥹) • gratefully, they let me work their for a while with their wifi and on their bean bag! ah i genuinely wish they sell coffee and pastries 🏅🏅 • THE MOST LOWKEYY and HUMBLE bookstore with pretty design in this year TBH (did you see the way they arrange their sitting place? WHICH PLACE LET US USE THEIR BEAN BAG FOR FREE and READ⁉️) • ambience, aesthetic was 10/10 ✅ EMPTY SPOTS! Lord, it was only me, my friend and 2 of the workers 🥹🥹 FEEELL SUPER RELAXING to have a quick work and chat with them and get to know the place • interestingly, they have both VINTAGE THRIFT RARE BOOKS and also new books⁉️ they must be a reader fr fr • fun fact, the owner previously closed the bookstore to teman his wife do master in UK 🥹 (WHAT A LOVE STORY) and reopen it again here at this place wohooo! and proudly, they have 3 stores under different names in malaysia!  • if you see close enough, they are artworks inside the bookstore and guess what? ITS ALSO FOR SALE (by request only)  • best thing about this place is that they sometimes would have a coffee vendor (if theres an event), and accepting event gathering! if you guys have a brand and want to use their place, U SHOULD DEF HIT THEM UP thru emails (my book lovers bestie that have its own BOOK CLUB must be screaming looking at this cute place⁉️)  • imagine having PRIVATE BOOK CLUB event here 😭😭 OHHH I - • oh BESTIES, save this post and RUN bcs its MRT REACHABLE. go support them bestie! its MALAYSIA BOOKSHOP REPRESENT HAHA  . • also guys, im doing honest review for all the places ive been, if its good ill tell you its good, if its not, I WONT EVEN highlight it in this account (even if they pay me :() i only want the best for my audience; so u guys dont need to worry abt authenticity 💓 • for PR / paid collab / paid partnership for review, slide to my dm 💌🧿 muahhh . #hiddengems #bookstores #bookshop #booktok #vintage #placestovisit #placestotravel #klhiddengems #cafehoppingmalaysia #klthriftstore #kualalumpur #bookclub

description: One of the most mesmerising places we got to have coffee in Okinawa! There are only 9 tables by the window, and you’d have to book yourself a seat and wait for your number to be called to get that spot right by the amazing Kuroshio Sea Tank!  We would definitely suggest heading to the cafe area first to book a slot, right when you get into the Okinawa Churaumi Aquarium, before going back to walking around the exhibits! You’d also only have your table for 40 mins and the cafe closes at 6pm 🐋 📍 Ocean Blue Cafe, Okinawa Churaumi Aquarium A little thought: while I completely agree that as many animals as possible should be left in the oceans, it is also important to consider that many people can only learn about these animals through exhibits like the Kuroshio Sea Tank! Jinta the Whale Shark, continues to hold the world record for being reared in an aquarium, and has led to the understanding of the ecology and reproduction of whale sharks, benefitting the conservations of these magnificent creatures! #okinawa #cafe #okinawaaquarium #churaumiaquarium #churaumi #whaleshark #okinawatrip #okinawacafe #japan #eshton #creatorsearchinsights

description: Every first of the month, and some times on the new moon, my mother would write herself a check, wipe the windowsills and doors down burn cinnamon, and cloves, and read a psalms to her liking. I would never have considered this as who do or any kind of magic. This was just what we did. Seeing the movie #sinners showed me that Black people have a collective, knowing through our rituals and remedies. I created my ancestral kitchen because I wanted my daughter to always be able to find herself and find her way back to her ancestors ways. It’s such a beautiful thing to see so much of what we kept quiet out loud on the screen. Here’s to my mother, my father, my grandmother’s and grandfather’s. Here’s to my descendants and here’s to you. Go blow and burn a little cinnamon. Write yourself a check. Say a Psalms to your liking. Listen and see if there’s anything else that needs to be done. Trust me you know what you’re doing.

description: HIDDEN GEMS OF NYC: Museum of Nostalgia  Part Museum. Part Toy Shop. All Fun! Welcome to the Museum of Nostalgia. Step into the Museum of Nostalgia — where childhood memories come to life. Here, you can immerse yourself in the enchanting world of nostalgia and take a trip down memory lane through toys. From Cabbage Patch Kids to Transformers, and everything in between, If you grew up with toys, lunch boxes, board games, and quirky memorabilia, this shop is a dream. Museum of Nostalgia is a treasure trove of nostalgia, especially from the ‘70s, ‘80s, and beyond.  How did it start? Local owners Phoebe and Jeff are lifelong toy collectors who wanted to find a way to share their collection and interests with the public (and make space in their crowded apartment)! After being told by friends to create something with their collection, they finally listened - and opened the Museum. The collection is part museum and part toy shop. One side is for display only, and organized in a museum-style exhibition of vintage toys and games with small cards denoting the toy’s history. This museum portion was designed to resemble a retro living room with a plastic-covered couch, old TVs, and wood paneling.  The other side of the experience is a retail space, organized by sections, with a plethora of vintage toys and artifacts with nearly every toy you can imagine.  In the back of the store you will find a couple of arcade games and even a play area for kids. It is epic and a space that brings back memories and sparks joy for “big kids” of all ages. We spent over an hour here, and I wanted to stay longer. A must-visit for the full nostalgia experience! 💫 Thanks for creating this magic, Jeff and Phoebe!  WHERE: 📍31-27 31 Street. Astoria, NY  WHEN: ⏰Typically 12-7, but Hours fluctuate. Check their instagram page for weekly schedule updates. PRICE: 🎟️Free to enter!  GOOD TO KNOW: 📕Can’t make it to the store? The Museum of Nostalgia has an eBay shop - a great way to buy treasures online! @museumofnostalgia #MuseumOfNostalgia #VintageToys #ToyCollectors #80sVibes #NostalgiaTrip #QueensNYC

description: Budget Roadtrip Asie – Partie 1 💸 Vous avez été nombreux·ses à nous demander combien on a dépensé… voici la première partie du budget de notre trip ! ✅ 🇹🇭 Thaïlande – 1 mois (Visa gratuit) 1260€/pers On a débuté par le Nord puis on est descendue à Bangkok pour Noël, en finissant par le Sud. La street food est au top, les logements privés à deux sont plus rentable que les dortoirs, location de scooters pour explorer, temples & boxe thaï… et quelques plaisirs comme massages & souvenirs. 🇱🇦 Laos – 1 mois (Visa 40€) 750€/pers Voyage plus nature et slow. Bouffe locale à petit prix, chambres privées, on a loué un scooter mais les routes sont galère, les cascades & balades sont souvent gratuites. On a pas fait la boucle de Pakse, mais à noter si vous y passez. 🇲🇾 Malaisie – 1 mois (Visa gratuit) 1000€/pers Gros contraste entre villes, jungle & plages. Bouffe à un prix très correct, logements abordables, Grab/bus/scooters selon les endroits. Beaucoup de visites de temples et de zones naturelles. 🇸🇬 Singapour Universal Studio – 2 jours (une journée de parc) 371€/pers Journée à Universal Studios : cher mais ça en vaut le coup. Pass Express = pas d’attente. Le parc a ouvert en février la zone « Moi moche et méchant » on l’a raté d’une semaine 🥲  Bouffe chère, logement trouvé à côté à un prix correct si vous cherchez bien. description: 【享吃 |  吉隆坡蕉赖 | 隐藏在社区里的温馨日式咖啡馆】 偶然地在蕉赖D'Alamanda 社区里，发现一家 #日式咖啡馆🎐，其设计具现代简约日式风格🪵，装修简单走心🧡，让人很难不爱😍 《 Aki禾火的故事》： 这家咖啡馆由两位年轻夫妇Eric & Carmen经营, Aki是指秋天🍁, 而Kohi即是咖啡☕️，这名字有秋天咖啡之意🥰，因他俩去日本及台湾旅游就是偏爱一些小型咖啡馆，觉得有独特的风格，而且喜欢在秋天的季节去，加上对咖啡的喜好❤️‍🔥，就开了这家咖啡馆啦 咖啡馆的墙壁和家具均以木制简约线条🪵和米色极简风格为特色，明亮舒适的设计创造出一种简洁及温馨的氛围💕，就像回到家一样🏠，让您能够在舒适环境下品尝美味的咖啡和轻食🍰🥪🥐。 老板很用心，会亲自现场磨制及冲泡咖啡，确保您品尝到最新鲜和美味的手冲咖啡☕️，而且也会在店内烘焙蛋糕甜点🍰，所以你还会闻到阵阵的烘焙香味及咖啡香气♨️ 这里的轻食菜单包括各种色香味俱佳的面包三明治，牛角包和多种口味蛋糕甜品如海盐布朗尼🌰，咸焦糖芝士蛋糕🍰等，以及特色饮品有日式抹茶拿铁🍵，草莓抹茶拿铁，玫瑰绿煎茶，巧克力，爱尔兰咖啡，清凉柚子饮品等，让您在一天疲惫时能够放松享受一番💯。 咖啡馆的店面不大，座位不多，在这里放松身心边喝咖啡听听抒情的音乐边工作，真的格外舒服🥰。无论是和朋友聊天还是你想沉浸于一个人的自我时间都很适合来这里唷！ ℹ️星期二及星期三休业是因为有Barista 咖啡师工作坊🆒️, 咖啡爱好者和初学者若想参与工作坊，学习有趣的咖啡知识，亲自动手实践！📲请联系Aki's Kohi负责人了解详情吧 【Aki's Kohi 】 📍地址:Lot 2-00-07, Ground Floor, D'alamanda Pudu Ulu Impian IV Jalan Pudu Impian, 56100 Cheras, Kuala Lumpur 56100, KUALA LUMPUR, 56100 Cheras, Wilayah Persekutuan Kuala Lumpur ☎️电话：0163018087 ⏰营业时间：9.30am-5.30pm (星期二及三休业） 🚗Google Map https://goo.gl/maps/S8EfhZosPtcc3nsCA 📷图片来源: 部分图片取自Aki's Kohi页面 广告商务合作请电邮：eatfunplayfun@gmail.com  ➕关注享吃享玩获取更多美食旅游资讯及好康 Insta🔗 instagram.com/eatfunplayfun Tik Tok🔗tiktok.com/@eatfunplayfun 小红书🔗https://bit.ly/3AKaIDQ #AkiKohi #KualaLumpur #Cheras #Cafe #Cafehopping #KLFoodie #EatFunPlayFun #禾火 #吉隆坡咖啡馆 #好地方推荐 #KL好地方 #去哪吃 #下午茶好去处 #打卡好去处 #吉隆坡美食 #大马美食 #享吃享玩

description: (ad) NEW Tiny Tyneside Play Area in Newcastle This brand new FREE play area for under 5s has just opened at Discovery Museum. It’s free and you just need to drop in during normal museum opening hours.    Here are some of my highlights:  🛟Climb aboard mini versions of ships you’ll find in the museum - you can steer them too.  🚅Play with the LUMO train table  🚗Sit on the ride ons and follow the road markings around the floor - you can even go over a bridge. There’s a replica NISSAN and Armstrong car  🕊️Duck under a mini Tyne Bridge and press the animal noise buttons to hear local birds - the Kittiwakes certainly sound familiar  🧑‍🍳Dress up and try on different hats with jobs you’ll find in our region  🌞Play shadow puppets with the shadow puppet wall  🚧Build your own Tyne Bridge using foam blocks  🏗️Operate your very own crane and use it to pick up and move blocks around  🛞There are fidget games and puzzles to play around the area  💡Turn the crank and watch as the energy lights up a bulb  🛞Build your own machine using gears  This area WILL be busy during the next few weeks so please be patient, I expect it will quieten down a bit after the Easter hols and is definitely somewhere I would choose to meet up with friends and pre-schoolers. It’s high quality and I love all of the local references.  The rest of the Discovery Museum is FREE to visit and has baby changing facilities, a cafe with a little play area inside, a packed lunch space and other interactive areas including Steam to Green where you can play with a wind tunnel and the Science Maze where you can get hands on with science (and there’s another dedicated under 5s play area in there too).  There is limited parking on the street outside or Times Square / Grainger Town multi-story car parks are a short walk away. Discovery Museum is a super easy day out by train - Central Station (for trains and Metro) is just around the corner.  #newcastleupontyne #newcastle #northeastfamilyfun #discoverymuseum #newcastlewithkids #thingstodoinnewcastle

description: The beautiful things I see at home are always connected to the beautiful things I see in the world. 📍Ōtsuka Museum of Art | Tokushima, Japan 徳島県・大塚国際美術館 This museum, filled with full-scale ceramic reproductions of over 1,000 masterpieces from around the world, is the very place my grandmother once called “the museum that holds everything.” Despite knowing that every artwork is a replica, I found myself speechless. I stayed for hours, deeply moved—more than I ever expected. 私の祖母は世界中の美術館を訪れた人ですが、 「この美術館には、すべてがある」と絶賛していました。 すべてが複製であるにもかかわらず、私は言葉を失うほど感動して、何時間もここに滞在していました。 At the end of all the stress and noise we face in our everyday lives, isn’t it always art that gently heals us? At least for me, it always is. 日常の中で感じるストレスや雑音のすべてを静かにほどいてくれるのは、 結局いつも“芸術”ではないでしょうか。 少なくとも、私にとってはそうです。 #OtsukaMuseumOfArt #ŌtsukaMuseumOfArt #大塚国際美術館 #ArtHeals #BeautyInEverydayLife #HomeAndWorld #旅と芸術 #心がほどける場所 #日常と非日常 #祖母の記憶 #アートのある暮らし #静かな感動 #ArtIsEverywhere #感性の旅 #芸術に癒されて #VisitJapan #TokushimaTravel #JapanArtTrip #HiddenGemsJapan #JapanMuseum

description: Let’s see if the largest Barnes and Noble in North America has my book on their shelves 👀 Shout out to my sister and brother-in-law for going to visit my debut, Crash Landing, at the Barnes and Noble in Union Square during their 48 hour trip to NYC 🥰 Grateful to every bookstore who stocks it on their shelves!! Crash Landing is a funny and heartwarming debut romance about two exes forced to reunite when a plane crash leaves them stranded on a deserted island. Piper Adams is completely, totally, one hundred percent over Wyatt, the former love of her life. At least, that’s what she tells herself. After he broke her heart, she stopped taking risks and focused instead on building a perfect—and perfectly safe—life. But bumping into Wyatt at the airport on the way to her best friend’s destination wedding wasn’t part of the plan. Neither was a canceled flight nor Wyatt’s offer of a ride on the tiny plane he’s flying to attend the same event. Desperate to make it on time, she accepts his offer, but things go from awkward to full-blown nightmare when their plane crashes in the Caribbean, stranding Piper on a deserted island with the last person she ever wanted to see again. At first, rule-following Piper clashes with adventure-driven Wyatt, but as the days tick by, she can see the boy she once loved has grown into a man. A man who makes her laugh, knows his way around a fire, and is annoyingly hot shirtless. A man she could love again. As the chemistry still simmering between them boils over, Piper begins wishing Wyatt was more than just a survival partner. But for their love to survive a second chance, she’ll have to not only trust Wyatt again, but also learn to trust herself and find the courage to let go of her carefully curated life for the chance at something far greater—if they can survive the island long enough for rescue. #nyc #romancebooks #avonbooks #romcom #2025debut #secondchanceromance

description: Ever pulled a shot and ended up with a soupy mess in your portafilter? 😩 If your espresso puck is more like a muddy puddle than a firm disc, it’s time to dive into the possible causes. One of the most common culprits? A low dosage of coffee. When you use too little coffee, the water flows through the grounds too quickly, resulting in under-extraction and a watery puck. This can affect the flavor of your espresso, making it taste weak or sour. Remember, perfecting your espresso shot is a journey, and every tweak brings you one step closer to that ideal cup. Happy brewing! ☕️✨ Have you faced this issue before? What’s your go-to solution? description: THAIFEX EP 1  Watch this video till the end because you might get a business idea to start or expand your business. Let’s take a look at what International Business Opportunities are available at the ThaiFex event. ThaiFex Anuga is considered the largest food exhibition in Asia, with exhibitors from many different countries. Today, I have a mission assigned by my clients to search for several products at this event, which will be introduced to the Middle Eastern market. Since we’re already here, I’d like to take you along to explore the exhibition and see products directly from manufacturers—items we wouldn’t normally come across in regular markets. For example, one client asked me to look for halal food products, while another requested food processing machinery. I also have a factory visit scheduled to inspect the facilities and check various standards. Afterward, I’ll prepare a report and send it to the clients. So, let’s go explore together and see what interesting products are available—products that could help you enter the market in your country or inspire you to develop your own. If you’re interested in any product and want me to connect you with suppliers or compare factory quality and pricing, just send me a message. I run a company that serves as an International Business Facilitator, ready to work on your behalf in Thailand. معرض تايفيكس. الحلقة الاولي: اتفرج علي الفيديو ده لحد الآخر عشان ممكن تلاقي فكرة مشروع تبدأ بيه أو توسع بيه شغلك. هانشوف مع بعض إيه هي فرص الأعمال الدولية المتاحة في معرض "ThaiFex". ThaiFex Anuga بيعتبر أكبر معرض أكل في آسيا، فيه عارضين من دول كتيرة مختلفة. النهاردة عندي مهمة من عملائي إننا ندور على منتجات معينة في المعرض ده، واللي هتتقدم للسوق الشرق أوسطي. وبما إننا هنا، عاوز أخذكم معايا نستكشف المعرض ونشوف المنتجات مباشرة من المصنعين - حاجات مش بنلاقيها في الأسواق العادية. عشان مثال، واحد من العملاء طلب مني أدور على منتجات أكل حلال، وعامل تاني عاوز ماكينات تصنيع الأكل. عندي كمان زيارة لمصنع علشان أشوف المنشأة وأفحص المعايير المختلفة. بعد كده هأعد تقرير وأبعتوه للعملاء. فهيا بنا نستكشف مع بعض ونشوف إيه المنتجات المثيرة اللي متاحة - منتجات ممكن تساعدك تدخل السوق في بلدك أو تلهمك تطور منتج لنفسك. لو حابب أي منتج وعاوز أوصلك بالموردين أو أقارن بين جودة المصانع والأسعار، ابعتلي رسالة. أنا عندي شركة بتشتغل كوسيط أعمال دولي، وجاهزين نشتغل نيابة عنك في تايلاند. خليكوا معانا في الأجزاء الجاية، هانعرض لكم بعض من أكثر المنتجات المثيرة. #makemoney #createbusiness #thaiservice #businessservice #egyptthai #thailand #thaibusiness #thaiexport #thai import

description: I think I just found the most peaceful escape at the end of the Tube line 😍🌿 A slow day trip to Amersham (yes — the very last stop on the Metropolitan line!) 🚇🌳🍃 🚇 Metropolitan line from central London – about 50 minutes 💰 Just your regular Zone 9 fare on Oyster/contactless (£10 return tickets) Here are the things you can do in Amersham: 🎢 Spot the Metropolitan line replica train tucked near the station 🌸 Parsonage Woods + Hervines Park – peaceful trails, birdsong, and a carpet of bluebells this time of year 🛍️ Popped into local shops + delis – stocked up on pastries, cheese, and a nice cup of coffee! 🍽️ Lunch at @thekingsarmsamersham – cosy, historic, and full of character. Plus, fun fact: parts of Four Weddings and a Funeral were filmed here! 🌺 Memorial Gardens – full of blooming flowers and tucked-away benches 🏛️ Amersham Market Hall – that iconic little building in the centre of Old Amersham. ⛪ St Mary’s Church – peaceful grounds, centuries of history, and the kind of quiet stillness that makes you want to pause and wander slowly. ☕ @seasonscafedeli – the perfect cake + coffee break before heading uphill again. Warm, welcoming, and full of locals. 🏡  @bekonscotofficial Model Village (a short hop away in Beaconsfield) – miniature scenes, working model trains, and so much nostalgic charm. Worth the quick detour if you have time! 🚶‍♀️ @chilternoam – past leafy streets and straight into living history. Traditional buildings, old cottages, and a proper green escape. 📌 Save this for when you want nature, calm, and a slow, simple day — all without leaving the Tube map 🌿💜 . . . . description: Have you been to São Paulo! 🇧🇷 São Paulo, Brazil’s largest city, is a dynamic mix of culture, art, and energy! description: secangkir kopi susu ☕ ditengah riuhnya pagi di sebuah ruangan kantor,  "sekarang ini aku sedang sangat menikmati secangkir kopi susu yang ku beli dari kedai kemarin. ternyata dia punya kawan kerja yang tak kalah cantik. pantas saja  hampir setiap pagi kau kesana. rupanya kedai itu mempunyai banyak pelayan yang cantik." sambil tersenyum lebar memegang secangkir kopi susu hangat dia berkata pada kawannya.  "aku ikut senang atas apa yang kamu sukai saat ini, tapi untuk ku tak berubah setiap paginya segelas kopi hitam dan empat potong roti bakar selai manis cukup untuk mengawali hariku." dengan tenang dan perlahan tanggapan itu terucap.  "cobalah besok kau mengagetkan dia yang biasa membuatkan menu mu dengan memesan yang lain. mungkin kau akan mendapatkan sebuah langkah baru bagaimana mengenal wanita tersebut." lanjutnya setelah meminum sedikit kopi itu, "ayolah beranikan dirimu untuk ajak dia keluar dan saling mengenal, kau sudah cukup lama hanya menatapnya kan?" tertegun sejenak dengan apa yang di dengar, pria itu menjawab dengan keraguan, "apakah harus aku melakukan semua itu? jika aku harus mengenalnya dengan menggunakan hal yang tidak biasa ku lakukan apakah dia akan benar mengenalku? dan apakah aku nantinya akan benar-benar mengenalnya dengan baik? aku ragu untuk memulai berbicara lebih lanjut tentang arti dari tatapanku." sambil menghela sejenak dan meminum kopi hitamnya, "biar aku menikmati masa dimana aku tak berani melangkah dan mungkin harus bersiap jika memang keputusan ini memberi dampak lain seperti yang hanya aku inginkan. mungkin tidaklah buruk secangkir kopi hitam yang sudah mendingin untuk tetap di nikmati." secangkir kopi susu☕ #coffee #coffestory #mindfulness #friendship #reflexion

description: It’s Independent Bookshop Week! ✨📚 I wanted to share a few of my favourite bookshops in Singapore! 🇸🇬 1) @BookBarSG — they’re nestled along Duxton Rd. They have a wide range of books on Singapore & Asian Literature. It’s also a very cosy place to chill and have a drink/coffee. They also host various book events; book launches and silent reading. I know that i can count on this bookstore if i ever wanted a place to unwind 😌 2) @Epigram Books — known for being the first bookshop in Singapore to focus on Singaporean titles (i love how they have a wide range of fic & non-fic books) and i must say, their coffee is so good! I love their coffee menu! ☕️📚 if you’re going to @singaporeartmuseum, make sure to drop by epigram bookshop! 3) @letsbommoi — a cute and quaint korean bookstore + cafe along Armenian Street. Their collection features enchanting Korean picture books for children, plus a variety of translated works. The exceptionally friendly owner welcomed me with a warm “안녕하세요” 🥹 love the cosy space too! 4) @Basheer Graphic — located at Bras Basah Complex. I love their variety of art books! If you’re an art, fashion, interior design student, i highly recommend to visit this bookstore! 🎨 5) Evernew Bookstore — One of my most favourite secondhand bookstores! Located at Bras Basah Complex. The books are affordable and they’re always restocking books.🤩 6) Ana Bookstore — another secondhand bookstore located at Far East Plaza. it’s quite a small space and when you enter the store, you might feel overwhelmed by the amount of books and how it’s all stacked together but trust me, this is the beauty of going into a secondhand bookstore. You just don’t know what you might find! The uncle is so friendly and somehow he just knows where the books are if we ask him for a certain title! ☺️ I’m absolutely thankful to have these bookstores in Singapore. As we all know, the physical book realm is slowly dying in a world where e-books & audiobooks are becoming increasingly popular. description: I’ll be exhibiting my installation piece ‘Lens’ as a part of @isquaredgallery’s exhibition, Sap. The exhibition will feature over 20 talented local artists and designers for an immersive exploration of the transformation of the seasons. Launch is this Saturday eve at 1/29 tinning st Brunswick. I’ll be selling prints from this work too! A special thank you to Mon ( @mon_ikr on Instagram) for creating the incredible audio, it captures the feeling of the video perfectly. <3    Set against an autumnal backdrop, ‘Lens’ explores the tension between change and stasis, within an age of hyper-individualism. While seasons shift, the world at large remains locked in a recursive loop - mirroring a system of algorithmic feedback, where socially and culturally, nothing truly new emerges. As society becomes digitally atomized, we no longer engage with each other through shared narratives, but rather through predetermined fragments of information. With algorithms tailoring everything to our personal preference, we are led towards a frictionless existence where discomfort is smoothed away. The act of choice has become meaningless, as a digital spectre shapes our desires before we articulate them. ‘Lens’ reflects upon this duality of our present moment: an increasingly chaotic external world versus the refined, internal reality of the individual. Ultimately, in our frenetic chase of total autonomy and self-optimization, we lose sight of the things that make life meaningful—community, uncertainty, and transformation. #videoart #video #art #animation #illustration#typography #exhibition #adamcurtis #electronic #ambient #hauntology #lofiart #lofi #digitalart

description: #泡泡阅读app “先，先生…”少年縮在上鎖的臥室角落，看著眼前步步逼近的男人，“我錯了，我不敢跑了…”就在剛剛，本以為已擺脫禁錮的少年輕而易舉便被男人抓住了。回私宅的路上，少年已經預料到了後果，可真正要面對時，他還是不自覺身體發抖。“為什麼要走？” 男人蹲身下來，溫凉的指尖捏住少年的下顎。少年咬唇，一時間說不出話來了。看著男人嘴角不悅的弧度，少年眼睛紅潤得更加厲害了，低頭不敢和男人對視，“因為，您要…結婚了…”少年嗓子發哽，“您答應過，不會讓我做…三的…”這次沉默的變成那個男人了。片刻，男人將少年的頭又挑高些，讓他能看清這張漂亮的臉。這個小東西他養在身邊兩年了，這小傢伙一點也沒變，乖乖的，膽子又很小。男人從抽屜裏拿出了一早準備好婚禮請柬。 “打開看看。”少年的手在發抖，讓他坦然接受自己愛的人要結婚了，殘忍又冷酷…看清請柬上新人署名的位置，少年愣住了。就聽男人沉聲接著道，“我的確要結婚了，但我的另一半卻想逃婚了…”一次次確認請柬上自己的名字，少年鑽進男人懷裡，再也忍不住痛哭…#foryou #小说 #bl #耽美 #scenery

description:
🎀 “Singapo人” Exhibition — turns out, I’m this kind of Singaporean too! Ever wondered what makes someone a “Singapore-style Chinese”? Just one visit and you’ll get it! 📍 Level 2, Singapore Chinese Cultural Centre This interactive exhibition uses games, videos, audio, and more to explore our language, festivals, values, and pop culture — helping us see how our everyday life is what defines a “Singapo人”. 👀 So many moments of nostalgia — from childhood TV shows to dialects our grandparents speak, and our own take on what “home” and “success” mean. 🕒 Opening hours: Mon: 2PM–8PM｜Tue–Sun: 10AM–8PM (Open on public holidays too!) 💰 Free admission 📌 Mandarin tours: Sat & Sun, 4PM 📌 English tours: Sat & Sun, 3PM 📸 Super aesthetic and perfect for photos! Come with your family or friends and share your stories together. #Singapo人 #fyp #fypage #foryoupage #foryoupageofficiall #fypシ゚ #fyppppppppppppppppppppppp #foryoupagе #exhibition #singapore #genz #SingaporeChineseCulturalCentre #FreeExhibition #LocalCulture #ThingsToDoInSingapore  #SGHeritage 🎀《Singapo人》展览｜原来我也是这样“新加坡人”
 什么是“新加坡式华人”？
 大家来一次就懂了！
 
 📍新加坡华族文化中心 Level 2 的《Singapo人》展览
 用互动装置、影视、语音、游戏
 带你从语言、节日、价值观、流行文化
 重新认识我们的日常
 原来我们熟悉的一切——
 就是“Singapo人”的样子。
 
 👀 很多展区都有“共鸣时刻”
 你会看到小时候看过的电视、
 长辈讲的方言，还有我们自己对“家”“成功”的定义。
 
 📅 开放时间：
 Mon 2PM–8PM｜Tue–Sun 10AM–8PM
 （公共假期也开放）
 📍 地点：新加坡华族文化中心 Level 2
 💰 免费入场
 📌 华语导览：每周六日 4PM～5PM
 📌 英语导览：每周六日 3PM～4PM
 
 📸 整个展览设计感很强，也很适合拍照打卡哦～
 推荐跟家人朋友一起来，聊聊彼此的故事。 
 #新加坡展览 #Singapo人 #新加坡华族文化中心 #文化共鸣 #免费展览 #新加坡文化 #本地好去处 #探索自己

description: Tampines Quarry is an untamed site that lacks directional signage and is not clearly marked on Google Maps. It is a serene oasis that provides a tranquil escape from the hustle and bustle of the city, with a lake surrounded by lush greenery and home to a diverse array of flora and fauna. Originally an operational sand quarry, Tampines Quarry collected rainwater over time, eventually forming a lake. Sand from the quarry was essential for construction; however, operations ceased due to the environmental damage it caused. Having been abandoned for years, Tampines Quarry is now enveloped in thick vegetation. description: This cafe in Penang makes the other hidden cafes ashamed to call themselves hidden. 😎#myfoodie #kopihutan #travelcoffee #travellife  #coffeehuntingmalaysia I have never put so much effort into creating aesthetic cafe content. It took me one car ride, a funicular train up Penang Hill (712m above sea level), slight walk, a buggy ride to save my legs, and hitched a ride at the back of a pickup truck to get back to the train. But it was all worth it. I used to be able to hike up Penang hill in about 1.5-2hours. But this is indeed a spectacular hidden cafe that serves a small variety of coffee (no lattes and affogato for you snobs, sorry) in a laid back environment with the soundtrack of the forest behind you. Kopi Hutan is the ultimate definition of a hidden cafe and if you want to go, drop a comment 📩. description: Have you been to these three important local museums? If not, you should absolutely go. The @wellsbuilt is rich in history - especially what William Monroe Wells contributed to the local community as a physician and someone who hosted those who were not accommodated elsewhere.  The @hannibalsquare_heritagecenter showcases Winter Park’s historic African-American community. A history that many locals may be unaware of with stories of past and present residents.  The Zora Neale Hurston Museum in Eatonville showcases not just Zora’s legacy, but the importance of preservation, and showcases artists like the one currently on display - @jerushia.graham. There is also a walking tour of historic Eatonville that you can take.  At all three locations wonderfully knowledgeable docents are available to speak with and learn from.

description: NOT URMU, NOT ILHAM GALLERY 🏆 (no offense, i love u guys sm too)— CANT BELIEVE that this art gallery have swimming pool and its located in the middle of lowkey forest in KL ⁉️ . location is at the end of the video (pt.1) . GASPED COUNTLESS-LY when i first stepped in (it was so serene and EMPTY). really really grateful that we found this place 😭😭 - rating this hidden gems 12/10!! . • AH YES ITS FREEEEE ENTRY  • they have private forest that look like a garden, w balcony that hv lots of chairs n tables to sit and two swimming pool • its so different from the art galleries i ever visited cus this one is pet friendly and they serve drink⁉️😭 ( i would say that this is some sort of community as well) • talked to angel (a former banker that now quit her job to become an art enthusiast), one of the member there and she mentioned that they used this as their office (look at those greeneries) and place to hang out too! • she also mentioned that usually during gallery launch, they would have intimate private gathering until night (in the ‘balcony’ with drinks etc) OMFG IS THIS SERIOUSLY MALAYSIA 😭😭🏆 • even tho its opened concept, they also turned on their AC and fan to keep the ambience cool  • best thing is that your pet can be outside (cus they have mini park and garden) + mini hangout spot then u can stroll around the art gallery • btw u guys can also buy their arts on the spot!!! 😭😭😭 . • SAVE THIS POST AND SHARE IT TO YOUR BESTIE N RUNNNNNNN BEFORE IT BECOME CROWDED 😭🏃‍♀️🏆💕 . • also guys, im doing honest review for all the places ive been, if its good ill tell you its good, if its not, I WONT EVEN highlight it in this account (even if they pay me :() i only want the best for my audience; so u guys dont need to worry abt authenticity 💓 • for PR / paid collab / paid partnership for review, slide to my dm 💌🧿 muahh . #hiddengems #artgallery #hiddenmuseum #aestheticmuseum #artgalleries #hiddengem #museum #placestovisit #placestogo #dateideas #kualalumpur #privateartist

description: Painting a gateway to the desert’s soul 🎨 I’m proud to reveal Sahar, a new piece in the « World faces » series. It is inspired by the Indigenous peoples of Egypt and the majestic desert landscapes that surround them. Sahar means dawn in Arabic. Her name captures that quiet moment between night and light, when the desert breathes and silence holds the promise of a new day. Her face blends with the eternal lands of Egypt. Pyramids rise between her eyes, golden dunes sweep across her cheeks, and palm trees whisper the rare beauty of water. This piece draws from strong cultural roots. It honors the Nubians, guardians of the Nile, and the Bedouins of the western desert, whose wisdom is born from sand, wind, and stars. Their spirit lives in her gaze, her adornments, and her presence. As in every World Face, a hidden landscape lives within the eyes. In Sahar, it is a silent desert, a memory painted with light, gold, and stillness. This portrait is a tribute to desert women, to the strength of those who carry their land within. It is a celebration of inner light, collective memory, and the beauty of our origins 🌍 #worldfaces #visagesdumonde #sahar #julienDurix #desertportrait #egyptart #nubianheritage #bedouinculture #identityinart #contemporaryportrait #artinspiredbynature #portraitpainting #artreveal #culturalart #soulfulart #newartwork #landscapeinagaze

description: 🇨🇦4月12日💥天气格外晴朗，阳光洒满温哥华的街道，空气中弥漫着春天的气息。这么好天气，正适合出门走走。我去了女朋友家，她住在Coal Harbour旁边——那片依山傍水、风景如画的区域，仿佛是城市中的一片静谧绿洲。 站在她家的窗前望出去，海天一线，帆船点点，远处的群山依旧被一层薄薄的白雪覆盖，令人心旷神怡。我们一起散步在海边小道上，边走边聊，感受着微风拂面，那一刻特别惬意、特别幸福。 这样的日子简单又美好，是温哥华生活最迷人的样子。

description: The things that stuck with me after reading more than 100 books:- 1. People act on emotions first, logic later. If you can tap into someone’s emotions, you’ve already won half the battle. Whether it’s fear, joy, or curiosity, emotions drive decisions far more than we realize. 2. The power of silence. Silence is louder than words. Sometimes, just not responding can make people reveal their true thoughts or feel pressured to meet your expectations. 3. Everyone has a blind spot. We all have something we want to hear—a compliment, a promise, or reassurance. Spot that blind spot in someone, and you can influence them more easily than you think. 4. Reciprocity works like magic. Do something small for someone, and they’ll feel an obligation to return the favor—even if they don’t realize it. 5. People want to be understood, not judged. The easiest way to influence someone is to listen. Make them feel like their perspective matters, and they'll naturally gravitate toward you. 6. Confidence is a silent weapon. People are naturally drawn to those who exude confidence. Speak with certainty, even if you're unsure, and most will trust your words without question. 7. Repetition creates trust. Say something often enough, and people start believing it. This is why advertising works—familiarity breeds comfort, and comfort breeds trust. 8. Framing matters more than facts. The way you present information can completely change how it’s perceived. Two people can say the same thing, but the one who uses the right tone, timing, and delivery wins. 9. People crave validation. A simple nod, a compliment, or agreeing with someone’s point of view can make them feel seen and heard. And when people feel validated, they’re more likely to align with you. 10. Scarcity is a motivator. When something seems rare or limited, people want it more. Phrases like “Only 2 left” or “Limited-time offer” trigger urgency, pushing people to act quickly. description: CALLI: THE ART OF XICANX PEOPLES at the Oakland Museum of CA through January 2025. @Oakland Museum of California    Experience intergenerational, feminist, queer, and Xicanx-Indigenous artworks offering ancestral forms of liberation, healing, and being. “Calli,” derived from Nahuatl, signifies the essence of home, family, and lineage. Immerse yourself in thought-provoking original artworks, installations, sculpture, painting, photography, poetry, and more, that showcase and honor the stories of Xicanx peoples across California in this temporary “Xicanx home.”  Calli layers multiple artistic perspectives, featuring posters from late queer Chicana activist and professor Margaret “Margie” Terrazas Santos’ collection in conversation with contemporary works by Xicanx artists who expand the horizons of possibility, inspiring reflection and fostering dialogue about a world in which we can all belong. Curated by chingona: @gildaposada and featuring many compas including some shared in this video like @elrafaesparza @jesusvbarraza @melaniecervantes @feevaone y más  I am honored to share: 🛒🍃 La Botanica del Barrio @botanicadelbarrio mobile medicine cart and other connected works in the exhibition 🌹The Rose that Grew from Concrete which offers rose medicine created with Fe’s guidance by members of @curyj510 for a social practice spiritual artivist project to create medicine to Heal the Heart. The medicine will be in the exhibit where visitors are invited to offer healing and positive energies, prayers, or songs over the medicine jars. Once ready, another skill share will be offered to process the medicine, place it in jars, and make it available for use to those participating in the workshops and for other youth of color working in the community specifically system impacted and formerly incarcerated BIPOC youth.  🏷️🌱Wellness Wall: an interactive wall to share and learn remedies from family to cultural. Share yours!  -Fe   #exhibit #artivism #art #arte #oakland #feliciamontes #omca #oakland #oaklandmuseum #botanicadelbarrio #artivism #artivista #wellness #holistic #herbalism #omca #calliexhibit #calli #xicanx #rosethatgrewfromconcrete #wellnesswall

description: Greg Goya, a street artist hailing from Turin, Italy, has made a name for himself with his "fast art," which blends street installations with social media performances. He initially focused on custom sneaker art before transitioning to street art. One of his famous pieces, "Kiss Stop," featured a heart on the ground with the prompt "kiss here," and gained significant attention on TikTok. Goya's work frequently invites public participation, emphasizing themes of love and human connection. His installations, such as a bench that asks who you'd like to sit with, are designed to stimulate thought and interaction. Using washable paint, Goya ensures his works are temporary and environmentally friendly. Despite facing some criticism, his art continues to grow in popularity, with exhibits at locations like the Street Art Museum in Narni and collaborations with places such as the Palace of Venaria. description: Had a fun day at Dujiangyan (DJY)! DJY is a city just outside Chengdu known for its 2000 year old irrigation system which is still in use today. There is a scenic area to observe the system, but I did not visit it. Here are some fun places to check out when you’re there! 🐼 Right outside Lidui Park 离堆公园 station, you’ll see this giant panda statue lounging casually on its back! This is a great photo spot!  🧧 Guanxian Ancient City 灌县古城 is just a 10min walk from the panda statue. This is a commericalised shopping street and is good to roam around and get some snacks! 📸 From the ancient city, you can walk 15mins to Wenmiao Street 文庙街. There are some retro installations featuring items such as cameras from the past displayed along this street. This is a popular photo spot among tourists! Located 10mins away is 钟鸭子 Zhong Ya Zi, a duck specialty store which I had my lunch at. The food was not bad - the duck was drizzled in sweet sauce but I’d prefer if it was served hot. 🌁 You can then walk abour 7mins to South Bridge 南桥, which is one of the main attractions of DJY! Over here you will be treated to a beautiful sight also known as DJY Blue Tears 蓝眼泪 💧 Waters of the Min River are illuminated with shimmering blue light 🩵 The light is turned on after 7pm in summer and around 6pm in winter. Most people will crowd on this bridge but heres a tip from me! The scenery is more beautiful at another bridge -   walk about 7mins Tianfuyuan Bridge 天府源廊桥 and the water currents here are stronger and nicer for photos 🌊 Check out my previous reel to see how it looks like!  I also received a couple of questions on how to get to DJY. There are 2 main modes of transport from Chengdu:  1. There is a bus ticket counter near Chunxi Road 春熙路 subway station Exit C. It looks like a bus and is filled with pandas so it won’t be easy to miss. The counter sells bus tickets to DJY (RMB 58) and departs at 10am.  2. You can travel there via rail too. This is the option I took. Take the subway to Xi Pu 犀浦 station (Line 2) and transfer to their rail to Lidui Park 离堆公园 station. You may buy rail tickets in advance on Trip.com/12306 app.  #vlog #minivlog #chengdu #travel #china #chinatravel #dujiangyan #panda #bluetears

description: “You Read With a Voice in Your Head?” #really  Having a voice in your head while reading, often referred to as "subvocalization," is a common experience for many people, but it's not universal. Subvocalization occurs when you internally "hear" the words as you read them, almost as if you’re speaking the words silently to yourself. This can help with comprehension and retention, making the reading experience more engaging. However, not everyone experiences this inner voice. Some people read without hearing the words in their head, processing the text visually or conceptually instead. For these individuals, reading might be more about quickly grasping the meaning of the text without the need to mentally articulate every word. The presence or absence of subvocalization doesn’t necessarily impact reading ability or comprehension; it’s simply a different way that individuals process information. People who don’t experience this inner voice might read faster or find it easier to skim through text, while those who do might benefit from a deeper, more deliberate engagement with the material. #brain #mind #psychology

description: 𝟐𝟎𝟐𝟓 𝐆𝐫𝐚𝐝𝐮𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧 𝐄𝐱𝐡𝐢𝐛𝐢𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧 – 𝐒𝐜𝐡𝐨𝐨𝐥 𝐨𝐟 𝐏𝐚𝐢𝐧𝐭𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐨𝐟 #CAA In the boundless cosmos, humanity’s pursuit of the infinite never ceases. From Zeno’s paradox—where Achilles endlessly chases the tortoise—to the flickering pixels of the digital age and the volatile rise of AI, “#infinity” remains a persistent riddle and muse. Space is limitless, art knows no bounds, and the infinite continues to challenge and inspire creative expression.   𝐼𝑛𝑓𝑖𝑛𝑖𝑡𝑦 𝑃𝑎𝑖𝑛𝑡𝑖𝑛𝑔 is both a visual algorithm of form, light, and theme, and an experiment in deconstructing and reimagining the very boundaries of painting. It asks: how can finite tools evoke the infinite? Here, painting is not a cold deduction of mathematical symbols, but a perceptual algorithmic reconstruction, alive in its dance between permanence and change.   In this flux of tradition and contemporaneity, the 2025 graduates of the School of Painting push the medium forward. Across four disciplines—oil, print, mural, and mixed media—and twelve studio paths, their works carry both inherited techniques and bold material experiments. They approach art not as students, but as artists—questioning, challenging, and renewing.   Each pursuit of the “infinite” yields its own missteps, and it is precisely these unexpected deviations that break open new possibilities. Whether preserving tradition or disrupting it—or wrestling with both—these young artists channel their journeys into vibrant, dopamine-charged energy.   As time and technology reshape the world, painting remains ever regenerative. Like Borges’ Book of Sand, its greatness lies not in answers, but in endless questions. Can painting still hold onto the essence of being human? description: ✨台北必看免費展覽 ✨ 近期最紅的免費展覽！🇹🇼縮小啦！#戰鬥之城_終  這個展總共有有三層 皆由藝術家 #張立人 花了14年一手打造 觀展順序從B1 開始的時空電影、二樓整個微型城市空間、再到三樓的俯瞰城市 藝術家在不同時期的成長經驗中，以印象和記憶拼湊出腦內呈現的虛構城市，所以會看到不同時期代表象徵的畫面，覺得衝突卻又融合、多元面貌的巨大微型世界 就連我不是很懂藝術的也津津有味 1:12的微型藝術空間，每個畫面都好精細 每一個細節都不可以錯過！ 完美呈現70-80年代時的台灣小小縮影～感覺不同的時空記憶都浮現在腦海中 愛畫畫的孩子們，最喜歡的就是二樓前方 紙人畫畫！創意塗鴉、再將畫作貼在牆面 每個人都是小小藝術家😍 可惜然然只愛車子，看到各種微型車 一直以為是他的玩具！  一直想要往前衝😅😅😅  媽咪只能努力的把他架住快速的看完展間匆匆離去 這也是生孩子後，連看個展覽都是一種挑戰 三樓展區偏創作背景和介紹，和俯瞰整個巨型城市 我在三樓停留了一陣 往下俯瞰的感覺，更覺得藝術家的才華和豐富的想像，真的很震撼！ 然然當然是看上面旋轉的飛機✈️ 台灣城市的微型藝術展 居然免費！怎麼能錯過，快到北師美術館來看看吧 📍北師美術館 🎨戰鬥之城·終  👨‍🎨張立人 展期：2024/5/4-7/21 地址：台北市大安區和平東路二段134號 （科技大樓站 走路三分鐘） 把握時間來看看喔！ @montue2011  #微型 #模型 #微型藝術展 #台北免費展覽 #台北展覽 #台北大安 #台北大安展覽 #親子展覽 #藝術展 #2y5d #24m5d #然然的成長日記  更多然然出去玩 👉🏻 #然然好好玩

description: 🇨🇳 칭다오 인당 6만원대 갓성비 호텔 대공개! (오션뷰+조식+위치👍🏻)  오션뷰+조식+최고 접근성까지? 이 가격 실화? 😍 중국 전역 900개 매장있을 정도로 규모가 큰 주즈호텔(桔子酒店; juzi jiudian) ✨ 바다 전망 객실, 스마트 시스템, 맛있는 조식까지 완벽! 칭다오 잔교(栈桥zhan qiao) 도보 10분, 칭다오 기차역 10분, 해수욕장 택시 10분! 다른 여러 관광지도 접근성 👍🏻 💾 지금 바로 저장하고, 가성비 여행 정보 더 받으려면 필트립 팔로우! 🚀 @pil_trip_ @pil_trip_ 🏨호텔 예약 방법 • 호텔 이름: 오렌지호텔 • 중국어 이름: 桔子酒店(青岛栈桥海景店) • 호텔 위치: https://j.map.baidu.com/0b/biZi (바이두 맵) • 주소: No.1 Qutangxia Road, Nanqu District, Qingdao City, 스남구, 칭다오, 산동, 중국 • 호텔 예약링크: https://url.kr/l6hhej (트립닷컴) . ⭐주변 갈만한곳 추천(15곳) - 가고싶은 곳 골라서 가시면 되게 정리해놨어요! • 잔교(栈桥, Zhanqiao Pier) 거리: 도보 약 15분 (1km) 특징: 칭다오의 상징적인 바다 산책로. 밤에는 조명과 바다 풍경이 어우러져 사진 촬영에 최적. 추천: 잔교 끝에 있는 회란각(回澜阁)에서 바다 전망 감상 . • 성 미카엘 대성당(圣弥厄尔大教堂, St. Michael’s Cathedral) 거리: 차로 약 5분 (2km) 특징: 독일풍 고딕 건축의 천주교 성당. 웨딩 촬영지로도 인기 추천: 유럽 감성 사진 찍기, 입장료 10위안(2000원) . • 중산로 상업지구(中山路商业街) 거리: 차로 약 5분 (2km) 특징: 칭다오의 전통과 현대가 어우러진 쇼핑 거리. 현지 음식점, 카페, 기념품 상점 등등 추천: 로컬 음식(해산물, 칭다오 맥주) 즐기기 . • 신호산 공원(信号山公园, Signal Hill Park) 거리: 차로 약 8분 (3km). 특징: 칭다오 시내와 바다를 한눈에 볼 수 있는 전망대. 독일풍 붉은 지붕 건물이 포토존 . • 소청도(小青岛, Xiao Qingdao) 거리: 차로 약 10분 (3.5km). 특징: 등대와 바다로 유명한 작은 섬. 잔교에서 보이는 섬으로, 산책/사진 찍기좋음 추천: 등대 주변에서 바다 배경으로 사진찍기 . • 5.4광장(五四广场, May Fourth Square) 거리: 차로 약 17분 (8km) 특징: 5.4운동을 기념하는 광장, 붉은 조형물 '오월의 바람'이 랜드마크. 바다와 야경 레이저 조명쇼로 유명 . • 칭다오 맥주박물관(青岛啤酒博物馆) 거리: 차로 약 15분 (5km). 특징: 칭다오 맥주의 역사와 제조 과정 체험. 맥주 시음 포함! 추천: 생맥주 시음과 맥주 거리 야경 즐기기. . • 중산공원(中山公园) 거리: 차로 약 10분 (3km). 특징: 칭다오 최대 공원, 벚꽃과 단풍 명소. 잔산사(湛山寺)도 근처. 추천: 봄 벚꽃 또는 가을 단풍 시즌에 산책. . • 해군박물관(海军博物馆) 거리: 도보 약 15분 (1.2km). 특징: 실제 군함과 잠수함 전시. 바다와 함께하는 역사 체험. 추천: 군함 내부 탐방 후 바다 배경 사진 찍기. . • 샤오위산 공원(小鱼山公园) 거리: 차로 약 10분 (2.5km). 특징: 칭다오 전경과 바다를 한눈에! 잔교와 소청도 뷰. 추천: 전망대에서 일몰 감상하며 사진 촬영. . • 라오산(崂山, Laoshan Scenic Area) 거리: 차로 약 40분 (30km). 특징: 중국 도교 성지, 절경의 산과 바다 조화. CNN 선정 “중국 40대 명소”. 추천: 정상 전망대에서 바다와 산 사진, 도교 사원 탐방. . • 칭다오 올림픽 세일링 센터(青岛奥帆中心) 거리: 차로 약 15분 (6km). 특징: 2008 베이징 올림픽 요트 경기장. 바다와 현대 건축의 조화. 추천: 요트 투어 또는 해안 산책하며 야경 인생샷. . • 황금모래해변(金沙滩, Golden Sand Beach) 거리: 차로 약 40분 (25km). 특징: 아시아 최대 백사장, 맑은 바다. 가족 및 서핑 명소. 추천: 여름 해변 산책, 모래성 쌓기, 석양 사진. . • 칭다오 동물원(青岛动物园) 거리: 차로 약 10분 (3km). 특징: 판다와 다양한 동물, 중산공원 내 위치. 가족 여행지로 유명. 추천: 판다 관람 후 공원 산책, 아이와 함께 인생샷. . • 타이동 상업거리(台东商业步行街) 거리: 차로 약 15분 (5km). 특징: 칭다오 최대 야시장, 먹거리와 쇼핑의 중심지. 추천: 해산물 꼬치, 칭다오 맥주 즐기며 야경 사진. . #桔子酒店 #칭다오여행 #잔교 #54광장 #칭다오 #중국 #갓성비호텔 #가성비호텔

description: 花一天时间，感受厦门氤氲烟火，爱上这座小城！ 都知道厦门是一座慢节奏的城市 比起特种兵式的打卡 或许漫步在大街小巷里是一种更好的打卡方式 其实厦门也是一座骨子里住着文艺的城市 它的文艺对生活在其中的人来说 更多是日复一日的平常 现在说起厦门旅游不再只有鼓浪屿了 游人更愿意去最具烟火气的地方 而溪岸路上就藏着这样的烟火气 作为一个惊艳了无数人的网红打卡地 溪岸路却尽显低调 只有先翻开它的过往 才得以窥见那些藏匿在岁月里的鹭岛旧时光 都说溪岸路一半是花鸟市场，一半是热闹小店 这里有很多有意思的精品店和咖啡店 只要你去过一次便会忍不住地时常想起它 也会情不自禁地爱上厦门这流淌在平凡日子里的袅袅烟火气~
