description: 泰國版的小馬爾地夫 Bubble in the forest Cafe 位於曼谷郊區超夯的網美咖啡廳 爆紅的程度可是一位難求啊！ 建議先用line預約+付訂（可抵消費） 還能挑選自己喜歡的用餐區域 因為現場排隊需半小時起或更久🤣🤣 像我們這次就選擇了獨立的SWING 有私人的空間不怕打擾 還有網美必備的盪鞦韆喔 從曼谷市區過去大約40分左右車程 本想選擇早上剛開門的時間來會比較少人 結果到了現場還是超多人的 這個時候真慶幸我們有先預訂 咖啡廳佔地還蠻大的 室內外皆有座位 戶外漂浮在藍色水面上的座位尤其搶手 再搭配上森林系造景更是吸引人 咖啡廳的環境很美很夢幻非常好拍 帶著滿滿的渡假氛圍～十分愜意 怎麼拍怎麼美～秒出大片🥰🥰 沒有預定到SWING也沒關係 兩層的BUILDING視野也很讚 登上二樓俯看下去 更是將整個園區美景收入眼底 湛藍的海池、漂浮的島嶼座位區 在陽光下隨便拍都是那麼有氛圍感 二側還有懸掛的空中吊床 有點刺激但躺拍又是一張美照👍 但其實個人覺得中央圓形坐位區很棒 有種整個被包覆在海洋裡的感覺～🥰 不過沒有任何的遮蔽物真的很熱 所以建議傍晚時來會比較好 整體整潔度維持的不錯 服務員的態度也很好 只是在溝通上不太順暢（英文不太行） 所以點完餐一定要再確認一次 不然多的或者是有錯誤都以訂單為主🥹 咖啡廳提供特色小吃、飯類、甜點等…. 還有卡打拍照必點的繽紛飲品 這滿滿一桌美食好看又好拍 餐點口味上整體都還可以 價格也沒有很貴且上餐速度快 重點是沒有低消也不限時 吃完還能坐下慢慢聊、拍照拍到爽 整體來說Bubble in the forest Cafe 個人是真的蠻推薦的⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ 雖然熱了點但景真的很好拍 難怪吸引了不少遊客來泰朝聖 成為泰國旅遊必訪景點之一 若是你也要來泰國遊玩記得安排上喔 ❤️SWING左右兩側都有，但個人覺得右側的視野比較佳，剛好可以看到整個園區的風貌 ❤️建議點完餐後可以先到園區內走走拍照 ❤️ 店員當天有提醒人潮較多，除了蘇打飲會比較快，其他的飲品製作時間可能都要等20分鐘左右 Bubble in the forest Cafe 地址：170 Charoen Tha Alley, Bang Toei, Sam Phran description: “The Architect” New mural in Crotone, Italy for @Gulìa Urbana . A visual exploration of the human form — revealing the inner architecture of a woman standing still, yet radiating force. She’s built from both flesh and bone, but also from balance, proportion, and the invisible laws that hold us together. The piece is based on additive color theory — using red and cyan to create depth, contrast, and duality. It holds three visual dimensions: one visible to the naked eye, and two hidden layers that can be revealed using cyan and red lenses. Each layer tells a different story, depending on how you choose to see it. Crotone is the city where Pythagoras once taught — his legacy shaped the design. A triple-circle halo symbolizes harmony, while a simplified Tetraktis of 10 dots floats around the portrait, referencing his philosophy of cosmic order. Red and blue. Structure and spirit. The seen and the unseen. Thank you Gulia Urbana and the people of Crotone for the support, energy, and connection. Thanks @Street Art Cities for documenting the mural and supporting all artists at the project as well as everyone from Gulia Urbana  Congratulations to all my fellow artists Vesod ,Mandioh , Tony Gallo for their amazing walls and all the laughs we shared in Crotone !  A Limited Print Edition is coming soon. ⭕️ #insane51 #TheArchitect #DoubleExposure

description: A Must-See Live Art Experience: Kansong Art Museum Collection at DDP This exhibition allows you to immerse yourself in a one-of-a-kind live media art experience at the Kansong Art Museum Exhibition at Dongdaemun Design Plaza (DDP).  This stunning showcase brings Korea’s artistic heritage to life through mesmerizing digital media and interactive displays. Inspired by the poetic theme—When the clouds clear, the moon shines, and when the wind blows, the stars shine—the exhibition offers a dynamic fusion of tradition and modern technology. Throughout the experience, live performances by artists add another layer of creativity, making each visit unique. description: London offers some fantastic hiking destinations, allowing you to escape the bustling city and immerse yourself in nature.  @jsrey_xperiences_ we've curated five great hiking spots near London for you this summer  1. Hampstead Heath Circular Location: Hampstead Heath, England, United Kingdom. Hampstead Heath is one to add to your favorite places for London hiking. Explore its rolling hills, ancient woodlands, and serene ponds. The circular trail offers stunning views of the city skyline and lush greenery. Don't miss Parliament Hill for panoramic vistas.  2. South Bank of the Thames: While not a traditional wilderness hike, walking along the South Bank of the Thames provides a unique urban experience. Enjoy iconic landmarks like the London Eye, Tower Bridge, and the Tate Modern. The river views are captivating, especially during sunset.  3. Parkland Walk (Finsbury Park to Alexandra Park):  Location: Parkland Walk, Crouch End, London, England. This disused railway line has been transformed into a leafy trail. Wander through woodlands, past old railway tunnels, and enjoy the peaceful atmosphere. It's a hidden gem within the city limits.  4. Thames Path National Trail (Hammersmith to Richmond):  Location: Thames Path, London, England. Follow the Thames River on this scenic trail. Pass by historic pubs, riverside mansions, and charming villages. The path is well-marked, making it an enjoyable day hike.  5. Epping Forest Oak Trail: Location: Epping Forest, northeast of London. Epping Forest, just northeast of London, offers ancient woodlands and diverse wildlife. The Oak Trail takes you through picturesque landscapes, including the iconic Queen Elizabeth's Hunting Lodge. It's a refreshing escape from the urban hustle and bustle.  Don't forget to pack comfortable shoes, water, and a sense of adventure! Whether you're a seasoned hiker or a beginner, these trails offer something for everyone. description: Ever vanished into a sunlit labyrinth? There was something almost sacred about those childhood afternoons in a Romanian village, slipping between rows of freshly laundered linens, the sun igniting them like cathedral windows. The air was thick with the clean, sharp scent of soap and warm cotton, a perfume of simpler days. For a fleeting moment, the world ceased to exist beyond that glowing white maze, and you—barefoot, breathless—were free, untethered, unseen. Romanian villages are relics of a world unwilling to bow to time. Here, clotheslines are more than practical—they are rites of passage, fluttering diaries of daily life. In a country where nearly half the population still resides in villages, this quiet rhythm persists. The wind does not merely dry the fabric; it whispers through generations, threading past to present with the scent of lavender fields, woodsmoke, and sun-scorched earth. The old ways endure not as a refusal to change but as a defiant hymn to something real, something unvarnished. So when was the last time you stood still, truly still, and let the past catch up to you? Can you still hear the crackle of a summer-dry sheet in the wind, feel the golden warmth on your skin? Or have you forgotten what it means to disappear into something so beautifully ordinary? description: Naoki Saito’s solo exhibition, “Respawn Point" is currently on view at Kaikai Kiki Gallery. Naoki Saito has been working as an illustrator, creating artworks for card games and character design, and is also widely known as a drawing YouTuber. In this exhibition, Saito, who has been at the forefront of digital art, takes on the challenge of painting on canvas for the first time. The gallery features a series of bold and experimental works that push beyond the boundaries of digital media, exploring new creative possibilities. There are only two days left until the exhibition closes. The artist will be present at the gallery on the final day, March 21 (Fri). Don’t miss this rare opportunity to hear about the inspirations and stories behind his works in person. ． ． カイカイキキギャラリーでは、さいとうなおきによる個展「Respawn地点」を開催しております。 これまでイラストレーターとして活躍し、カードゲームの作画やキャラクターデザインを手がけ、さらにはお絵描きYouTuberとしても広く知られるさいとうなおきさん。今回の個展では、デジタルアートの第一線で活躍してきたさいとうさんが初めてキャンバスへのペインティングに挑戦しました。 会場には、デジタルの枠を超え、新たな創作の可能性を模索する挑戦的な作品群が並びます。 会期終了まで残り2日となります。最終日の3月21日(金) には、作家自身が在廊予定です。作品誕生の背景や制作秘話を直接聞ける貴重な機会をどうぞお見逃しなく。 . ． Naoki Saito Solo Exhibition “Respawn Point“ Feb 28– Mar 21, 2025 11:00 – 19:00 Closed: Sunday, Monday, and public holidays Kaikai Kiki Gallery ． ． さいとうなおき個展「Respawn地点」 開催期間：2025年2月28日～3月21日 開廊時間：11:00～19:00 休廊日：日曜・月曜・祝日 会場：カイカイキキギャラリー ． ©Naoki Saito #kaikaikikigallery #NaokiSaito

description: เยี่ยมชมโครงการ ‘ไอรา เรซสิเดนซ์ งามวงศ์วาน’ โครงการหรู  ‘ทรอปิคอล โมเดิร์นสไตล์’ ท่ามกลางธรรมชาติเขียวขจี  “ไอรา เรซสิเดนซ์ งามวงศ์วาน” A PRIVATE URBAN NATURE RETREAT เป็นหนึ่งในผลงานที่สะท้อนไปถึงตัวตนของการเป็นบูทีค ดีเวลลอปเปอร์ (Boutique Developer) ที่ชัดเจน และแข็งแรงครบในทุกมิติ อาทิ 1. คุณภาพโครงการ  2. การบริการ 3. ความยั่งยืน (Sustainability) และ 4. เวลบีอิ้ง (Well-being) คุณสุธี ลิมปนชัยพรกุล ประธานอำนวยการ บริษัท นายณ์ เอสเตท จำกัด (Nye Estate) กล่าวย้ำถึงโครงการใหม่นี้ จะเป็นแนวทางการพัฒนาโครงการที่อยู่อาศัย จะเน้นความทุ่มเทใส่ใจทุกรายละเอียด ภายใต้วิธีคิด “Breaking New Ground” เพื่อสร้างบ้านที่เติมเต็มคุณภาพชีวิตที่ดี สร้างความสุข และส่งต่อมรดกที่มากคุณค่าจากรุ่นสู่รุ่น  บ้านเดี่ยวโครงการใหม่  “ไอรา เรซสิเดนซ์ งามวงศ์วาน” (IRA Residences Ngamwongwan) พื้นที่โครงการประมาณ  7 ไร่ ตั้งอยู่ในซอยงามวงศ์วาน 6 ใกล้ทางด่วนเพียง 900 เมตร และเดอะมอลล์ งามวงศ์วาน ประมาณ 1.5 กิโลเมตร  ผังโครงการ คุณภาพชีวิตใกล้ชิดธรรมชาติ •	ออกแบบผังให้มีลักษณะเป็น cluster ทำให้รถผ่านบ้านแต่ละหลังในจำนวนลดลง และเพิ่มความเป็นส่วนตัวให้กับทุกครอบครัว •	วางผังตัวบ้านในแนวทิศเหนือใต้ ช่วยหลบแดดทิศตะวันออกและทิศตะวันตก เปิดรับลมธรรมชาติจากทิศตะวันออกเฉียงเหนือและทิศใต้ •	วางบ้านแบบ Double front courtyard house สร้างสรรค์พื้นที่สวนส่วนกลางระหว่างบ้าน ทำหน้าที่ connect ระหว่างผู้อยู่อาศัยกับธรรมชาติ และเป็นพื้นที่รองรับกิจกรรมสำหรับคนในทุกช่วงวัย (Multi-generation) รวมถึงสัตว์เลี้ยง ซึ่งเป็นการส่งเสริมสุขภาวะที่ดี (Well-being) •	ระบบสัญจรทางเท้าต่อเนื่องเชื่อมกันทั้งโครงการ และสามารถเป็นทางวิ่ง พร้อมต้นไม้ใหญ่ตลอดแนวถนนหลักโครงการ  •	พื้นที่ส่วนกลางออกแบบรองรับ Universal design และสามารถเชื่อมต่อได้จากบ้านทุกหลัง ดีไซน์พื้นที่ส่วนกลาง ส่งเสริม Well-being •	The Terrace & Pond พื้นที่นั่งริมน้ำที่ให้ความรู้สึกผ่อนคลาย มีเสียงของน้ำ รวมถึงสีสันและการเคลื่อนไหวของปลาคราฟ รายล้อมด้วยต้นไม้ใหญ่ให้ความรู้สึกเหมือนพักผ่อนท่ามกลางธรรมชาติ •	Pet-Friendly Zone พื้นที่ของกลุ่มคนรักสัตว์เลี้ยง สามารถพาสัตว์เลี้ยงมาทำกิจกรรมในสวนได้ โดยมีประตูรั้วและแนวไม้พุ่มแบ่งแยกจากส่วนอื่นชัดเจน มีที่นั่งพักคอย ที่ผูกสายจูง ถุงขยะ และถังขยะสำหรับเก็บมูลสัตว์ •	Relaxation Area พื้นที่นั่งพักผ่อน และสามารถนั่งทำงานใต้ร่มเงาต้นไม้ใหญ่  •	Educational Playground พื้นที่เล่นและเรียนรู้กับธรรมชาติ ส่งเสริมจินตนาการและพัฒนาการของเด็กอย่างรอบด้าน ปลอดภัยในการทำกิจกรรม โดยออกแบบให้มีสีสันสดใส โทนสีฟ้าและเขียว เนินที่เปรียบเสมือนภูเขา และเส้นโค้งของคลื่นน้ำ  •	Reflexology path ทางเดินนวดเท้าท่ามกลางธรรมชาติ รองรับผู้อยู่อาศัยในทุกช่วงวัย (Multi-generation) บ้านทรอปิคอลโมเดิร์นสไตล์ เรียบง่ายแต่สวยนาน (Timeless) •	Tropical Modern Style ดีไซน์ตัวบ้านที่เน้นความเรียบง่าย เพื่อให้เกิด timeless สวยนานไร้กาลเวลา •	เน้นเส้นสาย และโทนสีของวัสดุ ที่สร้างความสงบร่มรื่น ผสานไปกับต้นไม้และสวน •	Inner Courtyard / Pocket Garden สร้างความเชื่อมต่อจากมุมมองของสวนส่วนกลาง เข้ามาภายในบ้าน, Room with a view เพิ่มการมองเห็นสวนได้จากหลายมุมของบ้าน เปิดรับแสงและลมธรรมชาติ แต่ยังคงความเป็นส่วนตัวได้จากเพื่อนบ้าน •	แยกพื้นที่ชัดเจน ระหว่าง Guest / Maid / Private Zone พื้นที่นั่งเล่นของครอบครัวและเพื่อนสนิทที่บริเวณชั้น 2 แยกจากพื้นที่รับแขกที่ชั้น 1 และ Maid Zone ที่แยกออกจากพื้นที่ส่วนกลางภายในบ้านอย่างชัดเจน  •	หลังคารองรับการติดตั้ง solar roof ในตำแหน่งที่มีแสงส่องเพียงพอ แต่ไม่ทำลายดีไซน์ภาพรวมของโครงการ #นายณ์เอสเตท description: Have you noticed these epic works of street art around Sydney? They're all hiding in plain sight - you just have to know where to look.  Tell us where to find your favourite street artwork in the comments below. Artwork featured in order: 1. Jenny Munro mural by Matt Adnate on 20 Dixon Street, Sydney 2. Data.scape by Ryoji Ikeda at the International Convention Centre, Darling Harbour 5. In Between Two Worlds by Jason Wing on Little Hay Street, Factory Street and Kimber Lane, Haymarket 6. Tree of Life by Xia Hang on Harrison Lane, Ultimo 7. Balfour Street mural by Matt Adnate and Eric Mangen on Teggs Lane, Chippendale 8. Bin Chickens by Scott Marsh on Teggs Lane, Chippendale 9. Danny Lim mural by Scott Marsh and Blends on Abercrombie Street, Chippendale 10. Native Bouquet by Scott Marsh on Cleveland Street, Darlington 11. Displacement by Apeseven on Vine Street, Redfern 12. Forgotten Songs by Michael Thomas Hill in Angel Place, Sydney 13. Untitled by unknown on Mary Street, Newtown 14. Woman with Telephone by Fintan Magee and Numskull on Church Street, Newtown [Video description: Video opens with a quick cut of several street artworks located around Sydney. Text on screen reads: Epic Sydney Street Art. The video continues to show panning shots of different street art beginning with the Jenny Munro mural, a large painting of Aboriginal Elder Jenny Munro, which is 20 metres tall and appears on the side of the Novotel in downtown Sydney. This is followed by many more artworks including Aspire in Pyrmont, a series of tall glowing yellow trees that sit under an underpass, Forgotten Songs, a collection of metal birdcages which hang high above the ground in Angel Place. The video ends with an untitled mural by artists Fintan Magee and Numskull, which features a painting of a woman 4 metres high on the side of a building in Newtown. The woman is wearing a blue, buttoned blouse and holding a tin can to her ear connected to a piece of string like a telephone. description: Everyone has a hidden side of themselves they don’t want to reveal. This is why I create art—because few things feel as sincere as the marks made on a piece of paper. I stand tall. Vulnerability is a source of strength, yet I am afraid of it being misconstrued as a desire for attention. Self doubt cuts deep. Inadequacy and comparison feels like an addiction. Old wounds follow me no matter how far I run. Inevitably, I end up back in the same place, feeling as helpless as I did years ago.  They say it’s time to let go — but how do I even begin to love myself?  #art #healing #drawing

description: What stirs the soul more deeply than a journey through time? The Mocănița of Maramureș, a narrow-gauge steam train, threads its way through the wilderness of Vaser Valley—a realm suspended between autumn’s last golden sigh and the iron grip of winter. Here, the past lingers like the faint scent of woodsmoke, entwining itself with the crystalline air. The train’s whistle echoes through frost-laced evergreens, a haunting hymn that awakens the spirit of an old-world Romania, where folklore and nature are eternal bedfellows. This locomotive relic, built in 1932, huffs and puffs its way through 21 kilometers of untamed terrain. Originally tasked with transporting timber from the forest, today it carries wanderers hungry for romance and nostalgia. The ancient wheels clatter over tracks hemmed by steep cliffs and river gorges, the landscape untouched by the ceaseless march of modernity. Steam unfurls like a diaphanous veil, mingling with the low-lying mists of the valley, creating an otherworldly tableau that begs for both poetry and reverence. Few places on Earth still breathe with such primordial vigor. As you watch the world pass through rain-streaked windows, it feels as though time itself has slowed. Locals wave from rustic homesteads, their lives bound to the land and its rhythms, while forests whisper stories of unseen creatures and age-old legends. The Mocănița isn’t just a train—it’s a portal to the sublime, a rare chance to revel in the marrow of an unspoiled world. Would you embark on this journey, knowing that its beauty lies in the fleeting and the ephemeral? description: все новинки в тгк: RichKids Store🍭  African Diaspora Goods, Denim Tears' New York flagship, opened on March 15th, 2024. The store’s design was a collaborative effort between Denim Tears’ founder, Tremaine Emory, and Theaster Gates, an award-winning multidisciplinary American artist and urban planner. Gates, whose art translates the intricacies of Blackness through space theory, land development, sculpture, and performance, has extended the role of the artist as an agent of change through the expansiveness of his approach as a thinker, maker, and builder. Among his many notable artistic and conceptual projects are his “land art” and creative placemaking demonstrations, which he famously undertakes through his Rebuild Foundation, where Gates purchases derelict homes and buildings on Chicago's South Side, transforming and reactivating them into affordable housing, community greenspace, artist studios and residencies, creative entrepreneurship incubators, and archival laboratories for both neighbors and visitors. Inspired by Gates’ decades-long artistic practice of archiving, elevating, and making publicly accessible historic Black images and objects, the store also serves as a community space housing a collection of over one thousand, five hundred publications on the history of the Arts of Africa longside the label’s seasonal collections. This robust selection of books was curated by Lee and Whitney Kaplan, owners of the Culver City-based art book store Arcana: Books on the Arts. #рекомендации #fypシ #fup #on #sale #wear #популярное

description: If you haven’t tried condensed milk in your espresso yet, you’re seriously missing out…  Here’s how to make it: 1. Start by adding a generous layer of condensed milk to the bottom of your cup (you can find it at most grocery stores). 2. Add 1/4 cup heavy whipping cream, 2 tbsp milk, and a pinch or two of salt. 3. Whisk it all together until it’s smooth and creamy.  For the espresso: 1. I use 20g of beans for the perfect shot, pulling about 40g of espresso.  2. Fill your cup with ice, then pour in 1/2 cup of milk.  3. Slowly pour the espresso close to the surface of the milk for that perfect pour.  Top it off with your creamy condensed milk mixture and a light dusting of powdered chocolate.  Now that’s an espresso drink worth savoring! It kind of has a Tiramisu vibe, don’t you think? description: So what is a “Living museum”? A living museum is a museum that still functions as its ORIGINAL PURPOSE. Not only is Toronto’s first post office a museum but it’s also a FULL SERVICE CANADA POST. So what’s pretty cool is locals & tourists alike can visit and use it as it was originally intended. If you’re vacationing to Toronto this is a fun stop to add to your itinerary and admission is PWYC to the museum! BONUS FUN FACT: the final clip showcases the accessible entrance to the post office. If you require the accessible entrance it’s about 15m North on the east side of the St. George & Adelaide intersection. You will see a black gate which is unlocked during business hours. You can push open the gate and it will take you into the back courtyard (which is super cute). You should then see the accessible ramp.  SUPER EXTRA FUN FACT: Every second Sunday of the month the post office hosts a letter-writing & calligraphy club in the reading room. If you are a fan of  letter writing you are MORE THAN WELCOME TO JOIN.  #toronto #todotoronto #historic #canadapost #livingmuseum #torontostreets

description: 🇲🇾这家Cheras的牛杂，也太好吃了🤤 今天介绍给你们一家Cheras的隐藏牛杂店，真的特别好吃！刚刚才听老板说，卤味的做法是跟🇨🇳师傅学来的，难怪那么香、那么入味。🤤 沙煲牛杂 真的是完全被惊艳到！牛肉滑嫩到不行，配上浓郁又香的汤底，简直绝配。牛筋Q弹软糯，完全没有腥味，肉质新鲜，和汤底融合得刚刚好，吃第一口就爱上了。 沙煲卤鸡脚 鸡脚卤得超入味，咬下去软糯又有Q感，卤汁香气十足，不咸不油腻，越嚼越香，真的越吃越上瘾。 卤套（鸡腿，豆腐，鸡蛋） 鸡腿软嫩入味，豆腐吸满卤汁，咸香适中，鸡蛋是老卤做法，蛋黄不会干，一整套配白饭，真的超级下饭。 除了卤味、牛杂，这里还有猪肉圆面、鱼圆面、牛肉丸面而且竟然还有牛肉、羊肉、鸡肉水饺，选择超多！不管想吃饭、吃面、还是点小吃，这里都能满足。 而且老板人很好，蛮健谈的，聊几句就觉得很亲切，让人吃得开心，心情也特别好。 📍蕉赖茶餐室 RESTORAN KAFE CHERAS 528-G, Batu 3 1/4, Jln Cheras, Taman Pertama, Cheras, 56100 🕰️ 16pm-12am #隐藏美食 #Cheras美食 #吉隆坡探店 #马来西亚必吃 #吃货的天堂 #本地吃货必试 #美食控必看 #超火美食店 #吃货种草 #牛杂控必试

description: Guide to visiting teamLab Planets Tokyo, Japan!😍✨🌺💎 This museum has a world full of interactive digital artworks that changes based on the presence of people.  There are 4 large scale artwork spaces (indoor) and 2 gardens (outdoor) to experience. Prepare to explore the museum barefoot as some areas involve walking through water up to knee depth. Certain areas also have mirrored floors. Be mindful of your clothing - wear shorts or pants you can be sure to roll up. There are lockers if you need to change & store personal items. Visitors follow one path from room to room. You can download the teamLab app to interact with the art. Artworks to expect during your experience include: - The Infinite Crystal Universe - Koi Pond - Drawing on the Water Surface Created by the Dance of Koi and People - Spheres of Light - Expanding Three-Dimensional Existence in Transforming Space - Flattening 3 Colors and 9 Blurred Colors, Free Floating - Floating in the Falling Universe of Flowers - Floating Flower Garden  - Glowing Moss Garden - Moss Garden of Resonating Microcosms - Solidified Light Color, Dusk to Dawn - Soft Black Hole - Waterfall of light particles at the Top of an incline.    Admissions to teamLab Planets Tokyo cost 3,600 JPY ($23) If you’re hungry don’t miss out on their Vegan Ramen UZU shop right outside the museum! teamLab Planets Tokyo takes about an hour and a half to complete. Thank you for your creativity!  This is Episode 3 of my series where I uncover Tokyo’s most underrated neighborhoods 💌  Today’s Episode: Kiyosumi-Shirakawa ☕️🎨🪴 If you’re looking for a quiet, artsy side of Tokyo that’s still off most tourist radar — Kiyosumi-Shirakawa is the perfect place to explore. Located 15 minutes from Ginza, this riverside neighborhood is known for its slow-paced charm, artisan coffee scene, and small galleries and boutiques. Once an old warehouse and factory district, this neighborhood is now known among locals for their charming warehouse cafes, traditional gardens, and curated bookstores. 🍃☕️ Here are 3 local favorites you shouldn’t miss while you’re there:👉  Kiyosumi Garden – a beautifully preserved traditional Japanese garden with a large pond, stone paths, and perfectly manicured pine trees. Come early in the morning for peace and stunning views of the koi and turtles 🐢👉  le bois – a minimalist café and gallery space tucked away in a quiet corner of the neighborhood. Great for specialty coffee, pastries, and a cozy place to journal or read 📖👉  Museum of Contemporary Art Tokyo (MOT) – one of Tokyo’s top art museums, featuring cutting-edge exhibitions from Japanese and international artists. 📌 Save this post for your next trip to Tokyo & follow @mytokyolife_ for more hidden gems around the city 💕 #tokyo  #kiyosumishirakawa  #TokyoTips  #TokyoNeighborhoods  #Cafes  #TokyoTravel  #Sweets  #TokyoCafes

description: #urbex #exploremore  --- **Urban Exploration (Urbex)** Urban exploration, often called *urbex*, is the activity of exploring abandoned or hidden man-made structures. These places can include old factories, deserted houses, tunnels, hospitals, or even rooftops of skyscrapers. Many people who practice urbex are passionate about history, architecture, and photography. Urbex is not just about adventure. It allows explorers to discover forgotten places and imagine the lives of the people who once lived or worked there. Many urbex enthusiasts take pictures to document their visits, creating beautiful and sometimes eerie images of decay and time. However, urbex also involves risks. Buildings may be unsafe, with broken floors or falling ceilings. Sometimes, exploring such places is illegal, especially if the site is private property. That’s why the urbex community often follows an unwritten rule: “Take nothing but pictures, leave nothing but footprints.” In conclusion, urbex is a fascinating way to rediscover the hidden side of cities, but it requires respect, caution, and responsibility.

description: The cafe's interior design is characterized by its minimalist approach, with a neutral color palette and uncluttered layout. The walls are painted in soft, muted tones, allowing the natural light to fill the space and create a warm ambiance. The furniture is sleek and understated, with clean lines and minimal ornamentation. One of the standout features of this cafe design is the small garden located on the second floor. This garden brings a touch of nature into the space. To further enhance the connection between the indoor and outdoor spaces, large windows are strategically placed throughout the cafe. These windows not only allow natural light to flood in but also provide customers with a view of the lush greenery in the garden. This seamless integration of the interior and exterior creates a sense of tranquility and relaxation. #Sanhaiinteriordesign    #Sanhaiarchitecturedesign    #Sanhaidesign    #interiordesign    #cafeinterior    #storeinteriordesign    #architecturaldesign    #designstudio    #cafeinteriordesign

description: 肇庆｜沉浸在白鹭的世界里，与自然共舞 白鹭不同于海鸥，海鸥喜人，拿点面包就飞过来了，白鹭可是有自己的生活方式的，虽不怕人但也不喜人多；肇庆的鹭鸟生态园反而是刚刚好！ 景区很小众，以观鸟为主，游人自然不多，以至于大部分的游乐设施都荒废了，春节期间也只有小火车和游船在开着；虽说颇为可惜，倒也很适合这里栖息的几万只白鹭，试想人头涌涌的风景区里怕也看不到这么多的鸟了吧？！ 跳上观光小火车，铁轨蜿蜒穿行于花海与鹭群之间。车铃叮当，惊起一片白羽纷飞，小火车载着笑声掠过水畔，仿佛驶入宫崎骏的动画世界。湖心的木舟随波轻晃，船夫竹篙一点，穿行在鸟岛之间，看鸟儿们忙碌于觅食，孵蛋，搭巢，玩闹，一阵风过，鹭鸟归巢的身影掠过天际，如墨笔勾勒的写意画～ #肇庆白鹭 #自然生态 #小众旅行 #观鸟天堂 #宫崎骏世界

description: Lisi Lake — A small, natural lake located in the north of Tbilisi, Georgia. A cozy place with cooler air than the city center, surrounded by walking trails, beautiful nature, and rich wildlife. Just 20 minutes from downtown, it’s the perfect spot for relaxing, exercising, and enjoying nature. There are great facilities around the lake: 🚴‍♂️ Bike Rental Georiders is located at the entrance of Lisi Park and offers high-quality mountain bikes. description: I love the rain so, so much. 🌧️ My love for it has been with me for as long as I can remember. As a kid, I welcomed it with open arms—running outside barefoot, twirling under gray skies, and letting it soak into every inch of me. And even now, that hasn’t changed. I still pause when I hear the first drops, watching them race down the windowpane, letting their familiar rhythm settle deep into my bones. Rain has a way of turning ordinary days into something softer—whether it’s wandering through misty woods or curling up at home with a warm drink. When it’s not falling, I find ways to bring it closer—filling the air with soft rain sounds as I lose myself in a good book. So, this is my love letter to the rain. 💌 You are more than just a passing storm; you are a feeling, a presence, a piece of me. In autumn, you turn the world golden and crisp, weaving through falling leaves with the scent of earth. In winter, you are soft and steady, tapping against frosted glass while I stay tucked beneath a blanket. Spring belongs to you in all the best ways—fresh and full of promise, bringing life to blooming trees and filling the streets with puddles. And summer, oh summer rain, you arrive in bursts—sudden, warm, electric—turning even the hottest days into something refreshing. You are there for the stillness and the adventure, for quiet mornings and wild afternoons. You remind me to slow down, to breathe, to enjoy the simplest moments. I’ll never stop being in awe of you. ❄️🌷🌞🍂 - I’d love to make more little love videos like this for my favorite things—autumn, hobbies, and all the simple joys that fill my heart. What’s something simple and inanimate that you love? Maybe it’s the glow of candlelight, the feeling of flipping through a well-loved book, or the comfort of your favorite sweater. I’d love to know what brings you that cozy, heartwarming feeling! 🤎 #rainy #rainyday #rainydays #rainyweather #rainydayvibes #foggy #rainforest #moodyaesthetic #gloomyweather #gloomy #cozyaesthetic #cozy #cozyvibes #cozycore #cozyliving #slowliving #slowlifestyle #cozyhome #rainsounds #comforting #ambience #atmospheric

description: ”Metempsychosis: The Passion of Pneumatics“ by Ivana Bašić at Schinkel Pavillion Berlin. On view until September 1, 2024. From the exhibition text: Charged by the artist’s childhood experiences of war, violence, brutality, and physical entrapment during the collapse of her native Yugoslavia in the 1990s, Bašić’s humanoid sculptures address sweeping themes of intergenerational trauma, post-humanist feminism, and the quest for immortality, but these far-reaching subjects are refracted through the disarmingly tender bodies in her work, clinging to support structures such as pipes and prosthetics that hold them in place. In the center of the exhibition is a seven-meter-wide, site-specific sculpture that will take up the entire first-floor hall. At the core of this sculpture, between two large lobes of glass, small pneumatic metal hammers are gradually pounding an alabaster stone into dust — merging with the floating clouds of dust already inhabiting the exhibition space. Driven by air-pressure, the hammers’ repetitive movements are timed to the cadence of the artist’s breath, evoking the Gnostic idea of the Pneuma,”breath” and “spirit” in Greek. In the teachings of Gnosticism, the Pneumatics were the highest order of beings — those powered by the “breath of life”, the spirit that transforms beyond the material realm. #contemporaryart #berlin #exhibition #ivanabasic #schinkelpavillion #otherworldly #art #arttok #thingstodoinberlin #installationart #sculpture #machineart

description: Let's talk about what no one wants to admit: Caffeine and its half-life. If you've had caffeine today, you're probably setting yourself up for disrupted sleep, whether you realize it or not. Here's the breakdown: caffeine has a half-life of around 6 hours, meaning it takes that long for just half of it to leave your system. If you drank coffee at 10 AM, by 10 PM you'd still have 25% of that caffeine in your system. Think about that. Would you drink a quarter cup of coffee right before bed and expect to sleep well? Of course not. Yet, that's exactly what your body is dealing with. The problem isn't just the caffeine itself-it's how disconnected we've become from understanding our own physiology. Poor sleep will compound into dysfunctional movement, hormonal imbalances, and chronic fatigue over time. If you care about your long-term health and performance, the question isn't "Did you have caffeine today?" but rather, "Why are you relying on it in the first place?" Thanks to Dr. Moran MD for bringing up this fact about caffeine that so many seem to want to gloss over. #functionalpatterns #fpisthestandard #projectfunction #caffeine #coffee

This work is a fascinating exploration of the relationship between humans and technology. Through the use of futuristic imagery, such as a woman entering a machine upside down with a camera looking through her body, the installation invites viewers to consider the ways in which technology is becoming increasingly integrated into our lives and bodies. description: Enjoy dog-friendly trails and spectacular views at this Perth urban bushland park. Just 8km from the city, Bold Park is a suburban bush sanctuary offering a peaceful escape with over 442 hectares of coastal native bushland to enjoy. Whether you’re a nature lover, fitness enthusiast, or just need a quiet place to unwind, Bold Park’s stunning Tuart and Banksia woodlands, towering jarrah and marri trees, and limestone heaths make it a must-visit. With over 15km of walking trails and 10 scenic lookouts, it’s easy to forget you’re still in Perth! Reabold Hill, the highest natural point along the coast, features an accessible boardwalk leading to a viewing platform with breathtaking 360-degree views of the city and beyond. Bold Park is also home to diverse native plants, wildlife, and wildflowers that bloom throughout the year - especially in spring! 🌼 If you’re up for a workout, you’ll love the hills scattered throughout the park. Try the popular 5.1km Zamia Trail for ocean views and glimpses of ancient zamias, or challenge yourself with the shorter but steeper 1.1km Tuart Walk under the shade of towering trees. Prefer to explore at your own pace? Mix and match trails for a custom adventure! All trails are limestone-based with mostly hard-packed paths, but some areas may be a little sandy or uneven underfoot. Look out for signposts at intersections to guide your way. Here’s what to keep in mind for your visit: 🚻 There are NO toilet facilities inside the park - the nearest ones are at the adjoining Perry Lakes Reserve. 🅿️ The larger Tuart Carpark (off Perry Lakes Drive) provides a convenient entry point to trails. 🐶 Dogs are welcome on a lead - just make sure to clean up after them. 🌼 All plants and animals are protected, so please leave them untouched for others to enjoy. 🥾 Stick to the marked trails to help preserve the park’s natural beauty. Whether it’s a leisurely walk, heart-pumping hike, or just some time outdoors with your dog, Bold Park is the perfect spot to reconnect with nature! . . . . . . . #perthlife #Perth #hiking #bushwalking #boldpark #westernaustralia #hikingtrails  #dogfriendly

description: 上海必打卡地旅游攻略｜如何5天4夜完成20个打卡点？（3）-玩转不收费古镇 昨天有网友丝～我，上海有没有不收钱的地方？这不，体验且为你整理出来了👇👇   朱家角古镇 🌹推荐理由： ✅上海毕竟属于中国江南，我想在这种大魔都下一定要有那种叫“小桥流水人家”的温婉吧？ 果真，在朋友的带路下，来到不收费的朱家角古镇👏 一进来，整体的脚步就开始不自觉的慢下来，满满的烟火气，我想这才是心灵的归处！你值得体验一下 ✅其次，朱家角被称为美食聚集地，果然名不虚传！👍都是老上海的传统口味：什么汤圆、面食等等而且也非常的包容噢 ⭐强推一：阿婆肉粽 阿婆家咸蛋黄大肉	粽，居然只要7.5r。真的肉很大块瘦肉结结实实的，拉丝清晰可见!吃到下面一颗大蛋黄!糯米也非常有味道	!阿	婆家还有红烧扎肉，不过没有尝试 📍地址:朱家角镇北大街264号 ⭐强推二：不过，在这里真的非常强推👍赵小姐的茶🍵 玫瑰花茶、茉莉花茶…总之想养生茶找她就对了 还有好多好玩好吃的，一定要来体验一下感受都市下的慢生活 #上海旅游 #朱家角古镇 #美食分享 #上海必打卡20个地点 #上海古镇

description: Here’s an Aesthetic Hidden Monochromatic (Black and White) Art Museum in Kuala Lumpur for your next solo date or hangout ⋆｡°✩⋆✴︎˚｡⋆ 📍 GDP Campus - Kuala Lumpur As a museum lover boy, I was captivated by this unique aesthetic art museum tucked away in a brand-new architectural firm at GDP Campus, Kuala Lumpur. It’s the ideal spot for solo dates, art lovers, and a perfect weekend activity. description: There’s something about the night — the way it holds silence, the way it hides chaos, and the way it listens without judgment. In this moment, I’m not just standing under the sky… I’m standing under memories, under dreams, under every unspoken word I never said. The stars don’t speak, yet they say so much. The darkness doesn’t scare me — it calms me, because in the quiet of the night, I hear the loudest truth: *who I really am*. I don’t need loud lights to shine. I don’t need a stage to feel seen. In this one frame, it’s just me — real, raw, and unfiltered. No masks. No edits. Just a soul looking up, searching, maybe healing. This isn’t just a photo. It’s a reminder:   - To stay grounded even when I dream high.   - To find peace in chaos.   - To be the calm in the storm.   - To love the quiet and trust the process. Not everyone will get it. And that’s okay.   Because this moment — this energy — isn’t for attention.   It’s for alignment.   If you're reading this, remember:   You don’t need to be loud to be powerful.   You don’t need to be seen to have worth. And sometimes, the deepest growth happens in the darkest hours. Stay silent. Stay strong.   And when it’s time — *shine so loud, even the stars pause to admire you*. —   #DarkAesthetic #MoodyVibes #LateNightThoughts #LostInTheStars #SilentPower #AloneButNotLonely #NightPhotography #CinematicShot #DeepSoul #MenWithMood #EmotionalEdge #HealingJourney #DreamerVibes #Introspective #DarkVibes #SoulInShadows #EyesToTheSky

description: Gerçek adı Can David Bayram olan Pashanim, Kürt kökenli Alman rap sanatçılarından biridir. 2000 yılında Berlin'de doğan sanatçı, genç yaşlardan itibaren hip-hop kültürüne ilgi duymaya başladı. Berlin'in sokaklarından gelen enerjiyi ve yaşam tarzını müziğine yansıtan Pashanim, kısa sürede Almanya rap sahnesinde adını duyurmayı başardı. 2018 yılında rap yapmaya başlayan Pashanim, özellikle 2020 yılında çıkardığı "Airwaves" adlı parçasıyla büyük bir çıkış yakaladı. Bu şarkı Almanya'da listelerde zirveye yükselerek TikTok ve diğer sosyal medya platformlarında viral hale geldi. Şarkının başarısı, Pashanim’i Almanya'daki en popüler genç rapçilerden biri haline getirdi. Müziğinde melodik beat'ler ve akıcı flow’lar kullanarak kendine özgü bir tarz oluşturan sanatçı, şarkılarında genellikle gençlik kültürü, sokak hayatı ve Berlin’in atmosferini anlatmaktadır. "Sommergewitter" ve "Kleiner Prinz" gibi hit parçalarıyla da büyük beğeni toplayan Pashanim, minimalist prodüksiyon tarzı ve lirik yapısıyla dikkat çekmektedir. Bağımsız olarak müzik yapmayı tercih eden ve büyük plak şirketleriyle anlaşma yapmayan Pashanim, kendisi gibi bağımsız sanatçıları destekleyen rap kolektifi Playboysmafia'nın bir parçasıdır. Sahneye nadiren çıkması ve gizemli imajını koruması, hayranları arasında ona olan ilgiyi daha da artırmaktadır. Kendi tarzını ve kimliğini bozmadan müzik yapmaya devam eden Pashanim, Alman rap sahnesinde yükselişini sürdürerek yeni nesil sanatçılar arasında önemli bir yere sahip olmayı başarmıştır.

description: Let me tell you a little story about why this moment means so much to me💙 8 years ago I worked in the Manchester Arndale Lush just below this Waterstones. On my breaks, I would come to this shop and sit in the cafe as I dreamed of being an author. I’d daydream, buy book after book on each shift, and it truly became my place of peace. A few years later when I first wrote Heavenly Bodies, I would walk in again, and imagine seeing my book one day in the shop. I was indie published then and thought it was nearly impossible.  Now, today, I got to walk in to a bookshop that I feel like has seen me through my entire twenties, and all manner of professions, and I got to see my book, on its own table, right near the entrance 😭 This was the exact image I held in my mind for so many years, and the fact that today I got to experience this dream I’d held in my heart for so long is just surreal. I’m crying writing this! It’s thanks to so many people that I was able to do this today, and i’m just so grateful. I feel beyond blessed and lucky to have such amazing readers who spread the word about this book and support me. It started HERE on TikTok, and look how far we’ve come. And a huge thank you to the lovely booksellers Chloe, Charlie, Ellie and Gemma who came and spoke to me and let me sign ALL these books. And the lovely customers who stopped by and picked up a copy as I was signing 🥹💙 You can get a signed copy now at Waterstones Manchester Arndale 🥰⭐️ @waterstonesarndale  #fyp #fairylootromantasybox #fairyloot  #booktok #enemiestolovers #CapCut #bookrecs #books #bookish #bookworm #booktoker #wattpadstories #spicybooks #fantasyromance #heavenlybodies #acotar #fbaa #bookrecommendations #romancebooks #authorsoftiktok

description: Juniper Springs and Campground is one of the most popular campgrounds in the Ocala National Forest. The location offers deeply shaded sites within walking distance of the STUNNING natural springs which some say hold medicinal properties.  While I’ve stayed at the campground many times and always enjoy it you can also come for the day for $15! You can bring food with you and grill on the charcoal grills. There are areas with picnic tables scattered throughout the springs area and it’s super chill. There are signs that alcohol is not permitted and dogs are also prohibited from the springs area only.  The bathrooms were pretty clean considering.  There is a camp store that has quite a few items if you may have forgotten something like a toothbrush etc. There’s also snacks, drinks, merch AND you can rent Kayaks!  The boardwalk is STILL closed and has been for years. And with the price increases here I REALLY wish they would get this done because it’s a huge missing piece of the gem of a place.  Pro tip: Go early before the crowds! Like right when it opens.  For more info go to the website: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/florida/recreation 📍 26701 FL-40, Silver Springs, FL 34488 #hiddengems #hiddengem #floridahiddengems #florida #ocala #ocalafl #springs #floridasprings #ocalanationalforest #floridacamping #kayakflorida

description: 美国谁还没来过这 约书亚树国家公园 這個日落打卡點真的是巨美絕美！！ 📍莫哈韦月亮【Mojave Moon •Joshua Tree】 粉色的天空下以其独特的艺术裝置"Transmission"而闻名。由钢和混凝土制成。它的手掌上有不锈钢月亮，装饰着二向色镜马赛克，手传递能量和光线，超级出片 这个地方还有网路 很适合看日落跟看星星的地方哦 💛约书亚树公园景点分布💛 📍Cholla Cactus Garden：公园内 zui热门的仙人掌花园景点，有一条环形步道可以游览参观多种类型的仙人掌 📍Arch Rock：人气徒步trail，徒步可以看到拱门形状圆滑的岩石，全程1.4英里大概40分钟 📍skull Rock：有一条专属的trail 可以有游览抵达，历经千年岁月冲刷形成的岩石，乍一看像骷髅头 📍Barker Dam：公园内少有的一片山水景观，崎岖的山间 📍Hidden Valley：原生态的石头山谷，邂逅各种奇石不要错过这个景点 📍Keys View：必去的日落景观地，可以俯瞰Colorado Desert全景 📝记得先下载好离线地图，一进到里面就没讯号啦，晚上一定要在那过一夜，看满天星空和流星#美国生活 #美国华人

description: This colourful interactive exhibition at the Ferens is the perfect place to take the kids this Half-Term! 🤩 It’s called Microworld, created by a UK-based digital art collective Genetic Moo, and it’s transformed part of the gallery into a bright, colourful space packed with huge digital projections that respond to your movements! The artwork is alive with weird and wonderful creatures, and as you move around, they react to you and each other. Each microorganism has its own task and purpose, from hiding and sleeping in the shade to eating colours, and watching them all react to your image is really fun! There are even nods to other artworks in the gallery hidden among the creatures, a great way to get the kids into the wider gallery as they try to find all the references. There’s also a sensory play area called the Microlab where younger visitors can explore, play and learn as they study the strange digital lifeforms around them. It’s completely free to visit and runs all summer until 7 September, with intermittent events like family-friendly craft activities and print-making to get stuck into, and even dance parties - with SEND versions too. Full details 👉 https://hullwhatson.com/events/microworld/ Give us a follow to discover more great events like this around Hull & East Yorkshire! #hull #interactiveexhibition #artgallery

description: 🇲🇾 Puchong新开cafe|竟然有沙滩区打卡 还没开张时在外面经过就被招牌吸引了🤩 上个周末正式开张就立马去探店🥳 店内空间舒适宽敞，有ID设计美美的可以打卡📸 我注意到有很多插座，来这里办公也不错🤭 食物方面蛮多样化的，除了早餐/西餐，也有中餐、Nasi lemak等等… 饮料方面除了咖啡，也有花茶、水果茶等等… 价格合理，跟一般café 差不多。 我们盲点了几份食物，U1S1，味道还真不错，品质在线😋 点了一杯巧克力的饮料个人觉得还好，但是咖啡确很不错，很香醇！ Matcha也很浓郁！ 原来这是Penang的牌子，在Penang/Kedah/Sabah有好几家分店了…  Puchong这家是雪隆d1家，应该陆续有来… 🤭 📍 Daily Coffee 🚗 20, Jalan Puteri 1/5, Bandar Puteri, 47100 Puchong, Selangor. ⏰Daily 8am-12am #puchongcafe #puchong美食 #puchong咖啡厅 #puchong好去处 #puchong必吃 #puchong美食探店 #puchong网红咖啡馆 #klcafe #蒲种公主城 #bandarputeri #吉隆坡cafe #朋友聚会 #puchong早餐 #puchong午餐 #puchong晚餐 #咖啡控 #周末好去处 #不吃醋的特蕊丝

description: 朱柳莉是中国著名的国礼画家，以她的工笔画和刺绣作品闻名。她在艺术领域取得了显著的成就，以下是她的一些主要艺术成就和贡献： 1. **工笔画大师**：朱柳莉擅长工笔画，其作品细腻精致，色彩丰富，常常描绘花鸟鱼虫等自然题材，展现了极高的艺术造诣。 2. **刺绣艺术家**：她不仅擅长绘画，还精通刺绣艺术，将绘画与刺绣完美结合，创作出许多精美的刺绣画作。她的刺绣作品色彩鲜艳、针法细腻，受到广泛赞誉。 3. **国礼艺术家**：作为国礼画家，朱柳莉的作品被选作国家礼品，赠送给外国政要和贵宾。这不仅体现了她个人的艺术成就，也代表了国家对她艺术才华的认可。 4. **艺术教育**：朱柳莉在艺术教育领域也做出了重要贡献，她致力于培养新一代艺术人才，传授工笔画和刺绣技艺，推动传统艺术的发展和传承。 5. **文化交流**：通过参与国际艺术展览和文化交流活动，朱柳莉为中外文化交流做出了积极贡献，提升了中国传统艺术在国际上的影响力。 6. **作品收藏**：她的作品被许多博物馆和美术馆收藏，如中国国家博物馆、故宫博物院等。这些作品不仅展示了她个人的艺术成就，也为公众提供了欣赏和学习的机会。 朱柳莉在艺术创作、教育和文化交流等方面的卓越贡献，使她成为中国当代艺术界的重要人物。她的艺术作品既保留了传统的精髓，又融合了现代的创新，具有很高的艺术和文化价值。#手绘画艺术 #朱柳莉 #国礼画家 #国画 #名画

description: 📍甲洞新开古早味猪肉粉！猪油渣控必冲！ 说到猪肉粉，你们最爱哪一家？ 甲洞新开了一家古早味猪肉粉，汤头、配料都超级有诚意，吃完真的回味超久！ 我的Zui❤️《猪肉粉》 每天用新鲜猪骨慢熬的汤底，喝一口就知道有功夫！ 料给得超足，猪肉片、肉碎、腐竹、猪油渣堆到满出来～  特别是它家的猪油渣！炸得又酥又香，咬下去脆脆的，满口都是猪油的香气，根本灵魂配角！每一口都是满足！ 这里还有槟城风味《龙虎斑鱼头米粉》，汤底是龙虎斑骨熬出来的，完全没有加奶，但味道超鲜甜厚实！喝得出鱼骨熬出来的浓香，鱼肉也超新鲜，米粉吸饱了汤，每一口都很鲜甜。 超级有槟城feel的一道《炸虾仔炒米粉》！ 米粉香气四溢，搭配炸得酥脆的虾仔，咸香脆口，每一口都是幸福！ 小吃推荐： 《Lobak》和《炸腐竹》炸到金黄酥脆，咸香开胃，配着面条一起吃超搭！ 他们家的咖啡也是水准以上！ 香浓顺口，饭后来一杯刚刚好～ CP值超高，价格还很实惠！ 甲洞的吃货们可以冲哦🥳 📍 Restaurant CHU CHU Pork Noodle & Fish Head Noodle A-G-9, Flat, Jalan Udang Harimau 1, Taman Megah Kepong, 52200 Kuala Lumpur, Federal Territory of Kuala Lumpur. 🈺 8am-9pm (♨️星期三休息）  #甲洞美食 #甲洞探店 #KL美食 #雪隆美食 #本地美食 #猪肉粉 #鱼头米粉 #猪油渣 #槟城风味 #古早味美食 #米粉控 #汤底超浓郁 #炸虾仔炒米粉 #吃货日常 #好吃不踩雷 #美食推荐 #早餐打卡 #午餐吃什么 #晚餐推荐 #CP值爆表 #必吃美食

description: Un museo da visitare a Napoli  A hidden gem that few tourists know! This unique museum is located inside the Palazzo Como, an elegant Renaissance building that houses the precious collection of Gaetano Filangieri, prince and great patron of the eighteenth century. Founded by Gaetano Filangieri, the museum represents a real treasure chest of art, history and culture. The intention of the Filangieri was in fact to create a place where art and knowledge could be accessible to all, contributing to the education and cultural growth of Citizens. 📍 Filangieri Museum, via Duomo 288, Napoli. Curiosity 👀: The Como palace is also called "the walking palace". During the construction of Corso Umberto I at the end of the 19th century, the palace risked being demolished or incorporated. To avoid its destruction, the building was dismantled and rebuilt stone by stone, but in a slightly more backward position, as if it had "Walked" to avoid his fate. description: 📍The Louvre Museum in Paris, France, is one of the world’s most famous and visited art museums.  Here are some interesting facts about the Louvre: 1. Historic Palace: The Louvre was initially built as a royal palace in the 12th century, making it one of the world’s oldest and most iconic palaces. 2. Art Collection: The Louvre houses over 38,000 objects, including some of the world’s most famous works of art, such as the Mona Lisa, the Venus de Milo, and the Winged Victory of Samothrace. 3. Mona Lisa’s Smile: The Mona Lisa, painted by Leonardo da Vinci, is one of the most recognised and celebrated artworks in the world. It is displayed in a climate-controlled, bulletproof glass case to protect it. 4. Glass Pyramid Entrance: The iconic glass pyramid at the main entrance was designed by architect I. M. Pei and opened in 1989. It has become a symbol of the Louvre and modern Paris. 5. Size and Scope: The Louvre is one of the largest museums globally, covering an area of 72,735 square meters (782,910 square feet). Navigating the museum’s extensive collection can take days. 6. Medieval Moat: The Louvre was initially constructed as a fortress and was surrounded by a moat. Some remnants of the medieval moat can still be seen in the museum’s basement. 7. Theft of the Mona Lisa: In 1911, the Mona Lisa was stolen from the Louvre by an Italian handyman. It was missing for two years before being recovered and returned to the museum. 8. Palace of Napoleon: During his reign, Napoleon Bonaparte used the Louvre as his royal residence and made extensive contributions to the museum’s art collection. ‼️On the first Saturday of each month, the Louvre offers free admission to its permanent collections for visitors under 26.  @louvre museum  Save and FOLLOW me for more amazing places❤️ . . #travel #louvre #museum #paris #france #travelplaces #travelphotography #fyp #tiktoktravel

The piece features hyper-realistic female figures in contorted, uncomfortable poses reminiscent of cramped travel or fitness routines. The title plays on the notion of airline "premium economy" seating, highlighting the superficiality of luxury and comfort. Uddenberg's work combines elements of high fashion and technology, questioning the commodification of the female body and societal pressures on women. description: So you wanna promote your band’s show by hanging posters around town?  Ryan (AKA TV-MA), Midtopia’s Street Team Manager, has some tips for you to help you build good relationships with local shops/places where you might want to promote. It’s so vital for local musicians to be able to promote their shows with physical promotion materials, but there’s also some do’s and don’ts to the art, to make sure you’re being respectful and mutually beneficial to our local businesses. Tips For Street Team Etiquette: Flyers  1. Introduce yourself to the manager or owner of the shop/business 2. Ask if you can put up flyers at their location 3. Take down any out-of-date flyers to make room for new ones. 4. Recycle old flyers 5. Find a size-appropriate spot that has good visibility and/or foot-traffic 6. Hang up your flyer with whatever is the best for the spot (tape, tacks, or staple gun) and hang it up making it look as clean as possible. 7. Thank the business! (Bonus points: if you take a pic/vid of the hanging flyer to promote on your band’s socials, tag the business in it to cross-promote for them, there, as well!) Good luck with the promo!  - - ✍️Follow @Midtopia for more original music content from local and regional bands and musicians + Local show info + educational tips and guides for DIY bands and music workers like this! - - - - - - - #localshows #DIYband #DIYmusician #DIYmusic #localmusicscene #ict #band #singersongwriter

description: How did I not know about @a_furry_affair? This is a proper pet cafe in the east where pets are allowed inside their air-conditioned cafe! How cool is that. Most of the time, we have to sit outside in the heat at pet-friendly places but this one allows you to go in with your pets. 😍😍😍 It’s a pretty big cafe with a gated corner on the first floor and another gated area in the back where the dogs can run free. Or you can keep them leashed to the carabiners on the ground. This place is really designed for pets, with doggy bowls for you to use and a menu of pet-friendly dishes like nuggets, boneless drumlets, steak and spaghetti. I ordered the Pawsome Meal for Bruno with beef cubes and a blueberry smoothie and he loved it. Don’t worry there’s food for humans too! Burgers, pasta, fish, coffee, alcohol even.  A Furry Affair is open every day, from 10am to 10pm from Sunday to Thursday, and 10am to midnight from Friday to Saturday. description: A true hidden gem in the Bay Area 😍 Nestled in the scenic hills of Danville, the @blackhawkmuseum stands as a captivating homage to automotive history and cultural heritage. It was established in 1988 by businessman and philanthropist Kenneth Behring. The museum initially focused on showcasing Behring's extensive collection of automobiles, including rare and historically significant models. Over the years, the museum expanded its scope to encompass not only classic cars but also a diverse array of exhibits that celebrate the intersection of automotive design, art, and culture. The museum features six exhibits: the Classic Car Collection, Art of Africa, Pat’s Compact, Into China, World of Nature, and Spirit of the Old West. The museum's ambiance, coupled with the passion evident in the meticulously curated displays, made my visit a memorable experience. Whether you are a car enthusiast or someone seeking a taste of the past, the Blackhawk Museum is a captivating destination that transcends the ordinary, inviting you to marvel at the beauty of these timeless machines. 📍Blackhawk Museum,  3700 Blackhawk Plaza Cir, Danville, CA 94506 @blackhawkmuseum  🗓️Open Friday - Sunday 🕰️10 am - 5 pm 🎟️Entry fee - $15 Have you heard of this museum? description: Japan Best Christmas Winter Illumination Spots to visit in 2024 📍Tokyo 📍Azabudai Hills NOV 23 ~ DEC 25 What to expect There are around 17 food and drink stalls (incl. vegan options), a 12-meter-tall Christmas tree shining with 20,000 LED lights, and shops stocking wreaths and other festive trinkets. The venue, the central square of Azabudai Hills, is draped with golden lights and a truckload of decorations. If you feel chilly outside, try one of the limited-edition dishes at a nearby restaurant. For 2024, there will be a photo-spot walk boasting selfie spots and even more decorations. 📍Tokyo Disneyland NOV 15 ~ DEC 25 What to expect At Tokyo Disneyland, enjoy a fantasy-filled Christmas with beautiful decorations, including a glittering Christmas tree. Guests of all ages are invited to experience a delightful and heartwarming holiday season. From November 15 through December 25, 2024, Tokyo Disneyland Electrical Parade Dreamlights will be presented in a special version exclusively for the Christmas event period. 📍Ebisu Garden Place NOV 9 ~ FEB 23 2025 What to expect Featuring a 10-meter-tall Christmas tree, a giant crystal chandelier, and a whole load of lights, The Baccarat Eternal Lights at Yebisu (Ebisu) Garden Place is one of the fancier displays of the season. Along with the Christmas tree, row of lights, and chandelier, the Christmas market is back for the first time in a while. Borrowing inspiration from European Christmas markets, it will take over both squares at Yebisu Garden Place and feature mulled wine, hot chocolate, hearty meals, and trinkets. 📍Roppongi Hills NOV 7 ~ DEC 25 What to expect There will be around 800,000 LED lights. Mohri Garden will be lit up and the Christmas Market will return. There will be several types of Christmas trees, including a flower-inspired tree at Roku-Roku Plaza. The illuminations begin in mid-November and will run until December 25, shining from around 5 p.m. to 11 p.m. each night. 📍Toramon Hills Business Tower NOV 23 ~ DEC 25 What to expect The Station Atrium on the B2 floor of the Toranomon Hills Station Tower will host the "MUUUSE CHRISTMAS EXPERIENCE" in conjunction with "MUUUSE: MUSIC MUSEUM (hereafter "MUUUSE")" held at "TOKYO NODE"*. A giant boombox over 2m tall will appear at the venue. It is an experiential installation where you can enjoy music that colors Christmas in Toranomon. Please spend a relaxing time listening to music with a collaboration menu with "MUUUSE" at the adjacent Toranomon Hills Cafe. In addition, Toranomon Hills'  official character "Toranomon" will be transformed into a Christmas version to welcome you. Together with the wreaths decorated at the entrance of the tower, it will liven up the Christmas mood. In addition, commercial stores will offer limited gourmet food such as Christmas cakes, stollen only available at this time of year, and sweets that will brighten up the holy night. description: 东京装逼圣地？劝退国立新美术馆的三大理由  #东京看展避雷   #穷游劝退指南   #日本旅行真实测评  	 🖼️ 免费展区仅1个 | 分展馆连环收费制 🖼️ 建筑大师设计≠内容惊艳（美术馆设计者黑川纪章在中国最著名的作品：郑东新区） 🖼️ 同样的票价能在上野看3个国字头！ 小红薯们听我含泪总结： 想看硬核展品请直奔国立博物馆（成人1000円） 想带孩子玩去科技馆（展品互动性天花板） 想拍光影大片再考虑这里（安藤忠雄清水墙确实出片） 每个独立展厅单独售票（500-2000円不等） 入场就像开盲盒 建议提前官网查当期展览 今日唯一免费厅10分钟逛完 付费的"XX现代艺术展"看得我瞳孔地震 终于理解那句话—— "艺术的门槛不是审美，是钱包厚度" 📌省流总结： 建筑控/摄影党可冲外立面 想看真迹建议移步上野三件套 学艺术贵不贵我不知道 但这里的票价确实有点小贵贵～💸  #东京美术馆刺客   #旅行防坑指南   #日本自由行攻略   #国立新美术馆   #艺术展打卡

description: ⚠️ Hoh Rain Forest is open I'm very picky and can’t be completely amazed by every “nice” location I visit, but Hoh Rain Forest is truly unique. It’s a must-visit destination a least once in your life.  Some tips for your visit:  — Bring waterproof gear like a rain jacket and water-resistant boots. Even if the forecast is clear, the forest can be damp. The forecast on my visit showed completely sunny weather, and you can see the result. — Explore the popular Hall of Mosses Trail (0.8 miles) and the Spruce Nature Trail (1.2 miles). Both are short but stunning hiking trails. — Double-check that the trail is open. — Consider bringing a lens with a wide aperture to capture the details in low light. #hohrainforest #washingtonstate #olympicnationalpark #nationalparks

description: 🍂 Waris Dırıe’nin gerçek yaşam hikayesi… Kitabı dün okumaya başladım ve bugün bitti. O kadar güzeldi ki…Yıllar önce filmini izlemiştim. Kitabını okumak daha bir farklı olduğunu söylememe gerek yoktur. Konumuz ise;  Güçlü bir başarı hikayesi… ‘Kadın sünneti’ kız çocuklarının doğumundan 5 yaşında kadar yapılan kötü bir uygulama. Kadın üreme organının kısmen ya da tamamen canlı canlı jiletle kesilmesidir. İğne ucu kadar boşluk bırakılır. Düşünün bu iğrenç olay hala devam ediyor. Amaç kadının cinselliğini kontrol altına almaktır. Namus göstergesi olarak uygulanan bu durum kız çocuklarının ölmesine bile sebep olur.  Waris Dırıe de 3 yaşındayken sünnet edilen bir kadın ve 13 yaşındayken deve karşılığı yaşlı bir adamla evlendirilmek istendiğinde ise yaşadığı çölden annesinin izniyle tek başına  yürüyerek kaçar. Geride anne özlemi kalır..Yanına sığındığı akrabalar ise sadece onu hizmetçi olarak kullanır. Taa ki keşfedilene kadar. Waris çok güçlü bir kadındır asla ama asla pes etmez. Kendi deyimiyle “ Somalili bir göçebenin Revlon modeline dönüşmesi” bu etkileyeci başarı hikayesini birebir kendi cümleleriyle okumak çok güzeldi. Hayatı BBC tarafından belgesel olarak 1995’te ‘New York’ta Bir Göçebe’ adında çekilmiştir. Waris, kadınların kendiyle aynı durumu yaşamasınlar diye mücadele vermiştir. Eser sade ve anlaşılır bir dilde kolayca okuyabilirsiniz. Bir günde okuyup bitireceğinize eminim. Ama etkisi uzun sürecek bir hikaye.. description: It’s also well known for another naughty exhibit. Did you see it?  Think you’ve seen all of London’s museums? Bet you haven’t been here. This is the Petrie Museum — and it’s one of the capital’s best-kept secrets Tucked away in UCL, this place is packed with over 80,000 objects from ancient Egypt and Sudan — we’re talking mummies, pottery, amulets, even ancient underwear. Yep, you heard that right It’s named after Flinders Petrie — one of the most influential (and controversial) archaeologists of the 19th century. His work laid the foundations for modern Egyptology, and the museum’s stuffed with pieces he excavated The vibe? Wonderfully old-school. No interactive screens, no café — just endless rows of glass cabinets and handwritten labels. It’s like walking through someone’s very dusty, very eccentric private collection It’s free to visit, super central, and honestly? Way more atmospheric than most of the bigger museums. If you’re into ancient history or just want a break from the crowds, this is your spot Hidden gem status: confirmed.  #londonxlondon #hiddengemslondon #londonhiddensecrets #secretlondon #visitlondon #londonhistory #discoverlondon #bloomsburylondon #quirkylondon #ancientegypt

description: 槟城亚依淡的这个菜市场几十年来一直人气旺盛，成为了当地社区生活的重要组成部分。尽管岁月流逝，环境有所变化，但市场的热闹景象从未减少。老一辈的人们带着他们的回忆逐渐离去，而年轻一代也开始接过接力棒，继续光顾这里。 这市场不仅是一个购物的地方，更是一个承载着人情味和历史的空间。清晨时分，小贩们热情地招呼着客人，摊位前总是人来人往，充满了讨价还价的声音和新鲜食材的气息。许多家庭一代又一代在这里购买食材，从传统美食到创新菜式，菜市场的食材是餐桌上的主要来源。 虽然现代化的超市和线上购物逐渐兴起，但这个菜市场的独特魅力吸引了年轻一代的目光。他们不仅是来买菜，更是来感受这里的氛围，聆听长辈的故事，体验从父母那里耳熟能详的记忆场景。时间虽然改变了一些摊位的面貌，却改变不了市场上流淌的人情与传承的温暖。 这样一个地方，像是一部默默诉说着社区生活变化的纪录片，连接着过去、现在与未来。 #ayeritam #ayeritampenang #airitamwetmarket #地道菜市场 #槟城亚依淡 #槟城亚依淡巴杀 #槟城亚依淡菜市场 #槟城旅游

description: Let’s take a walk around the largest street art district in Helsinki! Pasila became a mecca for street artists back in the 80s and remained so until the late 90s, until a new era with zero tolerance for graffiti had begun. description: 上海装修设计🍃95后都喜欢的新中式风🔥 Hi~这里是画.上海装修设计,专注室内设计10年，打造独属于你的家🏡 今天给大家分享一套95后都爱的禅意韵味的新中式家装 现代风与传统的碰撞，擦出古典雅致的火花 原木与艺术的融合将自然特色保留，绿植、挂画、器物营造零距离自然感，清新舒适。 喜欢这份静谧空间，远离喧嚣，倾听内心，找回自己🍃 . 🏷️·玄关设计： 通顶原木柜设计，中间镂空收纳 旁设换鞋凳，实用又高级🕺 🏷️·客厅设计： 简约设计，木材与中式装饰彰显传统韵味。 天花板做回型吊顶，边带安装回型藏灯 小射灯灯辅助照明，黄色灯光营造复古氛围 米白墙面与浅灰瓷砖形成对比，木质家具更显质感🌲 🏷️·餐厅设计： 餐厅与客厅以木质镂空隔断，空间区划分自然和谐，保持整体空间的流畅感 每一处都恰好融合，每个空间尽显美感 餐桌采用原木材质，简约而大气，椅子则采用布艺与木质结合，既舒适又具质感 餐桌上方设置吊灯，营造温馨的就餐氛围 墙面中式画作或装饰品，增添文化气息 地面依旧采用浅灰瓷砖，与客厅保持一致，确保整体风格的协调统一🏡。 🏷️·卧室设计： 胡桃木地板沉稳温馨，浅色护墙板与地板和谐搭配 米色床头柜与被面展现素雅气质 绿植增添自然清新感🌿，营造轻松入睡的氛围🛌 . 不得不说，审美的尽头竟是新中式！ 整套房屋很耐看很古典禅意，无论是客厅还是餐厅，都展现出简约而不失韵味的设计 既简约实用，也高级美观，让人沉浸于传统文化的魅力与现代生活的舒适中🏡！ 希望你也喜欢~了解更多精彩案例，请移步主页~ . 画 𝑫𝑬𝑺𝑰𝑮𝑵 -原创设计 ▫️Base上海，Since2013 ▫️专注居家实用、温暖自然的设计 〰️ 全案设计｜纯设计|上海 住宅设计｜商业空间设计 · 现代风·极简风·新中式 法式风·侘寂风·混搭风 . ｜锦云江悦公寓｜云开月明华庭｜ ｜华玺名邸｜虹玺名邸｜海泰园｜鸿印里｜ ｜阳明花园广场二期｜新湖青蓝国际城二期｜ ｜中海和园｜保利誉庭｜云林名邸｜东方别墅｜ ｜申川名苑｜星耀名邸｜唐悦名邸｜海天名筑｜ ｜尚和茗庭｜斐丽名邸｜旗忠悦园｜璞悦名邸｜ ｜都汇名邸｜静悦名邸｜晋元华庭｜云玺名邸｜ #上海装修设计#上海装修 #血脉觉醒 #中国人血脉觉醒 #设计 #新中式风格 #新中式装修 #新中式 #装修案例 #室内设计 #我要上热门 #独立设计师 #装修 #装修改造 #上海设计师 #上海装修哪家好 #上海室内设计 #新中式风 #我的装修日记 #装修灵感库

description: 【無二會所】台北｜大安區 日宅老宅全預約制下午茶🤎 百年建築超有特色 (•͈⌔•͈⑅) 🔸 櫻緣午茶 $780 期間限定的櫻緣午茶，只有供應到 4/25 唷！ 這款真的很美，花見糰子很優秀，口感非常很棒，不會太軟也不會太黏，相當Q彈帶勁，紅豆也不會太甜。 櫻花琥珀糖非常特別，脆脆的外殼，裡頭有著清甜滋味。手工的饅頭內餡是紅豆，吃起來香氣十足。時令鮮果也很新鮮美味。 唯一美中不足的是櫻花氣泡飲的味道有些清淡；飲品的部分也有櫻花玄米茶可以搭配喔🤍 🔸 閑午茶 $680 常態的午茶系列，午茶小點有 蜂蜜蛋糕、鹹派、果醬湯種吐司 可供選擇。選了蜂蜜蛋糕，內有糖粒增添口感，配茶很剛好。堅果餅相當脆，堅果也很香，不會太黏膩。飲品選了熱的蜜香紅茶，相當順口不澀，尾韻回甘。桌上還提供熱水可以回沖，非常棒🥰 整體推薦指數：🌕🌕🌕🌕🌖（4.7/5） 總結：無二會所是佇立在喧囂市區內的一抹綠洲。從庭院到室內，各種都值得細細品味✨🫶🏻 據說這裡是日治時期的員工宿舍之一，建築維護得非常好，各種擺飾也都是歷史感十足，濃厚的日式氛圍真的是讓人拍照拍不停，不說還以為到了日本🇯🇵 餐點的表現都蠻不錯的，價格的部分則稍高一些，但維護老式建築本身也不容易。當天是週六下午造訪，沒有客滿的情況下可以繼續待著，我們就這樣待了三個多小時，欣賞著、放鬆著，度過了快樂的午後，推薦給大家(´･ω･`)   P.S. 上網查資料的時候發現，這裡還是郭董之前的私人招待所呢.ᐟ.ᐟ.ᐟ 🏷️ 地區：#i食台北 #iの中和新蘆線美食 #iの松山新店線美食 🏷️ 類型：#i食咖啡廳 #i食甜點 —— 🅂🅃🄾🅁🄴 店家資訊 ———————— 📍：台北市大安區杭州南路二段61巷12號 🕕：週二 14:00～18:00；週三至週日 11:00～18:00 🚫：週一公休 📞：02 2391 7599 🚇：#古亭站 ⭐️：Google 評分 4.7 —— 🄽🄾🅃🄴 補充資訊———————— 📝：全預約制，可線上訂位 📝：每人低消一份套餐 📝：服務費 10% 📝：客滿限時2小時 喜歡我的文章歡迎追蹤我🐰 #無二會所 #古亭美食 #古亭咖啡廳 #台北咖啡廳 #老宅咖啡廳 #台北咖啡廳推薦 #大安區下午茶 #大安區美食 #大安區甜點 #台北下午茶 #台北甜點 #老宅 #老宅咖啡 #台北老宅 #台北下午茶 #台北美食 #台灣 #台北 #taiwan #taipei #taiwanfood #taipeifood #foodie #iの吃貨日記

description: Chevrolet Impala 1967 года – это культовый автомобиль, который стал символом американской автомобильной эпохи благодаря своему агрессивному дизайну, мощности и роскоши. Особенно известна версия 4-дверного хардтопа, получившая всемирную популярность благодаря сериалу "Supernatural". --- Основные характеристики Impala 1967 года 1. Дизайн и кузов Тип кузова: 2-дверное купе (Hardtop или Fastback). 4-дверный седан (Hardtop или стандартный). 4-дверный универсал. 2-дверный кабриолет. Отличительные черты: Широкая хромированная решетка радиатора. Узкие задние фонари (тройные встраиваемые в заднюю панель). Агрессивный профиль с длинным капотом и коротким багажником. Размеры: Длина: 5407 мм. Ширина: 2004 мм. Колесная база: 3023 мм. Высота: 1405 мм. Вес: ~1633–1900 кг (в зависимости от конфигурации). --- 2. Двигатели и их характеристики В 1967 году Chevrolet Impala предлагалась с широкой линейкой двигателей: Рядные шестицилиндровые (L6): 4.1L (250 куб. дюймов): 155 л.с. V8 (Small Block): 4.6L (283 куб. дюйма): 195 л.с. 5.4L (327 куб. дюйма): 275 л.с. V8 (Big Block): 6.5L (396 куб. дюйма): 325–375 л.с. 7.0L (427 куб. дюйма): 385–425 л.с. Примечание: Модель с 7.0L V8 могла разгоняться до 100 км/ч менее чем за 6 секунд. --- 3. Трансмиссия 3-ступенчатая механическая коробка передач (базовая). 4-ступенчатая механическая коробка передач (опция). 2-ступенчатая автоматическая коробка Powerglide. 3-ступенчатая автоматическая коробка Turbo Hydra-Matic (для мощных версий). --- 4. Подвеска и тормоза Передняя подвеска: независимая, на пружинах. Задняя подвеска: жесткая ось, пружинная. Тормоза: барабанные на всех колесах (дисковые тормоза – опция). --- 5. Интерьер Просторный и комфортный салон для 5–6 человек. Варианты отделки: ткань, винил, кожа (в зависимости от комплектации). Опции: кондиционер, AM/FM-радио, электрические стеклоподъемники. --- Популярность в культуре Самой знаменитой стала 4-дверная Impala Hardtop 1967 года, используемая в сериале "Сверхъестественное" (Supernatural). В сериале машина принадлежит Дину Винчестеру и стала своеобразным "членом семьи", символом приключений и борьбы с тьмой. Особенности модели из сериала: Двигатель: 7.0L V8 (Big Block). Цвет: черный с хромированными вставками. Модификации: скрытый отсек в багажнике для оружия и инструментов охотников. --- Chevrolet Impala 1967 года – это символ скорости, стиля и духа свободы, который до сих пор восхищает автолюбителей и поклонников американской классики.  #смешно #кружок #шутки #приколи #мемы #кружки #юмор #рофлы

description: Ganda ng view dito!! Sunsets + City lights!! 📍Kabesera Cafe — Eastridge Village, Angono, Rizal ❤️  Honest Review:  ☀️ the view is amazing, like super amazing :(( It felt like a breather!! i recommend visiting from sunset to night to see the city lights too!! 🍝 For food, my father and I ordered silog meals. They tasted just like how silog meals should be, so it was okay for both of us—no bad comments! My sister ordered pasta, and although it wasn’t bad, something could be added to improve it. The coffee was also okay compared to other overlooking cafés in Rizal. 💸 As for the prices, they’re on the pricey side! I guess you’re really paying extra for the view. The staff was accommodating, although we waited about 30 minutes for our orders. But given the number of people (around a hundred), it didn’t matter that much—we just spent the time appreciating nature, taking pictures, and having a great family moment. ‼️One thing I didn’t like was the entrance fee to Eastridge Village, the popular village in Rizal with lots of overlooking spots. For a four-wheel vehicle, they charge ₱100, ₱50 for motorcycles, and ₱30 for bikers. Isn’t ₱100 too much? Haha. As someone who has been here multiple times and knows that entrance used to be free if you showed your receipt, it’s quite shocking. 😍 Overall, still a great experience! The views really add 10,000x to the experience!! 🥰☀️ #cafe #OverlookingView #Rizal #AngonoRizal #WhenInRizal #motovlogger #roadtrip #citylights

description: Comment “PRICING” for my pricing-for-sales guide Same poster. Same hours. But Warner Brothers would never pay local cafe prices. Because price isn’t about the project. It’s about the stakes. If the outcome has high value to the client, Then helping them reach it should be high value to you, too.  That’s where your price comes from. Freelancers don’t get paid for time. We get paid to shoulder risk. To bring certainty. And the higher/heavier the stakes, the more you should be compensated. Price for that. P.S. description: 🌄 HUMBLE BEGINNINGS (2009-2011) 🌄 URBAN RETREAT by Acti-Labs started with nothing but a family’s determination to make a dream real. 🏠✨ In the beginning, they were a small lab making luxury products for exclusive spas, especially in Russia 🌍. When the economy crashed and exports were no longer viable, they made a bold choice: create their own brand and bring their passion for high-quality products directly to people. 💪🌟 Every team member stepped up—from cleaning floors to developing products—to ensure the dream would not die. 🌱 THE FOUNDATIONS (2011) 🌱 Running on sheer willpower 💸 and a belief in their products, the family launched ActiDerm in the UK in 2011 with just 11 skincare products, determined to keep their staff employed. 💖 Thanks to the courageous sellers who joined them at the start, Acti-Labs not only survived but began to thrive. 🌼 “Nothing is impossible. The word itself says, ‘I’m possible!’” —Audrey Hepburn 🌟 🚀 THE EXPANSION (2012) 🚀 With their business stabilized, new ambitions emerged. Now, Acti-Labs didn’t just want to avoid failure—they wanted to build a legacy. With a devoted team and a growing community of passionate consultants 🫂, they expanded beyond skincare and became “Acti-Labs,” opening a new facility in France dedicated solely to creating their own branded products. The dream had transformed into an unstoppable movement! 💪🌈 🌍 DARE TO DREAM (2021) 🌍 In 2021, amidst another global crisis, Acti-Labs saw incredible growth as the world moved online. But they wanted more than just online success; they dreamed of re-entering the professional beauty world with URBAN RETREAT products for spas, dermatologists, and professionals alike. This was no longer about growth—it was about evolution! 🌱🌟 🔥 DISASTER (2023) 🔥 Just as they were soaring, tragedy struck: a massive fire destroyed their UK warehouse. 💔🔥 But in true Acti-Labs spirit, they turned adversity into opportunity, moving operations entirely to France 🇫🇷. This setback became a powerful relaunch as they streamlined processes and introduced new products, emerging stronger than ever. 🌈💥 ✨ RISING FROM THE ASHES (2023) ✨ Now operating from France, Acti-Labs leaned into eco-friendly practices and a renewed commitment to quality. 🌿 This wasn’t just a comeback; it was a reinvention, with exciting new products and unmatched service. They were truly rising from the ashes! 🎉🔥 🌏 FORGING AHEAD (2024) 🌏 With unstoppable momentum, Acti-Labs expanded to Australia in March 2024 🇦🇺 and invested in advanced technology to create the ultimate online experience for their customers. Acti-Labs is more than a brand—it’s a community, a mission, and a journey that keeps evolving, driven by passion and resilience. 🌐💫

description: 📍Canal Convergence📍  Where: Scottsdale Waterfront When: Nov 3-12 from 6-9pm Cost: FREE!  Canal Convergence in Scottsdale, Arizona is an annual immersive arts and cultural event that transforms the Arizona Canal into a captivating, open-air gallery. This unique celebration of art and innovation combines water, light, and sound to create a stunning display of creativity. Attendees can expect to encounter a diverse range of art installations, from interactive sculptures to kinetic art, all thoughtfully positioned along the picturesque waterfront. In addition to the art, there are live music performers, vendors, family friendly activities, educational workshops, and more! Canal Convergence provides a platform for local and international artists to showcase their talents and engage with the community. It’s a dynamic fusion of art, technology, and nature, making it a must-visit event for anyone looking to experience the vibrant cultural scene of Scottsdale. description: #musik #fyp #masayoshitakanaka #nujabes #godspeedyoublackemporer #tameimpala #kendricklamar #recommendation #samuraichamploo  Samurai Champloo is a critically acclaimed Japanese anime series created by Shinichirō Watanabe, who is also known for his work on Cowboy Bebop. First aired in 2004, the series is renowned for its innovative blend of historical Edo-period Japan with modern elements like hip-hop music, graffiti art, and breakdancing. This unique fusion sets Samurai Champloo apart in the anime world, offering both a stylistically fresh and narratively rich experience. The story revolves around three main characters: Fuu, a spirited and headstrong young woman; Mugen, a wild, unpredictable swordsman with a fighting style inspired by capoeira and hip-hop movements; and Jin, a calm and disciplined ronin who adheres to traditional samurai values. Fuu convinces the two fighters, who initially clash violently upon meeting, to accompany her on a journey across Japan to find a mysterious samurai who “smells of sunflowers.” This quest forms the backbone of the series, though each episode often feels self-contained, resembling an anthology. What truly distinguishes Samurai Champloo is its genre-bending nature. Watanabe merges the aesthetics of Edo-period Japan with contemporary culture in ways that are both humorous and thought-provoking. For instance, the soundtrack, composed largely by the late Nujabes, mixes lo-fi hip-hop beats with traditional Japanese instruments, creating a sonic identity that is as unique as the visuals. This fusion mirrors the series’ thematic exploration of tradition versus innovation, order versus chaos, and personal freedom versus social constraint. The animation style is dynamic and fluid, particularly in the fight scenes, which are choreographed with cinematic flair. Mugen’s erratic and dance-like combat style contrasts sharply with Jin’s elegant and precise swordplay, visually reflecting their conflicting personalities. Fuu serves as the emotional anchor between them, often providing comic relief or moments of human warmth amid the violence and uncertainty of their travels. Despite its historical setting, Samurai Champloo frequently breaks the fourth wall and plays with anachronisms. Episodes include references to baseball, graffiti battles, and even zombie outbreaks, all while maintaining a coherent world. These elements serve not just as stylistic quirks but as commentary on the universality of certain human experiences—violence, ambition, friendship, and the search for meaning. At its core, Samurai Champloo is a story about unlikely companionship and the personal growth that occurs through shared hardship. The trio’s journey is as much internal as it is external, with each character grappling with their past and what kind of future they might want. The show concludes in an open-ended yet satisfying way, staying true to its philosophical tone and refusal to conform to easy resolutions. In summary, Samurai Champloo is a masterclass in genre hybridization, combining action, drama, comedy, and music in a visually and sonically striking package. It remains a standout in anime not just for its style, but for its depth, making it a lasting favorite among fans and critics alike.

description: Explore the vibrant community of Seneca Village, a 19th-century enclave of free Black landowners nestled in what is now Central Park. Founded in 1825, this diverse neighborhood boasted over 200 residents, including African Americans, Irish, and Germans, who built a life complete with houses, schools, and churches.  It was a rare setting where Black New Yorkers could own land and exercise their right to vote. Tragically, in 1857, the city displaced its residents to make way for Central Park, erasing their legacy.  Today, we honor and remember Seneca Village as an essential chapter in New York's history. Discover its rich heritage through historical maps, illustrations, and modern memorials that pay tribute to this lost community.  #SenecaVillage #BlackHistory #CentralPark #NewYorkHistory #CommunityLegacy.

description: 【世界の住宅】フォスターシティー アメリカ、カリフォルニア州の「フォスターシティー（Foster City）」は、サンフランシスコ・ベイエリアに位置する美しいウォーターフロントの計画都市です。この街は、ラグーン（運河）を中心に設計され、水辺の景観が魅力的な高級住宅地として知られています。 『エリアの特徴』 •ラグーンと水辺の住宅:  街の中心にはラグーンが流れ、住民は庭から直接ラグーンにアクセスできる住宅もあります。ヨットやカヌーなどの水上アクティビティも楽しめます。 •治安と教育環境:  小中学校の教育レベルが高く、治安が良いため、家族連れに人気があります。 •利便性:  サンフランシスコダウンタウンまで車で約30分、日本食スーパーや補習校へのアクセスも良好です。 『住宅』 ・一戸建て住宅:  平均価格は約1,500,000～2,500,000ドルで、築年数や立地によって変動します。 •アパートメント:  1～2ベッドルームの物件で、価格は約700,000～1,200,000ドルが相場です。 •賃貸物件:  3ベッドルームの一戸建て賃料は月額3,500～4,500ドル程度です。 『概要』 •生活環境:  公園やスポーツ施設が充実しており、住民同士の交流も盛んです。ラグーン沿いには散歩道や広場が整備されています。 •産業:  IT企業や日系企業が多く集まるエリアで、駐在員にも人気があります。 フォスターシティーは、美しい景観と利便性を兼ね備えた快適な生活環境を提供し、家族連れや企業駐在員にとって理想的な居住地です。 #高級 #住宅街 #アメリカ #america

description: 🇲🇾这家Cheras的牛杂，也太好吃了🤤 今天介绍给你们一家Cheras的隐藏牛杂店，真的特别好吃！刚刚才听老板说，卤味的做法是跟🇨🇳师傅学来的，难怪那么香、那么入味。🤤 沙煲牛杂 真的是完全被惊艳到！牛肉滑嫩到不行，配上浓郁又香的汤底，简直绝配。牛筋Q弹软糯，完全没有腥味，肉质新鲜，和汤底融合得刚刚好，吃第一口就爱上了。 沙煲卤鸡脚 鸡脚卤得超入味，咬下去软糯又有Q感，卤汁香气十足，不咸不油腻，越嚼越香，真的越吃越上瘾。 卤套（鸡腿，豆腐，鸡蛋） 鸡腿软嫩入味，豆腐吸满卤汁，咸香适中，鸡蛋是老卤做法，蛋黄不会干，一整套配白饭，真的超级下饭。 除了卤味、牛杂，这里还有猪肉圆面、鱼圆面、牛肉丸面而且竟然还有牛肉、羊肉、鸡肉水饺，选择超多！不管想吃饭、吃面、还是点小吃，这里都能满足。 而且老板人很好，蛮健谈的，聊几句就觉得很亲切，让人吃得开心，心情也特别好。 📍蕉赖茶餐室 RESTORAN KAFE CHERAS 528-G, Batu 3 1/4, Jln Cheras, Taman Pertama, Cheras, 56100 🕰️ 16pm-12am #隐藏美食 #Cheras美食 #吉隆坡探店 #马来西亚必吃 #吃货的天堂 #本地吃货必试 #美食控必看 #超火美食店 #吃货种草 #牛杂控必试

description: [Review] This is the first time we came across a fine dining restaurant nestled within an industrial area. It offers artisanal bakes in the morning and having heard good reviews of their Pistachio Croissant, we were there to check it out! The exterior of this croissant was encrusted with a huge amount of nuts, giving it a very aromatic and crunchy texture, while being buttery on the inside. The pistachio spread within is creamy and tasty, though of a thinner consistency than I expected. Nevertheless, I considered it value for money at $5 a piece as it is rather hearty and delicious. The smaller sized black sesame croissant (required to be purchased in a pair) came with sweet black sesame custard filling and dessicated coconut to add a light crunch to the exterior. I love the thicker custard cream consistency (as compared to the pistachio croissant) and find the taste very comforting! For a savoury option, we had a hard time deciding between the potato and turkey ham or the chicken curry in bolo bun. We decided to go for the former and glad to say it was not a bad choice. This savoury bun was served to us with the ingredients warm on the inside, which made the eating experience more enjoyable. If you like a classic bun, this is worth a try. Another classic we went for was the tubular shaped butter croissant, which was crispy and lightly sweet. We took the friendly server’s suggestion to dip this croissant in coffee (we went for unsweetened cappuccino) and it tasted awesome! A new way to enjoy croissant for us. Overall, we had a great breakfast at Sonder and would recommend. Do note that the Pistachio Croissant sold out really fast so you may want to visit early if you are keen to try it. description: Free art?? In THIS economy? Insane, I know! Please read the whole post so we’re all on the same page 💕 ✨RULES✨ 🍓 FOLLOWERS ONLY! Just be sure to give as clear of reference as possible, as design clarity will lead to a more accurate depiction! DO NOT TRY TO UPLOAD ON MULTIPLE SOCIALS OR YOU WILL BE DISQUALIFIED! 🍓 YOU CAN ONLY BE SELECTED ONCE! I want people to have a fair shot, please don’t try to get around that. 🍓 I CAN DRAW IN ANY ART STYLE I CHOOSE! I’m using this as an exploration of my art, and since it’s free, I want creative liberty in this! While I play to mainly do headshots, I may do more of the character depending on chance and how much free time I have that month! But you are at minimum getting a headshot if you win :) 🍓 PLEASE CREDIT MY ART IF YOU USE IT! Whether it be an icon or a reference for another artist, ALWAYS credit my work if you use it! It should go for any artists’ work you use! 🍓 Less of a rule and more of an expectation, but I at minimum, I’ll do these ONCE A MONTH! I might do more if I feel like it, but that’s not a promise! description: From Garage Roaster to $700M Coffee Empire: James Freeman's Blue Bottle ☕🔵 James Freeman wasn't a business expert. In 2002, as a struggling classical clarinetist in Oakland, California, he was frustrated with the dark, bitter coffee that dominated the market. He started roasting small batches of beans in a 183-square-foot potting shed and selling them at farmers markets within 48 hours of roasting. When Starbucks and other chains were focused on consistency and convenience, Blue Bottle emphasized freshness, origin, and meticulous preparation methods. The breakthrough came from their contrarian approach to café design. While other coffee shops maximized seating and efficiency, Blue Bottle opened tiny, architect-designed spaces with limited hours and often no WiFi. By 2017, Nestlé acquired a majority stake in Blue Bottle at a $700 million valuation. What strategies drove their remarkable success? Create Scarcity Through Quality Standards: Their commitment to serving coffee only at peak freshness (within 48 hours of roasting) created a sense of urgency and exclusivity. Slow Down When Others Speed Up: While competitors focused on quick service, Blue Bottle embraced time-consuming brewing methods that produced superior results. Design Spaces That Embody Your Values: Their minimalist cafés with clean lines and uncluttered aesthetics physically represented their philosophy of focusing on coffee without distractions. Freeman's story demonstrates that sometimes going against industry trends creates extraordinary opportunities. By emphasizing quality and craft when the coffee industry was racing toward convenience and scale, he built a brand that transformed how millions of people experience their daily coffee ritual. #BlueBottle #SpecialtyCoffee #ThirdWaveCoffee #CoffeeRoaster #CafeDesign #EntrepreneurJourney #CraftCoffee #PremiumBrands #FoodBeverage #AcquisitionSuccess

description: 咬定青山不放松， 立根原在破岩中。 题材：步步高升 [产品特点]：一块原料，整体雕刻，纯手工真光。 [产品介绍]：本摆件采用天然中东古青玉石制作，挑选玉质优美之玉石，经精心雕刻而成，太湖石和竹子都是中国传统文化中的重要元素，它们在历史和文化中都有着深厚的意义。太湖石被视为富贵的象征，并且"石” 谐音"时”有“时来运转"的寓意。太湖石以其美坚硬的特点，与竹子相结合，象征着坚如磐石和节节高升的寓意。 竹子在中国文化中有着极高的地位，被赋予了君子的人格象征，代表着谦虛、有气节、刚直不阿、不怕威逼利诱、坚持自我等品质。竹子的空心代表虛怀若谷的品格，其枝弯而不折，象征着柔中有刚的做人原则。竹子的四季常青则象征着顽强的生命力和青春永驻。 竹子与太湖石相映成趣，共同营造出一份静谧与和谐。当微风拂过，竹叶轻轻摇曳，发出沙沙的声响，仿佛是大自然的低语，让人感受到一种难以言喻的宁静与美好。
